right: 这三个词里的 o、ow、oa 都读字母 O 的名字：
no、snow、coat、go、boat 里的这个音一样。

ladder.q: 哪个词和 coat 里 oa 的读音一样：hot　home　cow
按 ow 的读音把词分两组：yellow　cow　snow　how
读生词 toast 和 bowl，说说 oa、ow 读什么音。
ladder.a: 都读字母 O 的名字

items.lesson: Unit 1_3 Fuel up_3 Listen and match.
items.stem: Mike 每天喝两瓶牛奶。选出正确的一句。
options: Mike drinks two bottles of milks every day.
Mike drinks two bottles of milk every day.
Mike drinks two bottle of milk every day.
right: 瓶子能数，两个瓶子是 bottles；牛奶不能直接数，不加 s：
two bottles of milk。

ladder.q: 补全：three ____ (bottle) of water
改错：Lucy buys three bottle of waters.
ladder.a: Lucy buys three bottles of water.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我每天喝一瓶牛奶，吃两个苹果。
ladder.a: I drink a bottle of milk and eat two apples every day.

items.stem: Amy 会跳舞。选出正确的一句。
right: can 后面的动词用原形，主语是谁都不变：
Amy can dance.
typical: Amy 是“她”，动词要加 s：

ladder.q: 补全：I can ____ (make) robots.
补全：Robin can ____ (jump) rope.
— Can you sing? — 不会。用英语回答，再说一样你会做的事。
ladder.a: No, I can't. I can ...（如 dance）

items.stem: Zhang Peng 这样写自己会做的事，你同意吗？
work: I can play the piano.
I can play the football, too.
right: 乐器前加 the：play the piano；
球类、棋类前不加 the：play football、play Chinese chess。

ladder.q: 补全（不需要就写 ×）：He can play ____ Chinese chess.
补全（不需要就写 ×）：Binbin can play ____ pipa. Let's play ____ football.
用英语说：我会弹钢琴，也会打篮球。
ladder.a: I can play the piano. I can play basketball, too.

items.topic: be good at 后接什么
items.stem: Mike is good at ____ basketball.
right: be good at 后面接名词或动词 -ing：
good at playing basketball、good at football。
typical: Mike can play，那 good at 后面也用原形：

ladder.q: 补全：Amy is good at ____ (draw).
补全：Binbin is good at ____ (play) the pipa.
用英语说：Robin 擅长做机器人。
ladder.a: Robin is good at making robots.

items.lesson: C Project: Make an album of your friends
lessons: Make an album of your friends
items.stem: Lily 给朋友相册写了四句介绍。她从第几句开始写错了？
work: This is my friend Ben.
He is funny and helpful.
He can draws very well.
He is good at playing ping-pong.
right: can 后面的动词用原形，主语是谁都不变：
He can draw very well.

ladder.q: 补全朋友卡：Amy is kind. She can ____ (sing) very well.
改错：My friend Tom can plays the erhu.
用三句话介绍一位朋友：性格、会做什么、擅长什么。
ladder.a: 如：He is clever. He can swim. He is good at drawing.

items.stem: Tim can't sing well, but he can play the erhu well. We need music for our party. — Can Tim help? — ____
options: No, he can't. He can't sing well.
Yes, he can. He can sing for us.
Yes, he can. He can play the erhu.
right: but 后面说 Tim 二胡拉得好，晚会正需要音乐，
他会的事能帮上忙：Yes, he can.
typical: Tim 唱歌不好，就帮不上忙：
No, he can't. He can't sing well.

ladder.q: Ann can't swim, but she can run fast. Ann 会做什么？
Ben can't draw, but he can write well. 海报要写字，Ben 能帮忙吗？用英语答。
ladder.a: Yes, he can. He can write well.

ladder.q: 用 I can't ..., but I can ... 说说你自己。
ladder.a: 如：I can't sing well, but I can dance.

items.stem: — What's the matter, Amy? — ____
right: What's the matter? 问“出了什么事”，
要说出遇到的事：I can't find my pen.
typical: 一听到问句，就先答 Yes：

ladder.q: — What's the matter? — 我的猫病了。用英语回答。
对方说 My cat is sick. 你该回哪一句：I'm sorry. / That's great!
同学看起来很难过，用英语问他怎么了。
ladder.a: You look sad. What's the matter?

items.lesson: Unit 2_1 Start up_1 Read and answer.
items.stem: 爸爸要扔掉几个旧罐子，Sam 想留着做玩具。他说：
right: 叫人“不要做”用 Don't + 动词原形；
宾语是 it、them 时，放在 throw 和 away 中间。
typical: 照 throw away the cans 把 the cans 换成 them：

ladder.q: 补全：This book is useful. Don't throw ____ ____.
改错：No use plastic bags.
用英语说：请把旧纸给我，别扔掉它。
ladder.a: Please give me the old paper. Don't throw it away.

items.stem: Amy can't swim. The swimming test is tomorrow. Amy is ____ .
right: Amy 不会游泳，明天就要考，心里担心：
Amy is worried.
typical: 明天就要考了，心里很激动：

ladder.q: Tom says bad things about me. I'm ____ .（生气的）
My little brother is sick. I'm ____ .（担心的）
用英语说：我爸爸病了，我很担心。
ladder.a: My father is sick. I'm worried.

items.lesson: Unit 2_2 Speed up_1 Read and answer.
items.stem: Old newspapers can turn into paper boxes. 这句话的意思是？
options: 旧报纸可以转进纸盒里。
right: A turn into B：A 变成 B。
旧报纸（old newspapers）回收后变成纸盒（paper boxes）。
typical: 只记得“变成”，从后往前译：

ladder.q: turn into 是什么意思？
翻译：Water can turn into ice.
用 turn into 写一句：旧瓶子可以变成玩具。
ladder.a: Old bottles can turn into toys.

items.topic: ee 和 ea 的读音
items.stem: Lily 这样说，你同意吗？
work: tea 和 see 写法不一样，
但 tea 里的 ea 和 see 里的 ee 读音一样。
right: ea、ee 都读 /iː/：tea、eat、see、sheep。
写的时候要按单词记住用哪一个。

ladder.q: 哪个词的读音和 meet 一样：meat　met　mat
补全（ee 或 ea）：I can s__ a sh__p. It can __t grass.
读生词 seat 和 feet，它们押韵吗？

items.lesson: Unit 2_3 Fuel up_1 Listen and chant
items.topic: ee 和 ea 的长音
items.stem: 哪个词里有和 keep 中 ee 一样的音？
right: keep、see、eat、tea 里的 ee、ea 都读长音 /iː/；
bread 里的 ea、bed 里的 e 读短音，和 ten 一样。
typical: ea 都读长音，bread 和 keep 一样：

ladder.q: 哪个词和 sea 的元音一样：she　shop　ship
按读音分两组：tea　head　sea　bread
读生词 jeep 和 bean，元音一样吗？

items.lesson: Unit 2_3 Fuel up_3 Listen and choose.
items.stem: 为了少用塑料杯，大家商量：我们带自己的杯子去聚会吧。选出正确的一句。
options: Let's bring us own cups to the party.
Let's bring our own cups to the party.
Let's bring own our cups to the party.
right: “我们自己的”说 our own：our 在前，own 在后，
再接东西：our own cups。
typical: 照汉语先说“自己”，再说“我们的”：

ladder.q: 补全：我用我自己的书包。I use ____ ____ schoolbag.
改错：Please bring you own pencils.
用英语说：Amy 用她自己的杯子。

items.stem: Grandpa is talking. Please listen ____ him.
right: “听某人说”是 listen to sb：
Please listen to him.
typical: 汉语“听他说”不用别的词：

ladder.q: 补全：We should listen ____ the teacher in class.
补全：Let's listen ____ music. Look ____ the picture.
用英语说：请听我说。

items.stem: John 的数学题不会做，想请爸爸帮忙。John 该说：
options: I can ask my dad for help.
I can ask my dad help.
right: 请某人帮忙：ask + 人 + for help，
I can ask my dad for help.
typical: “请爸爸帮忙”，ask 后面直接接爸爸和帮忙：
I can ask my dad help.

ladder.q: 补全：You can ask your brother ____ help.
I help my mum. / I ask my mum for help. 哪一句是“请妈妈帮忙”？
ladder.a: I ask my mum for help.

ladder.q: 用英语给建议：你可以请你的朋友帮忙。
ladder.a: You can ask your friends for help.

items.stem: Tom: I'm happy at school. I play with my friends. But I'm sad at home. My dog is sick. Tom 为什么在家难过？
options: His mum is angry with him.
right: 前两句写学校：开心，和朋友玩；
后两句写家：难过，因为 My dog is sick.
typical: 孩子难过，多半是妈妈生气了：
His mum is angry with him.

ladder.q: Tom 在学校感觉怎样？用一个英语词回答。
I'm worried. My grandma is sick. 我为什么担心？用中文答。
给 Tom 一条建议，用 You can ... 写一句。
ladder.a: 如 You can help your dog.

items.stem: Read: Mimi the cat is not happy today. She's very hungry. 怎样帮 Mimi 最合适？
options: Let's play with her. Then she can be happy.
Don't talk to her. She's angry.
right: 短文说了原因：She's hungry.（她饿了）
办法要对着原因：给她吃的。
typical: 故事里陪 Benjy 玩，它就开心了，这次也一样：

ladder.q: 小狗 Lucky 冷得发抖。选办法：A Give him some water. B Take him inside.
Tom looks sad. He can't find his ball. 用英语对他说一句话。
ladder.a: 如：Don't be sad. I can help you.

ladder.q: Kitty looks worried. She has a maths test tomorrow. 用英语说一句帮她的话。

items.lesson: C Project: Make a feelings book
items.stem: 做情绪书：生气时我想大喊，但我可以出去散散步。选出正确的一句。
options: I want shout, but I can take a walk.
I want to shout, but I can take a walk.
I want to shout, but I can to take a walk.
right: want 后面先加 to 再接动作：want to shout；
can 后面直接跟原形：can take a walk。
typical: 汉语“想喊”两个字连着说：
I want shout, but I can take a walk.

ladder.q: When I feel sad, I want ____ cry.
补全（要就写 to，不要写 ×）：I want ____ run, but I can ____ sing a song.
用英语写情绪书的一句：难过时我想哭，但我可以画一幅画。
ladder.a: When I feel sad, I want to cry, but I can draw a picture.

items.stem: We have PE ____ Tuesdays.
right: 在星期几用 on：on Tuesdays、on Monday。
at 用在钟点前，in 用在月份、季节前。

ladder.q: 补全：I often read books ____ Saturdays.
补全：I get up ____ 6:30 ____ Mondays.
用英语回答：What do you have on Fridays?（音乐和体育）

items.lesson: Unit 3_1 Start up_1 Read and answer.
items.stem: 选词填空：Tom is sad ____ he can't find his dog.
right: “找不到狗”是 Tom 难过的原因，
原因前用 because：Tom is sad because he can't find his dog.
typical: so 能把两句话连起来，就用 so：
Tom is sad so he can't find his dog.

ladder.q: 选词填空（and / but / because）：I like cats ____ dogs.
选词填空（but / because）：I want to play outside, ____ it's raining.
用 because 回答：Why do you like your best friend?
ladder.a: 如 Because he is kind and funny.

items.stem: Amy 这样写自己的课，你同意吗？
work: I have art class
on Thursday afternoons.
right: 说“星期几的上午、下午”，有具体哪一天，用 on：
on Thursday afternoons；只说下午才用 in the afternoon。

ladder.q: 补全：I read books ____ the evening.
补全：We play basketball ____ Monday afternoons.
用英语说：我星期六上午上美术课。
ladder.a: I have art class on Saturday mornings.

items.lesson: Unit 3_2 Speed up_1 Read and answer.
items.stem: Kate is tall and Lucy is short, but they both love music. How are Kate and Lucy similar?
options: Kate is tall and Lucy is short.
right: similar 问相同点：两人都爱音乐，They both love music.
一高一矮是不同点（different）。
typical: similar 是“不同”，就答两人哪里不一样：
Kate is tall and Lucy is short.

ladder.q: similar 和 different，哪个是“相似的”？
Lily likes red. Dan likes red, too. 他们哪里 similar？用英语答。
写一个你和好朋友的相同点、一个不同点。
ladder.a: 如 We both like football. I'm tall, but he is short.

items.topic: ie 和 igh 的读音
items.stem: 哪个词里有和 pie 中 ie 一样的音？
right: ie、igh 都读字母 I 的名字 /aɪ/：
pie、lie、tie、high、right、night。
typical: 照拼音 ie 读“耶”，和 yes 开头的音像：选 yes

ladder.q: 把词按读音分两组：tie　big　right　lie
补全（ie 或 igh）：My t__ is on the r__t.
读生词 flight 和 fries：igh、ie 各读什么音？
ladder.a: 都读字母 I 的名字 /aɪ/

items.lesson: Unit 3_3 Fuel up_1 Listen and chant
items.stem: 哪个词和 new 押韵？
right: new、few、zoo、too 的结尾都是长音 /uː/，所以押韵；
now 结尾读 /aʊ/，net 结尾是 /t/。
typical: new 和 now 都是 n 开头、w 结尾，读音一样：

ladder.q: 哪个词和 few 押韵：you　yes　cow
new 和哪个词押韵：blue　no　now
读生词 grew 和 chew，说说 ew 读什么音。

items.lesson: Unit 3_3 Fuel up_3 Listen and choose.
items.stem: Kate 和 Lin 是好朋友，总是互相帮助。用英语说：
right: each other 是 help 的对象，放在动词后面，
不加 s：They always help each other.
typical: 照汉语“互相帮助”，“互相”在前：

ladder.q: 补全：我们互相写信。We write to ____ ____.
改错：The two cats each other play with.
ladder.a: The two cats play with each other.

ladder.q: 用英语说：好朋友应该互相帮助学英语。
ladder.a: Good friends should help each other with English.

items.stem: — Does your aunt work at the weekend? — ____（是的）
right: 用 Does 问，就用 does 回答：
Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.

ladder.q: — Does Amy have art class on Fridays? — Yes, ____ .
— Does Zhang Peng cook lunch? — No, ____ .
用英语问 Mike：你爸爸周末工作吗？
ladder.a: Does your father work at the weekend?

items.stem: My sister ____ her room every Sunday. (tidy)
right: 主语是 My sister（她），动词用三单；
tidy 是辅音 + y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 es：tidies。

ladder.q: 写三单形式：cry　play
补全：My brother ____ (study) English at the weekend.
用英语说：她每天收拾她的书桌。
ladder.a: She tidies her desk every day.

items.stem: 读 Ann 的话：I'm very busy. After school, I finish my homework first. Then I play ball with my friends. 你同意吗？
work: Ann 很忙，
但她的学习和玩耍很平衡。
right: Ann 虽然忙，但放学后先做完作业，还和朋友玩球；
学习和玩耍两样都有，就是平衡。

ladder.q: 放学后 Ann 先做什么？用中文答。
Ben: I'm busy. I play football every day. I don't do my homework. Ben 平衡好了吗？
给 Ben 一条建议，用 You can ... 写一句。
ladder.a: 如 You can do your homework after dinner.

items.stem: 读完校长写给家长的信，Ken 这样说。你同意吗？
work: I do my homework and watch TV at the same time.
这样学习、玩耍都有了，是好的平衡。
right: 平衡是学习有学习的时间，玩有玩的时间；
一边写作业一边看电视，两样都做不好。

ladder.q: 这样安排好吗？I finish my homework first. Then I watch TV.
watch TV 和 do homework，Ken 应该先做哪一件？
ladder.a: 先 do homework，再 watch TV

ladder.q: 用 First ... Then ... 说说你放学后怎样安排学习和玩。
ladder.a: 如：First, I do my homework. Then I play outside.

items.lesson: C Project: Make a chart about work-play balance
lessons: Make a chart about work-play balance
items.stem: Lily: I do my homework every day. I help my mum. I study English every evening. I don't play outside. 哪一句说得对？
options: Lily has a good work-play balance.
right: Lily 的学习、家务都做到了，
可是没有玩的时间，所以该多去外面玩一玩。

ladder.q: 分成 work 和 play 两组：do homework, play football, do chores, fly kites
Ben: I play games every day. I don't do my homework. 给 Ben 一条建议。
用两句英语说说你放学后的学习和玩。
ladder.a: 如：I do my homework after school. Then I play football.

items.stem: Amy 这样写健康小贴士，你同意吗？
work: We should to wash our hands.
We should go to bed early.
right: should 后面直接用动词原形，不加 to：
We should wash our hands.

ladder.q: 补全（不需要就写 ×）：You should ____ eat more vegetables.
改错：He should to see a doctor.
用英语说：我们应该多吃水果。

items.lesson: Unit 4_1 Start up_1 Read and answer.
items.stem: Lily 打算明天去游泳。选出正确的一句。
options: Lily is going to swim tomorrow.
Lily is going to swims tomorrow.
Lily is going to swimming tomorrow.
right: 打算做的事：am / is / are + going to + 动词原形，
Lily is going to swim tomorrow.
typical: going to 就是“打算”，前面不用再加别的：

ladder.q: 补全：I ____ going to read a book tonight.
补全：Tom is going to ____ (visit) his grandma.
用英语说：我们明天打算去公园。
ladder.a: We're going to go to the park tomorrow.

items.stem: — How can I stay healthy? — ____
right: How can I ...? 问“怎样才能……”，
要说做法：You should drink enough water.
typical: 问句里有 can I，就用 Yes 或 No 回答：

ladder.q: 补全：— How can I stay healthy? — You should ____ every day.（锻炼）
I'm always tired in class. 用 You should ... 给他一条建议。
ladder.a: 如 You should get enough sleep.

ladder.q: 用英语问：我怎样才能保持健康？

items.lesson: Unit 4_2 Speed up_1 Read and answer.
items.stem: Ben 下决心：今晚不看电视了。选出正确的一句。
options: I don't going to watch TV tonight.
I not going to watch TV tonight.
I'm not going to watch TV tonight.
right: be going to 变否定，在 am / is / are 后面加 not：
I'm not going to watch TV tonight.
typical: I don't going to watch TV tonight.

ladder.q: 补全（isn't / doesn't）：He ____ going to play games today.
改错：They don't going to eat candy.
ladder.a: They aren't going to eat candy.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我明天不打算去购物。
ladder.a: I'm not going to go shopping tomorrow.

items.topic: oa 和 ow 的读音
items.stem: 哪个词里有和 slow 中 ow 一样的音？
right: 这里的 ow 和 oa 都读字母 O 的名字 /əʊ/：
slow、snow、goat、coat；how 里的 ow 是另一种读音。
typical: ow 学过，就读 how 里的音：选 how

ladder.q: 把词按读音分两组：snow　cow　coat　now
补全（oa 或 ow）：My new c__t is yell__ .
读生词 toad 和 bowl：oa、ow 各读什么音？
ladder.a: 都读字母 O 的名字 /əʊ/

items.lesson: Unit 4_3 Fuel up_1 Listen and chant
items.topic: ay 和 ai 的读音
items.stem: 哪个词里有和 today 中 ay 一样的音？
right: ay 和 ai 都读字母 A 的名字 /eɪ/：
today、may、wait、rain。
typical: 照拼音 ai 读“爱”，today 的结尾和 my 一样：

ladder.q: 按读音分两组：play　cat　rain　bag
补全（ai 或 ay）：Don't pl__ in the r__n.
读生词 sail 和 stay，ai、ay 读什么音？
ladder.a: 都读字母 A 的名字 /eɪ/

items.lesson: Unit 4_3 Fuel up_3 Listen and answer.
items.stem: Kim 说：我打算学骑自行车。选出正确的一句。
options: I'm going to learn to ride a bike.
I'm going to learn ride a bike.
I'm going to learn to riding a bike.
right: “学做某事”说 learn to + 动词原形：
I'm going to learn to ride a bike.
typical: I'm going to learn ride a bike.

ladder.q: 补全：My sister is going to learn ____ (cook).
改错：He wants to learn play the erhu.
ladder.a: He wants to learn to play the erhu.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我打算学做风筝。
ladder.a: I'm going to learn to make kites.

items.stem: — Can I go out to play now? — No, I'm afraid not. 答话人的意思是：
right: I'm afraid not. 是礼貌地说“恐怕不行”，
开头的 No 已经表明：不可以。

ladder.q: — Can I use your pen? — No, I'm afraid not. 能用吗？
I'm afraid it's too late. 这里的 afraid 是什么意思？
用英语礼貌地拒绝：— Can I have some candy? —

items.stem: Sam 总是很晚才睡觉。选出给他的建议。
options: You don't should go to bed so late.
You shouldn't go to bed so late.
You shouldn't to go to bed so late.
right: should 的否定是 shouldn't，后面直接接动词原形：
You shouldn't go to bed so late.
typical: You don't should go to bed so late.

ladder.q: 补全：You ____ watch TV so often.（不应该）
改错：He doesn't should eat so much candy.
ladder.a: He shouldn't eat so much candy.

ladder.q: 用英语给建议：你不应该吃太多冰激凌，你应该多吃水果。
ladder.a: You shouldn't eat too much ice cream. You should eat more fruit.

items.topic: 读懂 but 后面的话
items.stem: 读 Ben 的话：I like computer games, but I don't play them too often. I play football every day. 你同意吗？
work: Ben 爱玩电脑游戏，
这是他的一个坏习惯。
right: Ben 喜欢电脑游戏，但 but 后面说他玩得不多；
他每天还踢足球，这不算坏习惯。

ladder.q: I like ice cream, but I don't eat it every day. 他每天吃冰激凌吗？
Lily: I eat a lot of candy. I don't brush my teeth at night. 是好习惯吗？
用 but 写一句自己的习惯：I like ..., but I don't ... too often.
ladder.a: 如 I like TV, but I don't watch it too often.

items.stem: 读完护眼、护牙小贴士，Mike 这样说。你同意吗？
work: I brush my teeth twice a day,
but I still shouldn't eat too much candy.
right: 刷牙和少吃糖是两条建议，都要做到；
牙刷得勤，糖却吃得多，牙还是会坏。

ladder.q: 哪条是护牙的建议？A Brush your teeth at night. B Look out of the window.
同意吗？I exercise every day, so I can watch TV all evening.
给爱吃糖的弟弟写一条建议，用 shouldn't。
ladder.a: 如：You shouldn't eat too much candy.

items.lesson: C Project: Make a healthy habits checklist
items.stem: Mike 分享打卡表：My brother doesn't always get enough sleep. 意思是：
options: 我弟弟每天都睡得很够。
right: not always 是“不总是”：有的天睡够了，有的天没睡够；
所以他有时候睡不够，打卡表上有空格。
typical: 看到 doesn't 就是“不”，整句是“从来睡不够”：

ladder.q: 选一选：I don't always eat breakfast. A 我有时不吃早饭 B 我从不吃早饭
Amy 一周有三天没喝够水。用 doesn't always 说一句。
ladder.a: Amy doesn't always drink enough water.

ladder.q: 用 I don't always ... I should ... 说说你的一个习惯。
ladder.a: 如：I don't always drink enough water. I should drink more.

items.stem: 选出最合适的回答：— What would you like to drink? — ____
right: What would you like ...? 问“想要什么”，
要说出想要的东西：I'd like some water.

ladder.q: 补全：— What would you like to eat? — I'd like some ____ .（牛肉）
— Would you like some soup? — ____（不要）
— What's your favourite food? — 面条，很好吃。用英语回答。

items.lesson: Unit 5_1 Start up_1 Read and answer.
items.stem: In the future, my robot will ____ stories to me every night.
right: will 后面用动词原形，主语是谁都不变：
my robot will read stories to me.
typical: my robot 是“它”，动词要加 s：

ladder.q: 补全：Tomorrow I will ____ (clean) my room.
改错：The robot will helps my mum.
ladder.a: The robot will help my mum.

ladder.q: 用英语说：将来我会去月球。
ladder.a: I will go to the moon in the future.

items.topic: would like 后接 to do
items.stem: My dad would like ____ noodles.
right: would like 后面接动作，要用 to + 动词原形：
would like to eat noodles。
typical: “想吃”就是 would like 加 eat：

ladder.q: 补全：What would you like ____ (drink)?
补全：Lily would like ____ (eat) some fish.
用英语问 Oliver：你想吃什么？
ladder.a: What would you like to eat?

items.lesson: Unit 5_2 Speed up_1 Read and answer.
items.stem: 将来，火星上会有学校。选出正确的一句。
options: There will have schools on Mars.
There will are schools on Mars.
There will be schools on Mars.
right: 某处“有”用 there is / are，将来就把 is / are 换成 will be：
There will be schools on Mars.
typical: There will have schools on Mars.

ladder.q: 补全：There will ____ a big park in our city.
改错：There will have many robots in the future.
ladder.a: There will be many robots in the future.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我们学校将会有一间太空教室。
ladder.a: There will be a space classroom in our school.

items.stem: Tom 这样说，你同意吗？
work: cook 和 cool 里都有 oo，
所以 oo 的读音一样。
right: oo 有两种读音：book、cook、good、foot 读短音 /ʊ/；
too、cool、zoo、food 读长音 /uː/。

ladder.q: 把词按 oo 的读音分两组：foot　moon　wood　food
哪个词的 oo 和 look 读音一样：food　book　moon
读生词 wood 和 pool：oo 各读长音还是短音？

items.lesson: Unit 5_3 Fuel up_1 Listen and chant
items.stem: 哪个词里有和 pie 中 ie 一样的音？
right: ie、igh、y 在这些词里都读字母 I 的名字 /aɪ/：
pie、light、my、right。
typical: 照拼音 ie 读“耶”，和 yellow 的开头一样：

ladder.q: 按读音分两组：high　fish　fly　sit
补全（ie 或 igh）：The n__t is dark. I eat a p__ .
读生词 tie 和 sight，元音一样吗？

items.lesson: Unit 5_3 Fuel up_3 Listen and choose.
items.stem: In the future, we will grow food in space. Robots will cook for us. We will print cakes, too. 主要讲什么？
options: 家里的机器人能做什么
right: 三句话分别说太空里种的、机器人做的、打印的，
说的都是将来的食物，所以主要讲将来人们吃什么。
typical: 机器人做饭最有意思，这段话讲的是机器人：
选“家里的机器人能做什么”

ladder.q: Cats are cute. They can jump high. Many kids love cats. 主要讲什么？
找出总起句：We can help the earth. We can plant trees. We can recycle bottles.
People will live on the moon. They will grow food there. 主要讲什么？
ladder.a: 将来人们在月球上生活

items.stem: — Where does this apple come from? — ____
right: 主语是 it，动词用三单：It comes from Shandong.
问句里有 does，come 不变；答句没有 does，要加 s。
typical: 问句里是 come，就照着用：

ladder.q: 补全：— Where does the orange come from? — It ____ from Guangxi.
补全：Oliver ____ (come) from Australia.
用英语问：这些胡萝卜是从哪里来的？
ladder.a: Where do these carrots come from?

items.stem: 植物长在土里、吸收水分的部分，英语怎么说？写一个单词。
right: 植物长在土里、吸收水分的部分是根：root；
stem 是茎，leaves 是叶子，seeds 是种子。
typical: 根和茎都是长长的一根，记混了：

ladder.q: 用英语写出植物的这几个部分：根、茎、叶、种子
生菜（lettuce）：我们吃的是它的哪个部分？用英语答。
用英语说：这株植物有长长的茎和大大的叶子。
ladder.a: This plant has a long stem and big leaves.

items.stem: Sunflowers are tall. The flowers are big and yellow. Birds love the seeds. People eat the seeds too. 人们吃向日葵的什么？
right: 短文最后一句：People eat the seeds too.
人们吃的是向日葵的种子：the seeds。

ladder.q: Birds love the seeds. 谁爱吃向日葵的种子？
The flowers are big and yellow. 这句写的是花的样子还是用途？
仿写一句：说一种植物，人们吃它的哪个部分。
ladder.a: 如 We eat the roots of carrots.

items.stem: 读完 The history of tea，哪一句说得对？
options: 茶最早是在英国流行起来的。
茶叶只能泡水喝，不能做吃的。
right: 短文开头说，最早人们不喝茶，而是吃茶叶；
茶先在中国流行，18 世纪才在英国流行起来。
typical: 英国人爱喝茶，茶一定是从英国流行起来的：
选“茶最早是在英国流行起来的”

ladder.q: 按短文排顺序：A 茶在英国流行 B 人们吃茶叶 C 茶传到日本
短文说，在中国有人用茶叶做什么吃的？说出一样。
ladder.a: chicken、eggs、cakes 或 ice cream（任说一样）

ladder.q: 用英语说说你喜欢的一种饮料，它从哪里来。
ladder.a: 如：I like green tea. It comes from China.

items.lesson: C Project: Make a presentation about how a plant grows
items.topic: 介绍植物：they 还是 it
items.stem: 介绍植物怎么长：Look at these sunflowers! ____ from small seeds.
right: these sunflowers 是好几棵，用 they；
they 后面的动词不加 s：They grow from small seeds.
typical: 介绍的是一种植物，就用 it：

ladder.q: 补全：Look at this carrot. ____ grows in the ground.
补全：These potatoes are from Grandpa's farm. They ____ (grow) under the ground.
用 First ... Then ... 说说向日葵怎么长，用上 they。
ladder.a: 如：First, we plant sunflower seeds. Then they grow tall.

items.topic: 回答 Is there 问句
items.stem: — Is there a lake near your home? — ____（有）
right: 问句用 Is there，回答也用 there is：
Yes, there is.（末尾不缩写）
typical: Is it ...? 答 Yes, it is，
这句也这样答：Yes, it is.

ladder.q: 补全：— Is there a lake in the park? — No, ____ .
补全：— Are there any tall trees here? — Yes, ____ .
用英语问：森林里有河吗？
ladder.a: Is there a river in the forest?

items.lesson: Unit 6_1 Start up_1 Read and answer.
items.stem: — ____ for the Lantern Festival? — I'm going to make a fish lantern.
options: What you are going to make
What do you going to make
What are you going to make
right: be going to 的问句：把 are 提到 you 前面，
What are you going to make for the Lantern Festival?
typical: 照 You are going to make... 的顺序，前面加 What：
What you are going to make

ladder.q: 补全：— What ____ Amy going to do? — She's going to visit her grandma.
改错：What do you going to eat for dinner?
ladder.a: What are you going to eat for dinner?

ladder.q: 用英语问同桌：春节你打算做什么？
ladder.a: What are you going to do for the Spring Festival?

items.stem: 山里有一些湖。选出正确的一句。
options: There have some lakes in the mountains.
There are some lakes in the mountains.
There is some lakes in the mountains.
right: 说“某处有某物”用 there is / there are；
lakes 是好几个，用 are。
typical: There have some lakes in the mountains.

ladder.q: 补全：There ____ a small river near my home.
补全：There ____ many birds in the forest.
用英语说：树上有一些鸟，树旁有一条河。
ladder.a: There are some birds in the tree. There is a river near it.

items.lesson: Unit 6_2 Speed up_1 Read and answer.
items.stem: Don't cut down the old trees in the park. 这里的 cut down 是什么意思？
right: cut down 后面是树：砍倒，别砍公园里的老树；
后面是浪费、用量时才是减少：cut down food waste。
typical: 第二单元学过 cut down 是“减少”：

ladder.q: Let's cut down water waste at school. 这里的 cut down 是什么意思？
选意思（砍倒 / 减少）：Animals need trees. Don't cut them down.
用 cut down 说：我们应该减少纸张浪费。
ladder.a: We should cut down paper waste.

items.topic: walk 里的 l 读不读
items.stem: Kate 这样说，你同意吗？
work: walk 里有字母 l，
读的时候要把 l 读出来。
right: walk、talk 里的 l 不发音：walk /wɔːk/；
all、tall、wall 里的 l 要读出来。

ladder.q: 哪个词里的 l 不发音：tall　talk　small
读一读，说出共同的音：draw　August　walk
读生词 chalk 和 hall：l 读不读出来？

items.lesson: Unit 6_3 Fuel up_1 Listen and chant
items.stem: Leo 这样说，你同意吗？
work: book 和 school 里都有 oo，
所以它们的 oo 读音一样。
right: oo 有长短两种读音：school、zoo、moon 读长音 /uː/；
book、look、foot 读短音 /ʊ/。

ladder.q: 哪个词的 oo 和 foot 读音一样：look　moon　zoo
按 oo 的读音分两组：noodles　wood　spoon　book
读生词 hook 和 pool：oo 各读长音还是短音？

items.lesson: Unit 6_3 Fuel up_3 Listen and write.
items.stem: — Will you visit your grandparents on New Year's Day? — Yes, ____
right: Will you ...? 用 will 回答，“你”换成“我”：
Yes, I will. / No, I won't. 句末的 will 不缩写。

ladder.q: — Will Tom come to the party? — No, ____ ____.
— Will they make dumplings? — Yes, ____ ____.
用英语问：春节你会吃饺子吗？再用否定回答。
ladder.a: Will you eat dumplings at the Spring Festival? No, I won't.

items.stem: 明天会下雪。选出正确的一句。
right: 将来“会有”用 there will be，
will 后面用原形 be：There will be snow tomorrow.

ladder.q: 补全：There will ____ strong winds tomorrow.
改错：There will are strong winds this afternoon.
ladder.a: There will be strong winds this afternoon.

ladder.q: 用英语说：明天下午会有大雨。
ladder.a: There will be heavy rain tomorrow afternoon.

items.stem: 这里常常下大雨。选出正确的一句。
options: There is often big rain here.
There is often strong rain here.
There is often heavy rain here.
right: 英语说“大雨”“大雪”用 heavy：heavy rain、heavy snow；
“大风”才说 strong winds。
typical: There is often big rain here.

ladder.q: 补全：We can't go out. There is ____ snow.（大雪）
补全：There are ____ winds today.（大风）
用英语说：明天会有大雨和大风。
ladder.a: There will be heavy rain and strong winds.

items.stem: There is little water in my cup. 这句话的意思是：
options: 我的杯子里几乎没有水了。
我有一个装水的小杯子。
我的杯子里有一点水，够喝。
right: little 加水这类数不清的东西，表示“很少，几乎没有”；
a little 才是“有一点”。
typical: little 是“一点”，就是有一点水：
我的杯子里有一点水，够喝。

ladder.q: I'd like a little ice cream. 他想要冰激凌吗？
There is little food at home. 家里吃的多不多？
用英语说：家里的牛奶很少了。
ladder.a: There is little milk at home.

items.stem: 读完三江源国家公园的短文：它为什么被叫作 “Water Tower of China”？
options: 那里有一座很高的大水塔。
三条大河从这里流出，给很多人送去淡水。
那里一年到头都下大雨。
right: 短文说：长江、黄河、澜沧江都从这里发源，
给千百万人送去淡水，所以叫“中华水塔”。
typical: 那里有一座很高的大水塔。

ladder.q: 读短文：哪三条大河从三江源流出？
我们镇的外号叫 Flower Town。读：There are so many flowers here. 外号怎么来的？
给你的学校起个英文外号，再用一句英语说明原因。
ladder.a: 如：Book School. There are so many books here.

items.lesson: C Project: Write a welcome letter for a nature park
lessons: Write a welcome letter for a nature park
items.stem: 给自然公园写欢迎信，写冬天的天气：____ winter, there is often heavy snow.
right: 季节前用 in：in winter、in spring；
on 用在某一天前，at 用在钟点前。
typical: on Monday 用 on，冬天也用 on：
On winter, there is often heavy snow.

ladder.q: 补全：____ spring, there are many flowers in the park.
补全（in、on 或 at）：We go hiking ____ Saturdays ____ autumn.
为欢迎信写一句：这里夏天常常很热。
ladder.a: In summer, it is often very hot here.

items.stem: 教练提醒队员：We have a football game ____ Saturday. You ____ go to bed late.
right: 星期几前用 on：on Saturday.
“不应该”是 shouldn't + 动词原形：You shouldn't go to bed late.
typical: 写成 You don't should go to bed late.

ladder.q: 补全（不应该）：You ____ read in bed.
改错：We don't should play on the road.
ladder.a: We shouldn't play on the road.

ladder.q: 用英语提醒朋友：星期三我们有篮球赛，你不应该晚睡。
ladder.a: We have a basketball game on Wednesday. You shouldn't go to bed late.

items.stem: I usually eat breakfast ____ 7:00 ____ the morning.
right: 钟点前用 at：at 7:00；
上午、下午、晚上前用 in：in the morning。

ladder.q: 补全：I go to bed ____ 9:00.
补全：I do my homework ____ the evening.
用英语回答：When do you get up?（6:30）

items.stem: — When do you usually eat lunch? — ____
right: When 问“什么时候”，要答出时间：
Usually at 12 o'clock.（钟点前用 at）
typical: 听到 eat lunch 就答在哪儿吃：

ladder.q: — When do you play sports? — ____（4:30）
给答句提问：I eat breakfast at 7:10.
用英语问妈妈：你通常几点吃晚饭？
ladder.a: When do you usually eat dinner?（不说 usually 也对）

items.stem: 全班跟读 plate。哪种读法对？
options: 读成 po-late，p 后加个音
p、l 连着读，中间不加音
读成 pate，l 没读出来
right: pl 是两个辅音挨在一起，要连着读：
p 一出口马上滑到 l，plate 只有一个音节。
typical: 像拼音那样给 p 配个韵母：

ladder.q: 拍手数音节：clock、play、please
圈出含 cl 或 pl 的词：class, cake, people, pen
Please play with the clock. 里有几个词含 cl 或 pl？

items.topic: 过去式 was 和 were 怎么选
items.stem: Lucy and her brother ____ very happy at the zoo yesterday.
right: yesterday 说明是过去：am / is → was，are → were；
Lucy and her brother 是两个人，用 were。
typical: 空前面紧挨着 brother，一个人，就用 was：
Lucy and her brother was very happy.

ladder.q: 用 was 或 were 填空：I ____ nine last year.
用 was 或 were 填空：My friends ____ at my home last Sunday.
改错：Tom and I was in the park yesterday.

items.stem: — What do you do on the weekend? — ____
right: What 问做什么，不用 Yes / No 回答；
I often + 动词原形：I often play football.

ladder.q: 补全：I ____ play sports with my dad.（经常）
改错：I'm usually wash my clothes on Sundays.
ladder.a: I usually wash my clothes on Sundays.

ladder.q: 用英语回答：What do you do on the weekend?（说两件事）
ladder.a: 如：I often watch TV. Sometimes I cook.

items.stem: “我常和姐姐去购物。”哪句对？
options: I often go to shopping with my sister.
I often go shop with my sister.
I often go shopping with my sister.
right: “去购物”是固定说法 go shopping，
go 后面直接跟 -ing 形式，不加 to。

ladder.q: 补全：Let's go ____ (swim) this afternoon.
填 to 或不填：I go ____ school. I go ____ shopping.
用英语说：我星期天常去散步。
ladder.a: I often go for a walk on Sundays.

items.stem: 读完 Robinson 的信，Tom 这样说。你同意吗？
work: 信里的 Friday 说的是星期五。
right: 信里说 His name is Friday.——Friday 是朋友的名字。
名字和星期首字母都大写，要看上下文。

ladder.q: Friday likes swimming. 这里的 Friday 是一个人还是一天？
I play with Friday on Fridays. 哪个是人，哪个是日子？
ladder.a: with Friday 是人，on Fridays 是日子

ladder.q: My dog's name is Sunday. I play with Sunday every day. 第二个 Sunday 指什么？

items.stem: 去年夏天刚学游泳时，我游得不好：Last summer, I ____ good at swimming at first.
right: good 是说“怎么样”，句子里没有动作词，要用 be；
Last summer 是过去，I 配 was，否定是 wasn't。
typical: Last summer, I didn't good at swimming.

ladder.q: 用 wasn't 或 didn't 填空：The training ____ easy yesterday.
用 wasn't 或 didn't 填空：We ____ go to the camp last year.
改错：Yesterday my sister didn't happy.

items.topic: ir 和 ur 读同一个音
items.stem: 下面哪个词含有和 turn 里 ur 相同的音？
right: ir、ur 读同一个音：
girl、first 里的 ir 和 turn、nurse 里的 ur 读音一样。
typical: 只找有字母 u 的词：
fun 里有 u，就选 fun

ladder.q: 圈出和 bird 里 ir 读音相同的词：hurt, hat
圈出和 turn 里 ur 读音相同的词：purple, put, four
找出读音不同的词：third, hurt, hour

items.stem: In the basketball game, Class 2 beat Class 5. 哪个说法对？
options: 两个班的同学打起来了
right: A beat B 表示 A 打败了 B；
Class 2 在 beat 前面，是 2 班打败了 5 班，2 班赢了。
typical: 把 beat 后面的 Class 5 当成赢的一方：

ladder.q: Amy beat Lily in the game. 谁赢了？
用 beat 说：我们班打败了 4 班。
Ben beat me, and I beat Ann. 谁一场也没输？

items.stem: “我最喜欢冬天。”哪句对？
right: best（最）放在句末：I like winter best.
问句 Which season do you like best? 也是 best 在最后。

ladder.q: 连词成句：best / we / summer / like
改错：I like best summer.
用英语问同学最喜欢哪个季节，再写出你的回答。
ladder.a: Which season do you like best? I like … best.

items.stem: “夏天我能和朋友们去游泳。”哪句对？
options: I can swimming with my friends in summer.
I can go swimming with my friends in summer.
I can go swimming with my friends on summer.
right: can 后面用动词原形：can go swimming；
季节前用 in：in summer。

ladder.q: 补全：It's cold ____ winter.
补全：I can ____ (swim) in summer.
用英语说：春天我能放风筝。
ladder.a: I can fly kites in spring.（或 fly a kite）

items.stem: bread, library, grass, umbrella, breakfast 里有几个词含 br？
right: bread、breakfast 的 br 在词首；
library、umbrella 的 br 在词中，也算：共 4 个。

ladder.q: 圈出含 gr 的词：green, girl, grow, hungry
补全单词：um____ella（雨伞）　li____ary（图书馆）
写出两个 br 在词中间的单词。

items.unit: Unit 2 You can make a difference
items.stem: Ben got up late this morning, so he ____ to school.
right: this morning 已经过去，要用过去式；
hurry 是辅音字母 + y 结尾，改 y 为 i 再加 ed：hurried。

ladder.q: 写出过去式：worry → ____
写出过去式：study → ____，play → ____
改错：Yesterday Lily cryed because she lost her pen.

items.stem: 说说你为什么喜欢春天，选出正确的一句。
options: Because it's warm, so I like spring.
I like spring because is warm.
I like spring because it's warm.
right: because 和 so 只用一个；
because 后面要有主语：because it's warm。
typical: Because it's warm, so I like spring.

ladder.q: 补全：— Why do you like winter? — ____ I like snow.
改错：Because it's hot, so I don't like summer.
用 because 说一句：我最喜欢秋天，因为天气凉爽。
ladder.a: I like autumn best because it's cool.

items.stem: “秋天我常去摘苹果。”哪句对？
options: I often pick apple in autumn.
I often pick apples in autumn.
I'm often pick apples in autumn.
right: 摘的苹果不止一个，用复数 apples；
often 后面直接跟动词：I often pick apples.

ladder.q: 补全：I often plant ____ in spring.（flower）
改错：In winter I'm often make a snowman.
ladder.a: In winter I often make a snowman.

ladder.q: 用英语说：春天我们常去野餐。
ladder.a: We often go on a picnic in spring.

items.stem: In fall, apples fall from the trees. 两个 fall 各是什么意思？
options: 前一个“秋天”，后一个“落下”
right: in fall：在秋天，fall 和 autumn 意思一样；
apples fall：苹果落下，是动作。
typical: 在落下的时候，苹果落下来

ladder.q: I like fall best. 这里的 fall 是什么意思？
In autumn, the leaves fall from the trees. 这里的 fall 呢？
用 fall 的两个意思各说一句英语。
ladder.a: 如：Leaves fall in autumn. / I love fall.

items.unit: Unit 2 You can make a difference
items.stem: Yesterday, Leo ____ his old toy car to a little boy.
right: Yesterday 说明是过去，要用过去式；
give 是不规则动词，过去式是 gave。
typical: Leo gived his old toy car to a little boy.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：give → ____，make → ____
写出过去式：have → ____，sit → ____
改错：Last Sunday we eated lunch at a care home.

items.unit: Unit 2 You can make a difference
items.topic: ar 在 star 里的读音
items.stem: 下面哪个词含有和 star 里 ar 相同的音？
right: star、hard、park 里的 ar 读同一个音，嘴张大、声音拉长；
warm 的 ar 跟在 w 后面，读音不一样。
typical: 见到字母 ar 就选：

ladder.q: 圈出含有 ar 音的词：car, cat, cake
找出 ar 读音不同的词：park, farm, warm
圈出含有 ar 音的词：Mark's car is in the park.

items.unit: Unit 2 You can make a difference
items.stem: Mike 总是帮助别人。“我们应该向 Mike 学习。”英语怎么说？
right: “向某人学习”说 learn from + 人：
We should learn from Mike.

ladder.q: 补全：We can learn ____ our teachers.
翻译：我想向我的姐姐学习。
ladder.a: I want to learn from my sister.

ladder.q: 改错：We all learn to our grandpa. He is very kind.

items.stem: 歌唱比赛在十一月。选出完全正确的一句。
options: The singing contest is in november.
The singing contest is in November.
The singing contest is on November.
right: 月份的首字母大写：November；
只说月份用 in：in November。
typical: The singing contest is in november.

ladder.q: 改正书写：the chinese test is in june.
ladder.a: The Chinese test is in June.

ladder.q: 补全：My birthday is ____ August.
用英语回答：When is Children's Day?
ladder.a: It's in June.（也可以说 It's on June 1st.）

items.stem: — When is the Chinese test? — ____（3 月）
right: 英语每个月都有自己的名字：3 月是 March；
语文考试在 3 月：It's in March.

ladder.q: 补全：Children's Day is in ____ .（6 月）
用英语回答：When is your birthday?（只说月份）

items.topic: sh 和 ch 的拼写
items.stem: 写出“鱼”的英文单词。
right: fish 的结尾是 sh：f-i-sh；
sh 读时嘟嘴、气流长；ch 先堵一下再放开。

ladder.q: 填 ch 或 sh：___eep（绵羊）　lun___（午饭）
填 ch 或 sh：___irt（衬衫）　tea___er（老师）
写出：中国　短裤

items.stem:
— Were there many people at the library yesterday?
— ____
right: Were there …? 问过去“有没有”，
要用 there 和 were 回答：Yes, there were. / No, there weren't.
typical: 问的是过去的事，就用 didn't 回答：

ladder.q: — Was there a park near your home ten years ago? — Yes, ____.
— Did you read a book last night? — No, ____.
用英语问：昨天公园里有很多花吗？
ladder.a: Were there many flowers in the park yesterday?

items.stem: — What will you do on your birthday? — ____
options: I'll playing games with my friends.
I'm play games with my friends.
I'll play games with my friends.
I will to play games with my friends.
right: will 后面跟动词原形：I'll play games.
I'll = I will，说“将要做”的事。
typical: 学过 want to，就加 to：

ladder.q: 补全：I’ll ____ (sing) a song for her.
改错：I will cooking noodles for my grandma.
ladder.a: I will cook noodles for my grandma.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我将给老师画一幅画。
ladder.a: I’ll draw a picture for my teacher.（或 I will …）

items.stem: Lily 这样说，你同意吗？
work: 中秋节有时在九月，有时在十月。
right: 中秋节按农历算（八月十五），每年的公历日期不同，
所以说 usually in September or October。

ladder.q: Spring Festival 每年都在同一天吗？
ladder.a: 不是：按农历算，在 January 或 February

ladder.q: 国庆节每年都在 10 月 1 日吗？
用英语回答：When is Spring Festival?
ladder.a: It's usually in January or February.

items.stem: Art Party｜WHEN: June 6th｜WHERE: Gym｜RSVP: by May 30th　When is the party?
right: WHEN 后面的 June 6th 是聚会的日子；
RSVP: by May 30th 是“5 月 30 日前回复”。

ladder.q: RSVP: by April 20th. 是什么意思？
ladder.a: 4 月 20 日前回复来不来

ladder.q: Sports Meet｜WHEN: Oct. 15th｜RSVP: by Oct. 8th. When is the sports meet?
给你的生日聚会写一行 WHEN 和一行 RSVP。

items.stem:
— What ____ at your school yesterday?
— We had a reading day.
right: yesterday 是过去，happen 要用过去式；
happen 就是“发生”，前面不加 was：What happened …?
typical: What was happened at your school yesterday?

ladder.q: — What ____ (happen) in the park? — A dog jumped into the river.
改错：What was happened to your bike yesterday?
ladder.a: 去掉 was：What happened to your bike yesterday?

ladder.q: 用英语问朋友：昨天你们班发生了什么？
ladder.a: What happened in your class yesterday?

items.topic: 同是 ear 读音不一样
items.stem: 同意这句话吗？
work: bear 和 dear 里都有字母 ear，
所以这两个词里 ear 的读音一样。
right: 不同意：bear 里的 ear 和 chair、pair 里的 air 读音一样；
dear 里的 ear 和 hear、near 里的 ear 读音一样。

ladder.q: 圈出和 chair 里 air 读音相同的词：bear, near
找出读音不同的词：hear, year, wear
按读音分两组（同 hair / 同 ear）：pair, dear, bear, near
ladder.a: 同 hair：pair, bear；同 ear：dear, near

items.topic: turn A into B 的意思
items.stem: The kids turned an old box into a toy house. 意思是……
options: 孩子们把旧盒子变成了玩具屋
孩子们把玩具屋变成了旧盒子
孩子们把旧盒子转了个方向
right: turn A into B = 把 A 变成 B；
into 后面的 a toy house 是变出来的东西。
typical: 孩子们把旧盒子转了个方向

ladder.q: The rain turned into snow. 变成了什么？
用 turn … into 说：我们把这张纸变成了一只小船。
ladder.a: We turned the paper into a little boat.

ladder.q: He turned the story into a play. 先有什么，后有什么？

items.stem: 班级通知：Our class party is ____ June. We will meet ____ 2:30 p.m.
right: 只说到月份用 in：in June.
钟点前用 at：at 2:30 p.m.
typical: 都用 in：in June, in 2:30 p.m.

ladder.q: 补全：I go to bed ____ 9:15 p.m.
补全：My birthday is ____ March.
补全：We go swimming ____ summer, usually ____ 4:00 p.m.

items.stem:
— When ____ your grandpa ____ his first bike?
— In 1985.
right: In 1985 是过去，问句用 did；
did 已经表示过去，后面的动词用原形：When did … buy …?
typical: 过去的事，动词也用过去式：
When did your grandpa bought his first bike?

ladder.q: — What did you ____ (eat) for lunch? — Noodles.
— Where ____ you ____ (find) this old lamp? — In my grandma's house.
就时间提问：People made this pot 2,000 years ago.
ladder.a: When did people make this pot?

items.stem: 一篇日记的开头写着：Thursday, 5 March。这是哪一天？
right: 这种写法先写日、再写月：5 March 是 3 月 5 日；
Thursday 是星期四，Tuesday 才是星期二。
typical: 照汉语先月后日，把前面的 5 当成月份：

ladder.q: Monday, 2 February 是几月几日、星期几？
Saturday, 14 March 是几月几日、星期几？
用英语写日记日期：3 月 21 日，星期二

items.topic: oi 和 oy 怎么写
items.stem: 看词义补全单词：b__（男孩）、v__ce（声音）。依次填……
right: oi、oy 读同一个音。在词尾常写 oy：boy、toy、enjoy；
后面还有字母时常写 oi：voice、choice、point。

ladder.q: 补全：t__（玩具）
补全：ch__ce（选择）、enj__（喜欢）
找出拼错的词并改正：boy, voice, toi, point

items.stem: Tom wants to protect old buildings like his grandpa. 意思是……
options: Tom 喜欢爷爷，也想保护老建筑
Tom 想像爷爷一样保护老建筑
Tom 想让爷爷保护老建筑
right: 这里的 like 不是“喜欢”，是“像……一样”；
like his grandpa = 像他爷爷一样。
typical: 见到 like 就当成“喜欢”：
Tom 喜欢爷爷，也想保护老建筑

ladder.q: She sings like a bird. 这里的 like 是什么意思？
I like my grandpa. 这里的 like 是什么意思？
翻译：我想像我爸爸一样帮助别人。
ladder.a: I want to help others like my dad.

items.unit: Unit 4 When is the art show?
items.stem: — When is the maths test? — It’s ____ June 9th.
right: 具体某一天（几月几号）前用 on：on June 9th；
只说月份才用 in：in June。

ladder.q: 补全：The singing contest is ____ March 2nd.
补全：We have a school trip ____ October.
用英语回答：When is Teachers’ Day?

items.unit: Unit 4 When is the art show?
items.stem: My birthday is on May ____ .（5 月 3 日）
right: 日期用序数词：third，缩写是 3rd；
1st、2nd、3rd 特殊，从 4th 起才是 th。

ladder.q: 写缩写：first ____　second ____
写缩写：fourth ____　fifth ____
用英语回答：When is the school trip?（6 月 2 日）

items.unit: Unit 4 When is the art show?
items.stem: Tom 这样说，你同意吗？
work: this 和 three 都有 th，但读音不一样。
right: three、thin、maths 的 th 读时声带不振动；
this、mother、brother 的 th 读时声带振动。

ladder.q: 把 th 的读音分两组：thin, this, three, that
哪个词的 th 和 mother 一样：maths 还是 brother？
His brother is thirteen. 哪个词的 th 读时声带振动？

items.topic: put 的过去式还是 put
items.stem:
— Who put the flowers here?
— Lily ____ them here this morning.
right: this morning 已经过去，要用过去式；
put 的过去式还是 put，不加 ed，也不加 s。
typical: Lily puted them here this morning.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：put → ____，cut → ____
Last night Mum ____ (put) the milk in the icebox.
改错：Lily puted her coins in a box yesterday.

items.unit: Unit 4 When is the art show?
items.stem: My birthday is on December 12th. 把 12th 写成英文单词。
right: twelve 变序数词：把 ve 换成 f，再加 th：
twelve → twelfth

ladder.q: 写出英文单词：1st ____　2nd ____　3rd ____
写出英文单词：5th ____　9th ____
写出英文单词：12th ____　20th ____

items.unit: Unit 4 When is the art show?
items.stem: — When is your birthday? — ____（8 月 9 日）
right: 问 your，答 my：My birthday is …
具体日子前用 on：on August 9th。

ladder.q: — When is your birthday? — ____ birthday is on June 2nd.
— When is your mother's birthday? — ____ birthday is on May 9th.
替 Amy 回答：When is your birthday?（2 月 14 日）
ladder.a: My birthday is on February 14th.（或 It's on …）

items.unit: Unit 4 When is the art show?
items.stem: 日记上写着 June 26th。怎么读？
right: 日期读序数词：26th = twenty-sixth；
两位数只变最后一个词：twenty 不变，six → sixth。
typical: 两个部分都变成序数词：

ladder.q: 写出读法：April 21st
写出读法：May 23rd
写出读法：March 30th

items.stem: “我们昨天没有找到那只猫。”英语怎么说？
options: We didn't find the cat yesterday.
We didn't found the cat yesterday.
We not found the cat yesterday.
right: 过去“没做”用 didn't + 动词原形；
didn't 已经表示过去，find 不用变：We didn't find the cat.
typical: We not found the cat yesterday.

ladder.q: 改成否定句：I saw the jewels. → I ____ the jewels.
改错：The detective didn't knew the message.
翻译：昨天他没有偷那些珠宝。
ladder.a: He didn't steal the jewels yesterday.

items.topic: talk 里的 l 不发音
items.stem: 全班跟读 talk。哪种说法对？
options: l 要读出来，读成 tal-k
a 读 cat 里的音
right: talk、walk 里的 l 不发音；
这里的 al 和 all、ball 里的 a 读音一样，不读 cat 里的音。
typical: 把 talk 读成 tal-k，l 也读出来

ladder.q: 圈出 l 不发音的词：walk, tall
圈出 l 不发音的词：talk, help, small, half
圈出 l 不发音的词：Let's walk and talk in the small park.

items.stem: Lily 家在学校的北边。用英语怎么说？
options: The school is north of Lily's home.
Lily's home is north of the school.
Lily's home is the school's north.
right: “在 B 的北边”说 north of B；
在北边的是 Lily 家，放句首：Lily's home is north of the school.
typical: 照汉语“学校的北边”逐词说：
Lily's home is the school's north.

ladder.q: The park is north of my home. 谁在北边？
翻译：图书馆在公园的北边。
ladder.a: The library is north of the park.

ladder.q: A is north of B, and B is north of C. 谁在最北边？

items.stem: — Whose ruler is this? — It's ____ .（我的）
right: “我的”后面没有名词时用 mine：It's mine.
也可以说 It's my ruler.，my 后面要跟名词。

ladder.q: 补全：This is my book. It's ____ .
补全：— Is that Amy's pen? — Yes, it's ____ .
用英语回答：Whose pictures are these?（是他们的）

items.stem: — Whose kite is it? — It’s my brother’s. It’s ____ .
right: brother 是男孩，“他的”用 his；
It’s my brother’s. = It’s his.

ladder.q: 补全：It's Chen Jie's ruler. It's ____ .
补全：These are Wu Binbin’s pictures. They’re ____ .
用英语说：那只风筝是我妹妹的，是她的。
ladder.a: That kite is my sister's. It's hers.

items.stem: 哪个词结尾的读音和 long 的结尾一样？
right: long、sing 都以 ng 结尾：舌根抬起，鼻子出声；
think 后面还有 k，thin 的 n 是舌尖音。

ladder.q: 把词分两组：sing, pink, ring, ink
填 ng 或 nk：thi___（想）　thi___（东西）
写出：一枚粉色的戒指

items.topic: 过去和现在的 be 不同
items.stem: Long ago, there ____ no buses in our town. Now there ____ lots of buses.
right: Long ago 说过去，用 were；
Now 说现在，用 are：两句时间不同，be 也不同。
typical: 前一句用了 were，后一句也跟着用 were：
Now there were lots of buses.

ladder.q: Thirty years ago, my grandpa ____ a boy.
Now he ____ a teacher.
改错：Ten years ago, my school has one building. Now it had three.

items.stem: 小狗 Fido 是公的，用 he 称它：I often go for a walk with ____ .
right: with 后面用 him：go for a walk with him；
he 用来说谁在做事：He’s eating.
typical: I often go for a walk with he.

ladder.q: 补全：I like Mike. I often play with ____ .
补全：This is Amy. Can you help ____ ?
用英语说：我能给他一些水吗？
ladder.a: Can I give him some water?

items.stem: My little brother is ____ in the playground.（run）写出正确形式。
right: run 是“辅音 + 一个元音 + 辅音”的短词，
先双写 n 再加 -ing：running。

ladder.q: 写 -ing 形式：swim ____　sit ____
写 -ing 形式：jump ____　sleep ____
补全：The rabbits are ____ (run). The cat is ____ (climb).

items.stem: Amy 在草地上说：I’m jumping like a rabbit. 意思是：
options: Amy 喜欢跳，也喜欢兔子。
right: 这里的 like 是“像……一样”，不是“喜欢”；
I’m jumping：跳的是 Amy 自己。
typical: Amy 喜欢跳，也喜欢兔子。

ladder.q: I’m sleeping like a cat. 谁在睡？
I’m singing like a bird. 是什么意思？
用英语说：我像熊猫一样吃东西。

items.stem: The village changed a lot ____ the new road.
right: the new road 是一个名词短语，不是一句话；
名词短语前用 because of：because of the new road。
typical: The village changed a lot because the new road.

ladder.q: We stayed at home ____ the rain.
We stayed at home ____ it rained.
用 because 合并：The streets are clean now. People pick up rubbish.
ladder.a: The streets are clean now because people pick up rubbish.

items.topic: ou 和 ow 可以同音
items.stem: 同意这句话吗？
work: out 里的 ou 和 now 里的 ow 写法不同，
但读音一样。
right: 同意：ou 和 ow 常读同一个音，
如 out、house、mountain 和 now、town、down。

ladder.q: 圈出和 cow 里 ow 读音相同的词：house, snow
找出读音不同的词：brown, mouth, grow
补全（ou 或 ow）：t__n（城镇）、cl__d（云）

items.lesson: Unit 6_Fuel up_3 Listen and write “√” or “×”
items.stem: “这顶帽子是纸做的。”英语怎么说？
options: This hat is made of paper.
This hat is make of paper.
right: “是……做的”说 be made of；
is 不能漏，make 要用 made：This hat is made of paper.

ladder.q: 补全：The box is made ____ paper.
翻译：这把梯子是钢做的。
ladder.a: This ladder is made of steel.

ladder.q: 用英语问：这个风筝是用什么做的？
ladder.a: What is this kite made of?

items.stem: Look! The children ____ lunch now.
right: “正在做”= am / is / are + 动词 -ing；
children 是复数，用 are：are eating。

ladder.q: 补全：Listen! Amy ____ (sing).
补全：— What are they doing? — They ____ (read) books.
用英语说：我们正在看书。
ladder.a: We're reading books.（或 We are reading books.）

items.stem: Sarah 这样写，你同意吗？
work: Look! The cat is washing it's face.
right: “它的脸”用 its：washing its face。
it's 是 it is，washing it is face 说不通。

ladder.q: 填 its 或 it's：The dog is sleeping in ____ house.
填 its 或 it's：____ time for lunch.
填 its 或 it's：Look at the dog! ____ playing with ____ ball.

items.stem: 写出“什么时候”这个英文疑问词。
right: when 以 wh 开头：w-h-e-n；
what、where、when、whose 都是 wh 开头的疑问词。
typical: 听到 w 的音就只写 w：

ladder.q: 补全：___ere（哪里）　___at（什么）
写出：谁的
用 when 问一句，再回答。
ladder.a: 如：When is your birthday? It's on May 2nd.

items.stem: 宝宝在睡觉，提醒客人说话小声点：
right: 提醒别人做什么，用动词原形开头：Talk quietly.
说话的样子用 quietly；要说“人要安静”才用 quiet：Be quiet!
typical: 见过 No eating! 的牌子，也加 -ing：

ladder.q: 补全：Shh! Work ____ , please.（quiet）
补全：Be ____ , please! The film is starting.（quiet）
用 Please 开头说：请在教室里安静地读书。
ladder.a: Please read quietly in the classroom.

items.stem: 楼梯口的牌子：Keep to the right. 意思是：
right: right 在这里是“右边”；
keep to the right：一直靠右边走，不是拐弯。

ladder.q: That's right! 这里的 right 是什么意思？
Raise your right hand. 这里的 right 是什么意思？
上下楼梯时，该提醒同学说哪句英语？

items.stem: — Are you reading a book? — ____
right: Are you …? 用 am 回答：Yes, I am.
简略回答句末不能缩写成 I'm。
typical: I am 可以缩成 I'm：

ladder.q: — Are you watching TV? — No, ____ .
— Is your brother doing his homework? — Yes, ____ .
— Are the children playing football? — Yes, ____ .

items.stem: Chen Jie 牵着一只小狗。— Whose dog is that? — It's ____ . Look! It ____ water.
right: “她的”后面不再跟名词，要用 hers：It's hers.
Look! 说正在做：It is drinking water.

ladder.q: 补全：This is Amy's kite. It's ____ .
补全（她的）：The red bike is ____ bike. It's ____ .
用英语说：这是 Mike 的帽子，是他的。看！他正在吃苹果。
ladder.a: This is Mike's hat. It's his. Look! He's eating an apple.

lessons: What famous places do you know
items.stem: — How was your holiday? — ____
options: Yes, it was. I climbed a hill.
It is great! I climb a hill.
It was great! I climbed a hill.
It was great! I was climb a hill.
right: How was ...? 问过得怎么样，先说感受：It was great!
说假期里做的事，动词用过去式：I climbed a hill.
typical: 问句里有 was，就先答 Yes：
Yes, it was. I climbed a hill.

ladder.q: — How was your trip? — ____（很棒）
补全：I ____ (visit) my grandma last Saturday.
用英语问朋友周末过得怎样，再替他答：很好，我踢了足球。
ladder.a: How was your weekend? It was good. I played football.

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.stem: At the school market, Tom gives his old toys to other kids and gets 20 yuan. Tom ____ his old toys.
right: Tom 把玩具给了别人，自己拿到了 20 元，
拿东西换钱是 sell：Tom sells his old toys.
typical: 玩具给了别的小朋友，就是分享：

ladder.q: Mum pays 10 yuan and gets some pears. Mum ____ pears. (buys / sells)
Lily puts 5 yuan in her money box every week. She ____ her money. (saves / spends)
用 share 写一句话：把你的蛋糕分给朋友们。
ladder.a: I share my cake with my friends.

lessons: What famous places do you know
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Tom ____ (walk) around the lake last Sunday.
right: last Sunday 说的是过去的事，
walk 加 ed：Tom walked around the lake.
typical: Tom 是一个人，动词加 s：

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：We ____ (watch) a show yesterday.
用括号里的词填空：My cousins ____ (climb) Mount Taishan last summer.
用英语说：上个暑假我们参观了一座博物馆。
ladder.a: We visited a museum last summer.

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：My sister is ten. She always ____ (save) her pocket money in a box.
right: 主语 she 是一个人，说她平时的习惯，
动词加 s：She always saves her pocket money.
typical: She always save her pocket money.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：Ben always ____ (spend) all his money.
用括号里的词填空：My dad ____ (get) up early every day.
用英语说：我的朋友总是把钱存起来。
ladder.a: My friend always saves his / her money.

items.topic: Where did you go 怎么答
items.stem: — Where did you go last weekend? — ____
options: We had some delicious hotpot there.
I went to Hangzhou with my aunt.
I go to Hangzhou with my aunt.
Yes, I did. I went to Hangzhou.
right: Where 问去了哪里，先答地点；
说过去的事用 went：I went to Hangzhou.
typical: 听到 did you，就先答 Yes：
Yes, I did. I went to Hangzhou.

ladder.q: — Where did you go yesterday? — ____（去了公园）
— What did you do there? — ____（我们看了一场表演）
用英语问朋友：去年冬天去了哪里？在那儿做了什么？
ladder.a: Where did you go last winter? What did you do there?

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.stem: 在文具店问价钱：— ____ these crayons? — ____ 12 yuan.
right: these crayons 是复数：How much are these crayons?
回答也用复数：They're 12 yuan.
typical: How much is 说得最熟，没看 crayons 是复数：
How much is these crayons? It's 12 yuan.

ladder.q: — How much ____ the kite? — It's 18 yuan. (is / are)
— How much are the socks? — ____ 9 yuan.
用英语问这双鞋多少钱，再回答：80 元。
ladder.a: How much are the shoes? They're 80 yuan.

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：We ____ (see) the old city wall in Xi'an last summer.
right: last summer 是过去；see 是不规则动词，
过去式是 saw：We saw the old city wall.
typical: 过去式就在后面加 ed：
We seed the old city wall.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：eat → ____，go → ____
用括号里的词填空：I ____ (take) a trip to Wuhan last May.
用英语说：我们吃了热干面，还拍了很多照片。
ladder.a: We ate hot dry noodles and took many photos.

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.stem: 讲故事：Many years ago, there ____ an old tree near the river.
right: Many years ago 说的是过去，an old tree 是一棵，
所以用 was：there was an old tree.
typical: Many years ago, there had an old tree.

ladder.q: 填 was 或 were：Yesterday there ____ a big cake on the table.
填 was 或 were：Last year, there ____ two cats in my garden.
用英语说：从前有一个聪明的小女孩。
ladder.a: Long ago, there was a clever little girl.

items.stem: 补全旅行点评的最后一句：The science centre was so much fun! You should ____ it!
right: 点评里讲经历用过去式，最后推荐别人去用 should；
should 后面跟动词原形：You should visit it!
typical: 前面写的都是过去的事，这里也用过去式：

ladder.q: 补全：You should ____ (try) the noodles there!
补全：I ____ (walk) around the museum. You should ____ (go) there!
为你去过的一个地方写点评的开头句和结尾句。
ladder.a: 如：My trip to Xi'an was great! You should go there!

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.topic: cl 和 cr 的读音
items.stem: 哪个词开头也是 cr 的读音（和 cream 一样）？
right: cream 和 cry 都以 cr 开头，读 /kr/；
clean 开头是 /kl/，car 开头只有 /k/。
typical: clean 和 cream 都是 c 加一个舌头音，

ladder.q: 读一读，说出开头是 cl 还是 cr：clock，cry
找出开头读音不同的词：clever，clothes，crayon
按开头分两组：clothes，cream，clever，cry

items.lesson: C Project: Make a holiday scrapbook
items.stem: 给旅行剪贴簿配文字。用括号里的词填空：Last summer, my family went to Qingdao and ____ (eat) fresh fish.
right: 去青岛、吃鱼都是去年夏天的事，两个动词都用过去式；
eat 的过去式是 ate：went to Qingdao and ate fresh fish.
typical: 前面 went 已经变了，and 后面不用再变：
went to Qingdao and eat fresh fish

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：I visited my grandma and ____ (watch) TV with her.
用括号里的词填空：They climbed the mountain and ____ (see) the sunrise.
用 and 连起两件事，为剪贴簿写一句：你去了哪里、做了什么。
ladder.a: 如：I went to Xi'an and ate some noodles.

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
lessons: Make a plan for your money
items.stem: Mia 有 100 元，打算拿 45 元买一个足球。她向同桌介绍自己的计划，哪一句说对了？
options: I will spend 45 yuan on a football.
I will to spend 45 yuan on a football.
I will spend 45 yuan buy a football.
right: 说计划用 will + 动词原形：I will spend…；
把钱花在什么上：spend + 钱 + on + 东西。
typical: 照“拿 45 元买足球”逐字说：
I will spend 45 yuan buy a football.

ladder.q: 用 save 说计划：我会存 30 元。
填空：I will spend 15 yuan ____ a kite. (on / buy)
你有 50 元，用 spend 和 save 各说一句计划。
ladder.a: 如 I will spend 20 yuan on food. I will save 30 yuan.

items.stem: Read: My uncle took me to Mount Huangshan. We watched the sunrise! (Lily, a student from Hefei) 这篇点评是谁写的？
right: 点评末尾括号里写的就是作者：Lily，合肥的学生；
文中的 me、we 说的也是 Lily 自己。
typical: 第一句就是 My uncle，点评是叔叔写的：

ladder.q: (Tom, bus driver) 括号里告诉了我们作者的哪两样信息？
ladder.a: 名字 Tom，职业 bus driver

ladder.q: Read: My dad and I went to Mount Tai. (Ben, student) 谁写的？I 指谁？
照 Reading time 的样子，给你的旅行点评写个署名。

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.stem: Kate always ____ her pocket money. Now she wants two kites. She asks, “How much ____ they?”
right: Kate 是一个人，说她平时的习惯：Kate always saves…；
two kites 是复数：How much are they?
typical: How much is 说得最顺口，没看 two kites：

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：Mike always ____ (spend) his money on toys.
— How much ____ the shoes? — They're 90 yuan.
用英语写两句：Lucy 总是存钱；她问那两本书多少钱。
ladder.a: Lucy always saves her money. How much are the two books?

items.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money?
items.stem: Jack lives in the UK. He has 2 pounds in his pocket. 2 pounds = ____
right: 英国的钱是 pounds 和 pence，1 pound = 100 pence，
所以 2 pounds = 200 pence。cents 是美国的钱。

ladder.q: How many cents are there in one dollar?
Lucy has 3 pounds. How many pence is that?
Tom has 1 dollar. Amy has 90 cents. Who has more money?

lessons: How can festivals bring us together
items.stem: — Did you and your cousins eat jiaozi at the Spring Festival? — ____
right: Did 开头的问句，用 did 回答；
问的是 you and your cousins（你们），答的人说 we：Yes, we did.
typical: Do you ...? 用 do 答，这里也一样：

ladder.q: — Did you clean the house? — No, ____ .
— Did your sister paste fu on the door? — Yes, ____ .
用英语问同学：儿童节你去公园了吗？再替他否定回答。
ladder.a: Did you go to the park on Children's Day? No, I didn't.

items.stem: 这句话是 fact（事实）还是 opinion（观点）？同意 Lily 的判断吗？
work: Our school has 1,200 students!
Lily：这句是 fact。
right: 学生人数可以数出来、查得到，谁说都一样，是 fact；
感叹号只表示语气激动，不改变它是事实。

ladder.q: fact 还是 opinion：A week has seven days.
fact 还是 opinion：Maths is very interesting.
关于你的书包，写一句 fact 和一句 opinion。
ladder.a: 如 My bag is blue. / My bag is nice.

lessons: How can festivals bring us together
items.topic: 用 Did 问过去的事
items.stem: 国庆节过后，问朋友：你去看望爷爷奶奶了吗？
right: 问过去做没做某事：Did + 主语 + 动词原形？
Did you visit your grandparents?
typical: 说过去的事，动词要用过去式：

ladder.q: 补全：____ you watch the Spring Festival Gala?
变成问句：They watched the fireworks.
用英语问朋友：中秋节你们赏月了吗？
ladder.a: Did you watch the moon at the festival?

items.stem: It's raining. Amy says, “Why not take a bus?” Amy 的意思是：
options: 问别人不坐公交车的原因
right: “Why not + 动词原形……?” 是在提建议，
意思是“何不……呢”：坐公交车去吧。
typical: Why 是“为什么”，所以 Amy 在问：

ladder.q: Why not ask your teacher? 是提建议还是问原因？
用 Why not 建议朋友一起去公园。
ladder.a: Why not go to the park together?

ladder.q: 朋友说 I'm tired. 用 Why not 给他提个建议。
ladder.a: 如 Why not go to bed early?

lessons: How can big events bring us together
items.stem: — How was the sports meet? — It was great. — What did you like about it? — ____
options: Yes, I did. I liked it a lot.
It was fun. I was very happy.
right: What did you like about it? 问喜欢它的哪一点，
说出具体的事：I liked watching the races.

ladder.q: 补全：I liked ____ (sing) with my friends.
— What did you like about the book fair? — ____（喜欢听作家讲故事）
ladder.a: I liked listening to the writer's stories.

ladder.q: 用英语说说你参加过的一次活动：怎么样？喜欢哪一点？
ladder.a: 如：It was great. I liked playing games.

items.stem: 用 interesting 的正确形式填空：In my opinion, stories are ____ than songs.
right: 有 than 要用比较级；interesting 是长词，
前面加 more：more interesting。
typical: 比较级就在词尾加 er：

ladder.q: 写出比较级：fast → ____，beautiful → ____
用括号里的词填空：Walking is ____ (easy) than running.
用 better 写一句你的观点，比较两种水果。
ladder.a: 如 I think pears are better than apples.

lessons: How can big events bring us together
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Last Friday, our class ____ (sing) a song for the teachers.
right: Last Friday 说的是过去的事；
sing 是不规则动词，过去式是 sang。
typical: 过去式就在后面加 ed：
Our class singed a song for the teachers.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：run → ____，make → ____
用括号里的词填空：Last Saturday, Amy ____ (wear) a red dress.
用英语说：昨天老师给我们读了一个故事。
ladder.a: Our teacher read a story to us yesterday.

items.stem: Dear Mia, Can I use your green crayon? Tom has my crayons now. Your friend, Leo  这封信是谁写的？
right: 信开头 Dear 后面是收信人 Mia；
结尾 Your friend 下面的 Leo 才是写信人。

ladder.q: Dear Sam, … Your friend, Kate  这封信写给谁？
Hi Ben, … Love, Grandma  这封信是谁写的？
给同桌写一张便条：写出开头和结尾。
ladder.a: 如 Dear Lily, … Your friend, Wang Hao

lessons: How can big events bring us together
items.stem: Tom 读自己写的日记，这样判断。同意吗？
work: Our sports meet began at 8 o'clock!
有感叹号，所以这句是 Opinion。
right: 运动会八点开始，这件事能查证，是 Fact；
Opinion 是个人的看法，如 Races are so exciting!

ladder.q: Fact 还是 Opinion？Amy ran in the race.
Fact 还是 Opinion？Dragon boat races are the most fun!
写一句关于运动会的 Fact，再写一句 Opinion。
ladder.a: 如：We ran a race. It was great fun!

items.topic: dr 和 tr 的读音
items.stem: 同意 Tom 的说法吗？
work: Tom：tree 和 drink 开头的读音一样，
因为 t 和 d 读起来差不多。
right: tree 开头是 /tr/，drink 开头是 /dr/，读音不同；
读 d 时喉咙振动，读 t 时不振动。

ladder.q: dr 还是 tr：dream，train
找出开头读音不同的词：drum，draw，try
按开头分两组：drive，trip，drink，tree

items.stem: 辩题 Should students read every day? 你方观点 Yes，理由是 Reading helps us learn new words. 哪一句能作这个理由的例子？
options: I learnt 20 new words from two books.
We think students should read every day.
Some of my friends don't like reading at all.
right: 例子是一件具体的事，要能证明理由：
读两本书学会 20 个新词，正好证明“读书帮我们学新词”。
typical: 选了 We think students should read every day.
这是把观点又说了一遍，不是例子。

ladder.q: 理由：Sport makes us strong. 哪句是例子？a) I run every day and now I'm strong. b) We should do sport.
理由：Pets make people happy. 给它写一个例子。
ladder.a: 如 My cat plays with me and I feel happy.

ladder.q: 辩题 Should we walk to school? 选一方，写一个理由和一个例子。
ladder.a: 如 Yes. Walking is good for us. I walk to school and I feel great.

items.stem: 按年兽（Nian）的故事，人们过年为什么在门上贴红色的福字和春联？
options: Red paper makes the doors pretty.
right: 老人在门窗上贴红纸，年兽说 I hate the colour red!
故事说从那以后人们过年贴福字、春联，用的就是这红色。
typical: 年兽最后是被鞭炮吓跑的，就选怕响声：

ladder.q: 过年放烟花爆竹，对应年兽怕的哪样东西？
把窗户照得亮亮的，对应年兽怕的哪样东西？
用英语说说你家过春节时做的一件事。
ladder.a: 如：We eat dumplings with our grandparents.

items.stem: 哪一句是 opinion（观点）？
options: Science is more interesting than maths.
Tom is taller than his brother.
right: “更有趣”是个人感受，有人同意有人不同意，是 opinion；
谁更高、有几间教室，量一量、数一数就能核对，是 fact。
typical: 看到 taller than 在比较，就当成观点：
Tom is taller than his brother.

ladder.q: fact 还是 opinion：My ruler is longer than yours.
fact 还是 opinion：Cats are better than dogs.
用 more beautiful 写一句 opinion。
ladder.a: 如 Spring is more beautiful than winter.

items.lesson: C Project: Present photos from school events
items.stem: 展示上周运动会的照片：Look! These are photos from our sports meet last week. We ____ in three races.
right: 赛跑是上周（last week）的事，动词用过去式；
run 是不规则动词，过去式是 ran：We ran in three races.
typical: 照片就在眼前，动词不用变：

ladder.q: 补全：This is a photo from New Year's Day. We ____ (sing) songs.
补全：Look! These are our kites. We ____ (make) them last week.
用两句英语介绍一张学校活动的照片：这是什么照片，你们做了什么。
ladder.a: 如：This is a photo from our music day. We sang and danced.

items.stem: In Model UN, Li Ming speaks for Japan. 这句话说的是 Li Ming 要做什么？
options: 向大家介绍日本的名胜和美食
站在日本的立场，就世界问题发表意见
right: speak for a country 是“代表一个国家发言”：
Li Ming 要说出日本对世界问题的看法。
typical: 看到 speak 和 Japan，就以为是说日语：
Li Ming 全程用日语发言。

ladder.q: In Model UN, Tom speaks for the USA. 他代表哪个国家发言？
用英语说：在模拟联合国里，我代表中国发言。
ladder.a: In Model UN, I speak for China.

ladder.q: 在 Model UN 里你想谈什么世界问题？用 I want to talk about… 写一句。
ladder.a: 如 I want to talk about saving animals.

lessons: How do we know we are ill
items.stem: Tom has a runny nose. He should ____ some warm water.
right: should 后面直接跟动词原形，
主语是谁都不变：He should drink some warm water.
typical: 主语是 he，动词加 s：
He should drinks some warm water.

ladder.q: 补全：You should ____ (wear) warm clothes.
补全：She is angry. She should ____ (take) a deep breath.
朋友为考试担心，用 should 给他一个建议。
ladder.a: 如：You should ask your teacher for help.

items.stem: This place has lots of sand. It is very hot, and it doesn't often rain. There is no sea or lake. What is it?
right: 沙子多、很热、很少下雨，又没有海和湖：
这是沙漠 a desert。
typical: 看到 sand 就想到海边的沙滩：

ladder.q: It is a big place with lots of grass. 是哪个词？
There are lots of tall trees here. Many animals live in it. 是哪个词？
用两句英语描述 a beach。
ladder.a: 如 It is next to the sea. It has lots of sand.

lessons: How do we know we are ill
items.stem: 用英语说：Lily 发烧了。
right: 说得了什么病用 have / has；
Lily 是一个人，用 has：Lily has a fever.

ladder.q: 补全：I ____ a bad cold.
补全：My sister ____ a cough.
用英语说：我弟弟咳嗽，还发烧。
ladder.a: My brother has a cough and a fever.

items.stem: 用英语说：这条河大约有 900 千米长。
options: The river has about 900 kilometres long.
The river is about 900 kilometres long.
The river is long about 900 kilometres.
right: 说长度：be + 数字 + 单位 + long，
The river is about 900 kilometres long.
typical: 照“长约 900 千米”的顺序说：
The river is long about 900 kilometres.

ladder.q: 用英语说：这座桥长 50 米。
用英语说：那座山高约 1,000 米。
ladder.a: That mountain is about 1,000 metres high.

ladder.q: 用英语问：这条河有多长？再按 300 千米回答。
ladder.a: How long is the river? It's 300 kilometres long.

items.stem: 补全：We need ____ enough water every day.
right: need 后面跟动作要加 to，
to 后面用动词原形：We need to drink enough water.
typical: 和 We should drink 一样：

ladder.q: 补全：We should ____ (sleep) well.
补全：You need ____ (eat) healthy food.
用 need to 给爱熬夜的朋友一个建议。
ladder.a: 如：You need to go to bed early.

items.stem: Tom 这样说，你同意吗？
work: Health is only about our body.
Feeling happy is not part of it.
right: 健康不只是身体不生病，也包括心情好；
心情不好时，可以找家人朋友说一说，做做运动。

ladder.q: 哪件事让心情变好？A. watch TV all night  B. talk to your friends
朋友说 I feel sad. 用英语给他一个建议。
ladder.a: 如：You can talk to your family.

ladder.q: 用两句英语说怎样过健康的生活：一句关于身体，一句关于心情。
ladder.a: 如：I run every morning. I talk to my friends.

items.stem: 用 old 的正确形式填空：This tree is 500 years old. It is the ____ tree in our town.
right: 和镇上所有的树比，是“最”老，用最高级；
old 是短词，加 est：the oldest tree。
typical: 比别的树老，就用比较级：
It is the older tree in our town.

ladder.q: 写出最高级：tall → ____，big → ____
用括号里的词填空：Tom is the ____ (fast) runner in our class.
用英语说：这是我们城市最高的楼。
ladder.a: This is the tallest building in our city.

items.stem: Miss White 说：Don't stay up late. 意思是：
right: stay up late 是熬夜：晚上很晚还不睡；
Don't stay up late. 就是“别熬夜”。
typical: up 和 get up 里的一样，是起床：

ladder.q: 选一选：I often stay up late. 意思是 A 我常熬夜 B 我常晚起
用英语说：不要熬夜。
用英语给爱熬夜的朋友两条建议。
ladder.a: 如：Don't stay up late. Exercise often.

items.stem: 用英语说：我哥哥对地图感兴趣。
options: My brother is interested in maps.
My brother is interesting in maps.
right: 说人“感兴趣”用 interested，前面要有 be：
My brother is interested in maps.
typical: My brother is interesting in maps.

ladder.q: 填 interested 或 interesting：This story is very ____.
用括号里的词填空：Lucy ____ (be) interested in music.
用英语说：我妹妹对恐龙感兴趣。
ladder.a: My sister is interested in dinosaurs.

items.stem: I didn't win the race today. I'm feeling down. 这里的 feeling down 是什么意思？
right: 比赛没赢，心里难过：feeling down 是心情低落；
也可以说 I'm sad. / I feel unhappy.
typical: 这个单元说的都是生病：
feeling down 就是身体不舒服。

ladder.q: 选一选：I'm feeling down. 意思是 A 我很难过 B 我发烧了
朋友说 I'm feeling down. 用英语问他怎么了。
用 should 和 can 各写一句，给心情低落的同学建议。
ladder.a: 如：You should talk to your family. You can join a club.

items.topic: bl 和 br 的读音
items.stem: 哪一组的两个词开头都是 br 的读音，或都是 bl 的读音？
right: brother 和 bring 都以 br 开头，读 /br/；
brown 是 /br/、black 是 /bl/；bed 开头只有 /b/。
typical: brown 和 black 都是 b 加一个舌头音，

ladder.q: bl 还是 br：black，brush
找出开头读音不同的词：brother，brown，blackboard
用 bl、br 开头的词各写一个，并读出来。

items.stem: 为家乡做旅游海报：Stone Bridge is one of ____ in our town.
right: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，old 是短词，最高级是 oldest：
Stone Bridge is one of the oldest bridges in our town.
typical: 说的只是一座桥，就用了单数：

ladder.q: 选词填空：It is one of the tallest ____ in our park. (tree / trees)
用括号里的词填空：West Hill is one of the ____ (high) hills here.
仿写一句介绍你喜欢的地方：… is one of the most … in …
ladder.a: 如 Moon Lake is one of the most beautiful lakes in our town.

items.stem: 读完 Right Hand 和 Left Hand 的故事，Tom 这样说。你同意吗？
work: Making things with our hands can make us happy.
That's good for our health, too.
right: 故事里主人不开心，双手帮他做手工，他又开心了；
故事说开心对健康很重要，所以这也有益健康。

ladder.q: 故事里，双手帮主人做了哪件让他开心的事？
同意吗？Talking with friends is good for our health.
用英语说一件你用双手做、能让自己开心的事。
ladder.a: 如：I draw pictures. It makes me happy.

items.stem: — ____ is Moon Mountain? — It's about 2,000 metres high.
right: 答句说的是 2,000 metres high，问的是山有多高：
How high is Moon Mountain? 问河有多长才用 How long。
typical: 看到 metres，就用 How long：

ladder.q: — ____ is the river? — It's about 500 kilometres long.
— How high is the hill? — It's about 300 metres ____.
就 Blue Lake 问一个问题并回答：湖深约 50 米。
ladder.a: How deep is Blue Lake? It's about 50 metres deep.

items.stem: 读公园介绍，填表中的 What is it famous for? 同意 Tom 的填法吗？
work: Moon Park has lakes, hills and forests.
Every autumn, people come to see its red leaves.
Tom：It is famous for its lakes, hills and forests.
right: lakes, hills and forests 是公园里有的自然景观；
人们每年秋天专门来看红叶：It is famous for its red leaves.

ladder.q: Star Lake is famous for its blue water. 它以什么出名？
Sun Park has rivers. Every spring, people come to see its flowers. 它以什么出名？
用 famous for 介绍你家乡的一个地方。
ladder.a: 如 Our town is famous for its old bridge.

items.lesson: C Project: Make a healthy lifestyle guide
items.stem: 健康生活指南写“不要看太久电视”。选出正确的一句。
options: Don't watch TV for too long.
Not watch TV for too long.
Don't watching TV for too long.
right: 叫人不要做某事，用 Don't + 动词原形开头：
Don't watch TV for too long.
typical: 汉语“不要”放在动词前，就写 not：
Not watch TV for too long.

ladder.q: 改成“不要……”：Eat too much candy.
改错：Not play computer games late at night.
ladder.a: Don't play computer games late at night.

ladder.q: 为健康生活指南写两条：一条“要……”，一条“不要……”。
ladder.a: 如：Exercise every day. Don't go to bed late.

items.stem: 补全：I ____ a football with my pocket money.（打算买）
right: 打算做某事：am / is / are + going to + 动词原形。
I am going to buy a football.
typical: I going to buy a football.

ladder.q: 补全：We ____ going to buy some fruit.
补全：He is going to ____ (play) football this afternoon.
— What are you going to do this weekend? — 去买几本书。
ladder.a: I'm going to buy some books.

items.stem: Lily makes a robot. It can clean the floor for her grandma. Lily is a little ____.
right: 空里说的是 Lily 这个人：发明的人是 inventor；
invention 是发明出来的东西，invent 是动词。
typical: 机器人是发明，Lily 就是 invention：

ladder.q: 填 inventor 或 invention：The robot is a great ____.
用英语说：她想成为一名发明家。
ladder.a: She wants to be an inventor.

ladder.q: 用 invention 写一句话，说说你喜欢的发明。
ladder.a: 如 The phone is a great invention.

items.stem: Lily 这样说，你同意吗？
work: I pay 30 yuan for a haircut.
That's a service, not goods.
right: 理发是别人为你做的事，是 service；
书包、食物这些买回家的东西才是 goods。

ladder.q: goods 还是 service？a home delivery
goods 还是 service？a pair of sunglasses
用英语各说一句：你用钱买的一样 goods、付钱的一项 service。
ladder.a: 如：I buy books. I pay for haircuts.

items.stem: — What are you doing, Jack? — I ____ a paper boat for my little sister.
right: 问的是“现在正在做什么”，用现在进行时：
am + making：I am making a paper boat.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：Look! Tom is ____ (draw) a bird.
用括号里的词填空：— What are they doing? — They ____ (water) the flowers.
用英语问妈妈在做什么，再替她答：在做蛋糕。
ladder.a: What are you doing, Mum? I'm making a cake.

lessons: How can we use money wisely
items.stem: — How much is the bike? — It's ____ yuan.（246）
right: 246 说成 two hundred and forty-six：
hundred 前有 two 也不加 s，forty 里没有 u。
typical: two 是两个，后面加 s：

ladder.q: 用英语写出数字：300
用英语写出数字：158
用英语说：这个书包一百四十元。
ladder.a: The schoolbag is one hundred and forty yuan.

items.stem: 做贺卡：First, cut a piece of paper. Next, ____ a flower on it. Then, write “Happy birthday”.
right: 说步骤用祈使句，动词放在句首、用原形：
Next, draw a flower on it.
typical: 手工正在一步步做，就用 -ing：
Next, drawing a flower on it.

ladder.q: 改成说步骤的样子：washes your hands → ____
用 First、Next 写两步：洗苹果，切苹果。
ladder.a: First, wash the apples. Next, cut them.

ladder.q: 用 First、Next、Then、Last 写出做三明治的四步。
ladder.a: 如 First, put some bread on a plate. …

lessons: How can we use money wisely
items.stem: 补全：Amy ____ a new bike. She is going to save up for it.（想买）
right: 主语 Amy 是一个人，want 加 s；
want 后面跟动作要加 to，to 后用原形：wants to buy。
typical: Amy 是三单，两个动词都加 s：
Amy wants to buys a new bike.

ladder.q: 补全：Tom ____ (want) to buy a kite.
补全：He wants to ____ (save) up for a football.
用英语说：我妹妹想买一本关于太空的书。
ladder.a: My sister wants to buy a book about space.

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Last Sunday, Grandpa ____ (cut) some bamboo to make a kite.
right: Last Sunday 说的是过去；cut 的过去式不变，
还是 cut：Grandpa cut some bamboo.
typical: 过去式就在词尾加 ed：

ladder.q: 写出过去式：put → ____，see → ____
用括号里的词填空：Yesterday I ____ (put) my book on the desk.
用英语说：上周我们做了一把扇子。
ladder.a: We made a fan last week.

lessons: How can we use money wisely
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Lucy ____ (buy) a comic book every Sunday.
right: every Sunday 说的是常做的事，用一般现在时；
主语 Lucy 是一个人，动词加 s：buys。
typical: 前面一直在说过去的事：
Lucy bought a comic book every Sunday.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：He ____ (save) money every week.
用括号里的词填空：Tom ____ (walk) to the shop every Saturday.
填空：Last Sunday she ____ (buy) a book. Every Sunday she ____ (save) ten yuan.

lessons: How can we use money wisely
items.stem: 问 Lucy 的妈妈：她每周都存钱吗？选出正确的问句。
options: Do she save money every week?
Does she save money every week?
Does she saves money every week?
Is she save money every week?
right: 主语是 she，问句用 Does 开头；
有了 does，动词用原形：Does she save ...?
typical: she 后面的动词要加 s：
Does she saves money every week?

ladder.q: 补全：— Does he write a spending plan? — Yes, ____ .
变成问句：She buys books with her pocket money.
ladder.a: Does she buy books with her pocket money?

ladder.q: 变成否定句：Tom waits for a sale.
ladder.a: Tom doesn't wait for a sale.

items.topic: fr 和 fl 的拼写
items.stem: 用 fr 或 fl 补全单词：My best ___iend lives next to me.
right: friend 开头读 /fr/，拼作 fr：
My best friend lives next to me.
typical: fr 和 fl 读起来差不多，

ladder.q: fr 还是 fl：___uit（水果）
fr 还是 fl：Look at the red ___owers!
按开头分两组：Friday，flower，fruit，flag

items.stem: Problem: The school bags are too heavy for little kids. 哪个发明能解决这个问题？
options: A bag with many colours. It looks nice.
A bigger bag. You can put more books in it.
A bag with wheels. It moves easily.
right: 难处是书包太重、小朋友背不动；
装上轮子拉着走，就不用背着：A bag with wheels.
typical: 只看到“书包”，就想把书包做得更大：
A bigger bag. You can put more books in it.

ladder.q: Grandpa can't read small words. 哪个有用：a phone with big words 还是 a phone with many colours？
Problem: Our classroom floor is often dirty. 用 It can… 说一个发明的用处。
ladder.a: 如 It can clean the floor fast.

ladder.q: 说一个身边的问题，再用 This is our… It can… 介绍你们的发明。
ladder.a: 如 This is our light pen. It can help us write at night.

items.stem: 读 Reading time：后来人们为什么用起了纸币？
options: 纸币比金属钱币更值钱。
金属钱币太重，带着不方便。
那时候还没有金属钱币。
right: 短文说：Metal coins were heavy to carry.
金属钱币太重，带着不方便，人们就用起了纸币。
typical: 纸币现在还在用，一定是更值钱：
选“纸币比金属钱币更值钱”

ladder.q: 按短文排顺序：A paper money　B exchanging goods　C metal coins
短文说，最早人们交换东西时会遇到什么麻烦？
ladder.a: 有时很难换到自己想要的东西

ladder.q: 今天人们还能用什么付钱？用英语说出两样。

items.topic: 讲做法：原形还是过去式
items.stem: Lily 讲她上周日怎样做玩具车，用括号里的词填空：Last Sunday I made a toy car. First, I ____ (find) a small box.
right: Last Sunday 说明讲的是已经做完的事，动词用过去式；
find 是不规则动词，过去式是 found。
typical: 看到 First，就用说步骤时的原形：
First, I find a small box.

ladder.q: 教同学做手工，用括号里的词填空：First, ____ (cut) the paper.
讲昨天做的事，用括号里的词填空：Then I ____ (make) a paper bird.
用 First 和 Then 讲你做过的一件手工（两句）。
ladder.a: 如 First, I found some paper. Then I made a paper box.

items.stem: 读下面关于学校花园的介绍，同意 Tom 的说法吗？
work: Our school garden is very old. Who made it?
Nobody knows for sure. Some teachers think it was Mr Wang.
Tom：It may be Mr Wang, but nobody is sure.
right: Nobody knows for sure 说明谁也不能确定；
Some teachers think 只是一部分人的看法，所以 Tom 说得对。

ladder.q: Some people think it was Lily. 这件事确定吗？
ladder.a: 不确定，只是有些人这样想

ladder.q: No one knows for sure who made the kite. 谁做的这只风筝，大家清楚吗？
用 We don't know for sure 和 Some people think 写两句话。
ladder.a: 如 We don't know for sure. Some people think it was Tom.

items.lesson: C Project: Make a spending plan
items.stem: Amy has 100 yuan. She needs a schoolbag (60 yuan). She wants a toy car (70 yuan). 她的计划该怎样写？
options: First, I'm going to buy the toy car.
I'm going to buy both today.
First, I'm going to buy the schoolbag.
right: 先买需要的书包：100 − 60 = 40 元；
玩具车 70 元，钱不够，可以先存钱以后再买。
typical: First, I'm going to buy the toy car.

ladder.q: 一本书 30 元，一个球 60 元，你有 80 元。两样都买得起吗？
need 还是 want？Tom's shoes are too small. He ____ new shoes.
用 I need ... I want ... First, I'm going to ... 写你的花钱计划。
ladder.a: 如：I need a pen. I want a ball. First, I'm going to buy the pen.

lessons: What can we see in the sky
items.stem: 补全：Look up! ____ is big and round tonight.
right: 月亮只有一个，大家都知道指哪个，
前面用 the：the Moon，同样说 the Sun。
typical: A Moon is big and round tonight.

ladder.q: 补全：____ Sun is very hot.
补全：I can see ____ plane and some birds.
用英语说：今天早上太阳很亮。
ladder.a: The Sun is very bright this morning.

items.stem: 用英语说：她牙疼。
right: 说得了什么病用 have，主语 she 用 has；
牙疼是 toothache：She has a toothache.
typical: 汉语“她牙疼”里没有“有”，就用 is：

ladder.q: 用英语说：我头疼。
用英语说：他发烧了。
用英语说：我妹妹咳嗽，还喉咙疼。
ladder.a: My sister has a cough and a sore throat.

lessons: What can we see in the sky
items.stem: 哪一句说得对？
options: The Sun travels around Earth every day.
right: Earth 是行星，绕着太阳转；
月球是地球的邻居，绕着地球转。
typical: 每天看到太阳东升西落：
The Sun travels around Earth every day.

ladder.q: 补全：Earth is a ____ . It travels around the Sun.
补全：The Sun is not a planet. It is a ____ .
用英语说：太阳是恒星，地球是行星。
ladder.a: The Sun is a star. Earth is a planet.

items.stem: Put on your coat. It's very cold today. You may have a cough tomorrow. 句中 may 的意思是：
right: 这里不是允许你咳嗽，而是说一种可能：
不穿外套，明天可能会咳嗽。
typical: 所以 may 就是“可以”

ladder.q: May I open the window? 句中 may 是什么意思？
It's cloudy. It may rain. 句中 may 是什么意思？
用 may 说一句：你可能会牙疼。

items.stem: — Is there a space museum in your city? — ____
right: Is there ...? 用 there is / there isn't 回答；
a space museum 是一个，用 is：Yes, there is.
typical: 问的是这座城市，就用 it：

ladder.q: — Is there a river near your school? — No, ____ .
补全：There ____ a rover on Mars.
用英语问：火星上有树吗？再替对方否定回答。
ladder.a: Are there any trees on Mars? No, there aren't.

items.stem: — What's the matter with Tom? — He has a fever. — He should ____ to bed early.
right: should 后面直接跟动词原形，不加 to，
主语是 he 也不加 s：He should go to bed early.
typical: He should to go to bed early.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：You should ____ (see) a doctor.
— I have a toothache. — You ____ eat too many sweets. (should / shouldn't)
朋友说 I have a cough. 用 should 给他两条建议。
ladder.a: 如 You should see a doctor and go to bed early.

items.stem: 用英语说：他们乘飞船去空间站。
options: They go to the space station by a spaceship.
They take a spaceship go to the space station.
They go to the space station in a spaceship.
They go to the space station in spaceship.
right: 坐在飞船里去：in a spaceship，a 不能少；
用 by 说方式时不加 a：by bus、by plane。
typical: “乘飞船”就是 by + 一艘飞船：
They go to the space station by a spaceship.

ladder.q: 补全：My dad goes to work ____ car.
改错：We went to Shanghai by a plane.
ladder.a: We went to Shanghai by plane.

ladder.q: 用英语说：航天员乘飞船回到地球。
ladder.a: Astronauts come back to Earth in a spaceship.

items.stem: Ben 想提醒弟弟爱护眼睛，写了下面这句话。同意他的写法吗？
work: You don't should play computer games at night.
right: should 的否定是在后面加 not：shouldn't，
You shouldn't play computer games at night.

ladder.q: 改成否定句：You should eat lots of sweets.
ladder.a: You shouldn't eat lots of sweets.

ladder.q: 填 should 或 shouldn't：You ____ sit too close to the TV.
为保护眼睛，写一句 should 和一句 shouldn't。
ladder.a: 如 I should sleep early. I shouldn't …

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：In space, a taikonaut ____ (wash) his face with a wet cloth.
right: 主语 a taikonaut 是一个人，动词用三单；
wash 以 sh 结尾，加 es：washes。

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：She ____ (brush) her teeth every morning.
用括号里的词填空：He ____ (watch) the sunrise in space.
用括号里的词填空：Every afternoon the taikonaut ____ (do) exercise.

items.topic: gl 和 gr 的读音
items.stem: 哪个词开头也是 gr 的读音（和 grow 一样）？
right: grow 和 green 都以 gr 开头，读 /gr/；
glue 开头是 /gl/，good 开头只有 /g/。
typical: glue 和 grow 都是 g 加一个舌头音，

ladder.q: gl 还是 gr：glad，grape
找出开头读音不同的词：grass，glass，grandma
按开头分两组：great，glue，green，glad

items.stem: Tom often goes to bed at eleven, and he is tired in class. 他的健康计划 Sleep 一栏写哪句？
options: I go to bed at eleven.
I'll goes to bed at nine.
I'll go to bed at nine.
right: 计划说以后要做的事：I'll（= I will）+ 动词原形；
早点睡才能解决上课犯困：I'll go to bed at nine.
typical: 照着自己现在的作息写：
I go to bed at eleven.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：I'll ____ (drink) more water every day.
用 I'll 为自己写一句 Eat 计划。
Amy watches TV for three hours every day. 替她写一句 Do 计划。
ladder.a: 如 I'll play outside after school.

items.stem: 太空垃圾（space junk）是人造的、留在太空里的东西。下面哪一个是 space junk？
options: an old spaceship part going around Earth
right: 太空垃圾要同时满足两条：是人造的，在太空里；
旧飞船的零件是人造的，又绕着地球转，所以是。
typical: 绕着地球转的东西都是太空垃圾：

ladder.q: Is the Sun space junk? 用英语回答，再用中文说为什么。
ladder.a: No, it isn't. 它不是人造的

ladder.q: 从飞船上掉下来、在太空里飘着的一个旧螺丝，是不是 space junk？
Space junk is growing. 意思是太空垃圾越来越多，还是越来越少？

items.stem: — What's the matter with Tom? — He ____ a fever. — He should ____ in bed.
right: 说生病用 have / has + 病名，Tom 是三单：He has a fever.
should 后面用动词原形：He should stay in bed.
typical: 照“他发烧了”，用 is 把人和病连起来：

ladder.q: — What's the matter? — I ____ a cough. (have / am)
用括号里的词填空：She has a cold. She should ____ (drink) more water.
Your friend has a bad cough. 用 should 给他一条建议。
ladder.a: 如 You should take some medicine.

items.stem: 读完 Let’s explore 的短文 Natural medicines，哪一句说出了短文的主要意思？
options: Some natural medicines are in the park.
There are many natural medicines around us.
With them, we never need to go to the doctor.
right: 短文说天然药物可以在公园、花园、厨房里找到，
又举了几种例子，合起来讲的是：我们身边有很多天然药物。
typical: 只记住了“在公园里”这一处：
Some natural medicines are in the park.

ladder.q: Walking is good for us. It makes our legs strong. It helps us sleep well. 哪句是主要意思？
Milk is good for us. Fish is good for us. Eggs are good for us. 用一句话说主要意思。
ladder.a: 如 Many foods are good for us.

ladder.q: Amy has a bad fever. 她只喝点天然药茶、不去看医生，行吗？为什么？
ladder.a: 不行，天然药物不能代替看医生

items.lesson: C Project: Share facts about Earth, the Sun and the Moon
lessons: Share facts about Earth, the Sun and the Moon
items.stem: 做太空知识卡：Why do we have day and night on Earth?
options: Because the Sun goes around Earth.
Because Earth goes around the Sun.
right: 地球在不停地自转（spins），
转到朝着太阳的一面是白天，背着太阳的一面是黑夜。
typical: 每天看到太阳东升西落，是太阳在绕着地球转：
Because the Sun goes around Earth.

ladder.q: 地球自转一圈大约要多长时间？A 一天　B 一年
Earth goes around the Sun. 地球绕太阳转一圈大约要多长时间？
北京是白天的时候，地球另一面的地方可能是白天还是黑夜？

items.stem: Binbin 想问：雨是从哪里来的？选出正确的问句。
right: 主语 rain 是三单，问句用 does：Where does ...?
有了 does，动词用原形：Where does rain come from?
typical: rain 是三单，come 要加 s：

ladder.q: 补全：Where ____ electricity come from?
变成问句：Water comes from the sea.
ladder.a: Does water come from the sea?

ladder.q: 用英语问：这些苹果是从哪里来的？
ladder.a: Where do these apples come from?

items.stem: 哪一句是对的？
options: We went to UK last year.
We went to the Canada last year.
We went to the UK last year.
right: the UK 是固定说法，前面要有 the；
Canada、France、Italy 前面不加 the。
typical: 国家名前面都不加 the：
We went to UK last year.

ladder.q: 填 the 或不填：My uncle lives in ____ France.
填 the 或不填：London is in ____ UK.
用英语说：我想去澳大利亚和英国。
ladder.a: I want to go to Australia and the UK.

items.stem: 补全：We use solar power ____ our homes.（给家里供暖）
right: 用某样东西做某事：use ... to + 动词原形，
We use solar power to heat our homes.
typical: We use solar power heat our homes.

ladder.q: 补全：We use electricity ____ (light) our rooms.
补全：We can use wind power ____ (run) trains.
用英语说：我们用水能来发电。
ladder.a: We use water power to make electricity.

items.stem: Solar power is green energy. 这里的 green 是什么意思？
options: 它发出的光是绿颜色的
right: green energy 指清洁、对地球好的能源；
太阳能来自阳光，不是植物，也不是绿颜色的。
typical: 它发出的光是绿颜色的。

ladder.q: 说出课上学的三种 green energy。
ladder.a: wind power, solar power, water power

ladder.q: Green energy is green in colour. 对吗？
用英语说：风能是绿色能源，因为它很干净。
ladder.a: Wind power is green energy because it is clean.

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Last Saturday, my aunt ____ (take) me to the zoo.
right: Last Saturday 说的是过去的事；
take 的过去式是 took：my aunt took me to the zoo.
typical: 过去式就在词尾加 ed：
My aunt taked me to the zoo.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：see → ____，go → ____
用括号里的词填空：We ____ (have) a walk by the river yesterday.
用英语说：昨天爸爸带我去了公园。
ladder.a: Dad took me to the park yesterday.

items.stem: It's time for bed. 补全：Let's ____ the TV.
right: 关掉电视、电灯这些用电的东西用 turn off；
Let's turn off the TV.

ladder.q: 补全：Turn ____ the computer when you finish.（关掉）
补全：It's dark. Let's turn ____ the light.（打开）
用英语给家人一条节约用电的建议。
ladder.a: 如：We should turn off the TV.

items.topic: What a 和 How 感叹句
items.stem: 看到同学画的画，你说：____ clever girl she is!
right: clever girl 是“形容词 + 单数名词”，
用 What a 开头：What a clever girl she is!
typical: 看到形容词 clever 就用 How：

ladder.q: 填 What 或 How：____ big the room is!
填 What 或 What a：____ nice day it is!
用 How 改写：What a tall tree it is!

items.stem: Amy 这样说，你同意吗？
work: I keep my toys in an old shoe box.
That's reuse.
right: 旧鞋盒没送去回收，换个用法再用，是 reuse；
送去回收、做成新东西，才是 recycle。

ladder.q: reuse 还是 recycle？Use an old jar as a pencil box.
reuse 还是 recycle？Send old paper to make new paper.
用英语各说一个 reuse 和 recycle 的做法。
ladder.a: 如：Reuse old boxes. Recycle old books.

items.stem: It's going to rain, so I won't ride my bike tomorrow. 句中 won't 是哪两个词的缩写？
right: won't = will not，说将来不会做某事：
明天要下雨，我明天不骑车了。
typical: won't 和 want 长得像，
