ladder.q: 写出缩写：will not → ____，do not → ____
用 won't 改写：I will not be late again.
用 won't 说一句：明天你不会做的一件事。
ladder.a: 如 I won't watch TV tomorrow.

items.stem: 节水小贴士：Wash all the dirty cups together, not one at a time. 意思是：
options: 每个杯子只洗一次就够了
攒够脏杯子一起洗，不要一个个洗
right: together 是“一起”，not one at a time 是“不要一个一个地”；
攒够了一起洗，能省水省电。
typical: one 和 time 就是“一次”：
每个杯子只洗一次就够了。

ladder.q: 选一选：Come in one at a time. A 一个一个进来 B 一起进来
Walk to school. Don't go by car. 用汉语说说这条建议。
用英语写一条节约用电的小贴士。
ladder.a: 如：Turn off the lights when you leave.

items.topic: pl 和 pr 的读音
items.stem: 哪个词里有 pr 的读音（和 pretty 开头一样）？
right: April 中间的 pr 读 /pr/，和 pretty 开头一样；
play 开头是 /pl/，pet 开头只有 /p/。
typical: play 和 pretty 都是 p 加一个舌头音，

ladder.q: pl 还是 pr：plate，present
找出含 pr 读音的词：April，apple，pen
按开头分两组：plate，pretty，plane，present

items.stem: 给外地朋友写家乡介绍，想说“家乡的橘子很有名”。哪一句写对了？
options: Oranges is famous in my hometown.
Oranges are famous in my hometown.
right: oranges 是复数，be 动词用 are：
Oranges are famous in my hometown.
typical: 照“橘子很有名”逐字说，漏了 be：

ladder.q: 选词填空：The old bridge ____ famous in my hometown. (is / are)
选词填空：Dumplings ____ famous in my hometown. (is / are)
用 … is / are famous in my hometown. 介绍家乡的一样东西。
ladder.a: 如 The tea is famous in my hometown.

items.stem: 读完太阳能“烤箱”的故事，Lily 这样说。你同意吗？
work: Solar power can light our homes,
but it can't help us cook.
right: 故事里爷爷、Binbin 和 Robin 用太阳能“烤箱”做好了饭，
没用燃气也没用电：太阳能也能用来做饭。

ladder.q: 故事里，Robin 说阳光能做哪三件事？
ladder.a: 照亮房子、让汽车跑起来、做饭

ladder.q: 同意吗？We can use solar power to run cars.
用 We can use solar power to ... 写一句。
ladder.a: 如：We can use solar power to make electricity.

items.stem: 讲去年的旅行：Last summer we ____ to Sanya. What a beautiful beach ____!
right: Last summer 说的是过去，go 的过去式是 went；
感叹句 What a + 形容词 + 名词 + 主语 + 动词：… it is!
typical: 照问句把 is 提到 it 前面：
What a beautiful beach is it!

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：Yesterday I ____ (see) a tall tower.
连词成句（感叹句）：nice / what / a / is / it / day
ladder.a: What a nice day it is!

ladder.q: 用一句过去时和一句感叹句讲你的一次旅行。
ladder.a: 如 Last year I went to Beijing. What a big city it is!

items.topic: one of the first 的意思
items.stem: Amy was one of the first students to use the new library. 这句话是什么意思？
options: 她是第一个用新图书馆的学生
她是最早用新图书馆的学生之一
她先去了新图书馆，再去别的地方
right: one of the first … to … 是“最早……的那批人之一”；
不是说只有她第一个，也不是说她先去哪儿。
typical: 看到 first 就译成“第一个”：
她是第一个用新图书馆的学生。

ladder.q: He was the first student to come to school today. 他是第几个到校的？
She was one of the first girls to join the club. 她是唯一最先加入的人吗？
ladder.a: 不是，她是最早加入的几个女孩之一

ladder.q: 用 one of the first 写一句：Tom 是最早到校的学生之一。
ladder.a: Tom was one of the first students to come to school.

items.lesson: C Project: Give a presentation about green energy
lessons: Give a presentation about green energy
items.stem: 演讲稿讲 3R 规则。下面哪一个是 Reduce 的例子？
options: Keep crayons in an old jar.
Use less water when you wash.
right: Reduce 是少用：水、电、东西都少用一点；
旧罐子装蜡笔是 Reuse，旧报纸回收是 Recycle。
typical: reduce、reuse 都以 re 开头，都是节约：
Keep crayons in an old jar.

ladder.q: Reduce、Reuse 还是 Recycle？Turn off the lights when you leave.
Reduce、Reuse 还是 Recycle？Make a pencil box from an old box.
为演讲稿写一句 Reduce 的建议。

items.stem: Last Sunday, I ____ the science museum. Next Sunday, I ____ the car museum.
right: Last Sunday 是过去：I visited ...
Next Sunday 是打算：I am going to visit ...
typical: 写成 I going to visit the car museum.

ladder.q: 补全：I ____ going to visit my grandma tomorrow.
Last week we ____ (visit) the zoo. Next week we ____ (visit) a museum.（后一空用 be going to）
用英语说：上周我去了公园，下周我打算去参观博物馆。
ladder.a: Last week I went to the park. Next week I'm going to visit a museum.

items.stem: Lily 12 岁，Tom 10 岁。比岁数：Lily is ____ than Tom.
right: 说岁数的“大”“小”用 older / younger；
big 说的是个头大：Lily is older than Tom.

ladder.q: 补全：I'm 12. You're 11. I'm ____ than you.
用英语说：我妹妹比我小。
ladder.a: My sister is younger than me.

ladder.q: 用英语说：Mike 比我大，也比我高。
ladder.a: Mike is older and taller than me.

items.stem: This box is 4 kg. That box is 6 kg. That box is ____ than this one.
right: 有 than，要用比较级；
heavy 以“辅音字母 + y”结尾，把 y 改成 i 再加 er：heavier。

ladder.q: 补全：I'm 1.5 m. You're 1.6 m. You're ____ (tall) than me.
补全：This film is ____ (funny) than that one.
用英语说：我比我姐姐小两岁。
ladder.a: I'm two years younger than my sister.

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：My schoolbag is ____ (big) than yours.
right: big 以“辅音 + 一个元音 + 辅音”结尾，
双写末尾的 g 再加 er：big → bigger。

ladder.q: 写出比较级：fat ____　thin ____
写出比较级：sad ____　short ____
补全：Summer is ____ (hot) than spring. The days are ____ (long).

items.stem: Tom 比 Ben 重 3 千克。Tom is ____.
right: 相差多少放在比较级前面：
Tom is 3 kilograms heavier than Ben.
typical: 照汉语“重 3 千克”的顺序：
Tom is heavier 3 kilograms than Ben.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我比你高 3 厘米。
用英语说：我的铅笔比你的长 2 厘米。
ladder.a: My pencil is 2 centimetres longer than yours.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我哥哥比我大三岁。
ladder.a: My brother is three years older than me.

items.stem: 小林这样写，你同意吗？
work: Did you watched TV last weekend?
right: 问句已经用 did 表示过去了，
后面的动词用原形：Did you watch TV last weekend?

ladder.q: 补全：— Did you clean your room? — Yes, ____ .
变成问句：She washed her clothes.
用英语问 Mike：你上周末待在家里了吗？
ladder.a: Did you stay at home last weekend?

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：I ____ (see) a panda at the zoo last weekend.
right: last weekend 说的是过去，动词用过去式；
see 是不规则动词：see → saw。

ladder.q: 写出过去式：watch ____　clean ____
写出过去式：go ____　read ____　have ____
用英语说：上周末我读了一本书，还洗了衣服。
ladder.a: I read a book and washed my clothes last weekend.

items.stem: Amy 这样写上周日的事，你同意吗？
work: It was rainy last Sunday.
We didn't go to the park.
right: didn't 已经表示过去，后面的动词用原形：
didn't go，写得对。

ladder.q: 补全：I ____ (not watch) TV yesterday.
变成否定句：She cleaned her room.
用英语说：昨天我感冒了，所以没去上学。
ladder.a: I had a cold, so I didn't go to school yesterday.

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：The baby ____ (cry) all night, so Mum was very tired.
right: 后半句用了 was，说的是过去的事，动词用过去式；
cry 是“辅音字母 + y”结尾，改 y 为 i 再加 ed：cried。

ladder.q: 写出过去式：study ____　worry ____
写出过去式：play ____　try ____
补全：Last Sunday Amy ____ (stay) at home and ____ (study) maths.

items.stem: 补全：Last night my cat ____ off the sofa.
right: Last night 说的是过去，fall 的过去式是 fell：
My cat fell off the sofa last night.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：fall ____　hurt ____
写出过去式：ride ____　go ____
用英语说：上周我弟弟从椅子上摔了下来。
ladder.a: My little brother fell off a chair last week.

items.stem: 补全：Last Saturday, Lily ____ to the beach with her aunt.
right: Last Saturday 说的是过去，go 的过去式是 went：
Lily went to the beach with her aunt.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：ride ____　eat ____
补全：— Where did you go? — I ____ (go) to Beijing.
用英语说：去年冬天我去了哈尔滨，还拍了照片。
ladder.a: Last winter I went to Harbin and took pictures.

items.stem: 陈杰这样写，你同意吗？
work: My uncle lives in Wuhan.
We went there last Saturday.
right: there 本身就是“到那里”，前面不加 to：
went there，就像 go home 一样。

ladder.q: 补全（不需要就写 ×）：I went ____ home at 5 o'clock.
补全（不需要就写 ×）：We went ____ the park yesterday.
— Did you go to the zoo? — Yes. 我们昨天去了那里。用英语说后半句。

items.stem: 补全：Last Sunday my friends and I went hiking. We ____ very tired after that.
right: 说过去怎么样用 was / were；
主语 we 是复数，用 were：We were very tired.
typical: We was very tired after that.

ladder.q: 补全：My winter holiday ____ great.
补全：The apples on Grandpa's farm ____ very sweet.
用英语说：昨天我很累，但我的朋友们很开心。
ladder.a: I was tired yesterday, but my friends were happy.

items.stem: Forty years ago, there ____ no buses near Grandpa's home.
right: 说过去“有”用 there was / there were；
buses 是复数，用 were。

ladder.q: 补全：There ____ a big tree in front of my old house.
补全：Now there ____ many trees on the playground.
补全：Before, there ____ no park near my home. Now there ____ two.

items.stem: 补全：Before, Lily ____ eat carrots. Now she eats them every day.
right: eat 是动作词，过去的“不”用 didn't + 原形：
Before, Lily didn't eat carrots.

ladder.q: 补全（wasn't / didn't）：Before, my cat ____ fat.
补全（wasn't / didn't）：Before, Tom ____ play badminton.
用英语说：以前 Tom 个子不高，也不喜欢篮球。
ladder.a: Before, Tom wasn't tall, and he didn't like basketball.

items.stem: 小林这样写变化，你同意吗？
work: The tree was small five years ago.
Now it was very tall.
right: Now 说的是现在，第二句要用现在时：
Now it is very tall.

ladder.q: 补全：Tom was a baby ten years ago. Now he ____ a tall boy.
补全：There ____ no trees here before. Now there ____ many.
用英语说：以前我的猫很小，现在它很胖。
ladder.a: My cat was small before. Now it is fat.

items.stem: Two years ago, Tom ____ shorter than me. Now he is ____ than me.
right: Two years ago 是过去：Tom was shorter.
有 than 要用比较级：taller than me.
typical: 照汉语写成 Tom is shorter than me.

ladder.q: 补全：Three years ago, I ____ very short.
补全：Five years ago, my cats ____ small. Now they are big.
用英语说：以前我比哥哥矮，现在我比他高。
ladder.a: I was shorter than my brother before. Now I'm taller than him.

items.lesson: Section A How do you greet people?
items.topic: 字母前用 a 还是 an
items.stem: 字母前用 a 还是 an？依次填空：____ F，____ U，____ M
right: 看第一个音，不看字母：F /ef/、M /em/ 以元音开头，用 an；
U /juː/ 以辅音 /j/ 开头，用 a。
typical: F、M 不是元音字母，用 a；U 是元音字母，用 an

ladder.q: 填 a 或 an：____ orange，____ ruler
填 a 或 an：____ egg，____ X，____ Y

items.lesson: Starter Welcome to junior high! (Get ready)
items.topic: a 和 an 的选用
items.stem: 说说书包里的东西：I have ____ English textbook and ____ pencil case.
right: English 开头是元音 /ɪ/，用 an：an English textbook；
pencil 开头是辅音 /p/，用 a：a pencil case。
typical: I have a English textbook and a pencil case.

ladder.q: 填 a 或 an：____ pen，____ eraser
填 a 或 an：I have ____ apple and ____ orange.
填 a 或 an：____ uniform，____ hour

items.lesson: Section B How do you start a conversation?
lessons: How do you start a conversation
items.stem: 你的同桌叫 Bill。新同学指着他问：How do you spell his name? 你怎么回答？
right: How do you spell ...? 问的是“怎么拼写”，
要一个字母一个字母地拼出来：B-I-L-L, Bill.
typical: 听到 his name，就回答名字：

ladder.q: 给问句选答语：What's his name?　A. T-O-M.　B. His name is Tom.
—How do you spell "Lily"? —____
补全问句：—____ ____ ____ ____ your name? —G-R-E-E-N, Green.

items.lesson: Starter Welcome to junior high! (Know your school)
items.stem: 介绍教学楼：二楼有 12 间教室。哪句对？
options: There is 12 classrooms on the second floor.
There are 12 classrooms on the second floor.
There have 12 classrooms on the second floor.
right: “某处有某物”用 there be；
12 classrooms 是复数，be 用 are：There are 12 classrooms …
typical: 汉语说“二楼有……”，“有”就是 have：
There have 12 classrooms on the second floor.

ladder.q: There ____ a library in our school.
There ____ two dining halls in our school.
改错：There have two playgrounds in my school.

items.lesson: Starter Welcome to junior high! (Introduce yourself)
items.stem: 做自我介绍时说生日：My birthday is ____ October.
right: 只说月份时用 in：My birthday is in October.
说到具体哪一天才用 on，如 on Monday。

ladder.q: Her birthday is ____ June.
We have PE ____ Monday.
填介词：I get up ____ 6:30 ____ Monday.

items.lesson: Starter Welcome to junior high! (Hold a party)
items.stem: 把愿望写在许愿树上：我打算每天跑步。
options: I going to run every day.
I'm going to run every day.
I'm going to running every day.
right: 打算做某事：be going to + 动词原形；
主语 I 配 am：I'm going to run every day.
typical: I going to run every day.

ladder.q: I ____ going to make more friends.
She is going to ____ (join) a football team.
连词成句：read / going / books / to / more / we / are
ladder.a: We are going to read more books.

items.lesson: Section A What do you have?
items.stem: 小明这样说，你同意吗？
work: cap 后面加上 e，就成了 cape。
e 不发音，所以 a 的读音不变。
right: 结尾的 e 不发音，但它让前面的 a 读字母 A 的名字。
cap 里的 a 和 cat 一样；cape 里的 a 和 cake、name 一样。

ladder.q: 圈出 a 读字母 A 名字的词：cat　cake　bag　name
哪个词里的 a 和 face 里的 a 读音一样：bag　make　hand
用拼读规则读生词 gate：a 像 cat 里的，还是像 cake 里的？

items.lesson: Section B Where do you put your things?
lessons: Where do you put your things
items.stem: —Where ____ my keys? —____ on the sofa.
right: keys 是复数：问句用 are，
答句用 they 指代：They're on the sofa.
typical: 问句用了 are，答句还是 It's：
—Where are my keys? —It's on the sofa.

ladder.q: Where ____ (be) your books?
—Where's my hat? —____ on the bed.
—Where are your pencils? —____ in my pencil box.

items.stem: 讲台上的那本书是陈老师（Ms Chen）的。The book on the desk is ____.
right: 后面没有名词，用名词性物主代词：
hers = her book：The book on the desk is hers.
typical: The book on the desk is her.

ladder.q: This pen is ____ (我的).
—Is this your bag? —No, it's ____ (他的).
____ (她的) eyes meet ____ (我的).

items.stem: Mia 的爸妈在信里说，有时她得自己驾驶小船：Sometimes Mia has to sail her boat by ____.
right: by oneself 意为“独自”，要用反身代词；
Mia 是女孩：by herself。
typical: Mia has to sail her boat by her.

ladder.q: I do my homework by ____.
Tom cleans his room by ____.
You can do it by ____ (你自己)!

items.stem: 开学前填三栏表：I know... / What I want to know... / How I can find out more... 同意 Tom 的做法吗？
work: Tom 把这一句写进了第三栏：
How big is the school library?
（How I can find out more...）
right: 这是还不知道答案的问题，放第二栏 What I want to know...；
第三栏写找答案的办法，如 I can ask my teacher.

ladder.q: Our school has a big playground. 放哪一栏？
I can ask my classmates. 放哪一栏？
ladder.a: 第三栏 How I can find out more...

ladder.q: 写一个你开学前想知道的问题，放进第二栏。
ladder.a: 如 What clubs are there in my school?

items.stem: 哪个词里有 /æ/（和 plan 中 a 的读音一样）？
right: back 中的 a 读 /æ/，和 plan、activity 一样；
car 中的 ar 读 /ɑː/，head 中的 ea 读 /e/。
typical: 所以和 plan 里的 a 读音一样

ladder.q: /æ/ 还是 /ɑː/：map，arm
/e/ 还是 /æ/：friend，thank
找出元音和另外两个不同的词：sad，back，start

items.lesson: Section A What is fun in a yard?
lessons: What is fun in a yard
items.topic: hop 和 hope 里的 o
items.stem: 小明这样说，你同意吗？
work: hope 和 hop 里都有字母 o，
所以 o 都读字母 O 的名字。
right: hop 里 o 后面只有一个辅音、没有 e，读短音，和 hot 里的 o 一样；
hope 词尾有不发音的 e，o 才读字母 O 的名字。

ladder.q: 圈出 o 和 hot 里的 o 读音一样的词：box　joke　dog　home
哪个词里的 i 和 big 里的 i 读音一样：nine　six　like
用拼读规则读生词 rob 和 robe：o 各像 hot 还是 home 里的？
ladder.a: rob 像 hot，robe 像 home

items.lesson: Unit 2 More than fun  Starting out & Understanding ideas 1
items.topic: 短语 cut in 的意思
items.stem: Rock music meets the erhu：“…the sound of Grandpa's erhu cuts in.” 这里的 cuts in 是什么意思？
right: “我”正在听摇滚乐，这时爷爷的二胡声响了起来；
cut in 指（声音、话）突然插进来。
typical: 所以 cuts in 是爷爷用刀切东西

ladder.q: Rock music is coming out of my computer. 意思是？
ladder.a: 摇滚乐从我的电脑里传出来

ladder.q: I rush into his room. 意思是？
Please don't cut in when your friend is talking. 意思是？
ladder.a: 朋友说话时请不要插嘴

items.lesson: Section B What is fun on a farm?
lessons: What is fun on a farm
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：On the farm, I can see six ____ (sheep) and ten ____ (cow).
right: sheep 单复数同形，几只都写 sheep；
cow 是规则变化，复数加 s：cows。

ladder.q: two ____ (duck) and three ____ (horse)
many ____ (sheep) and some ____ (chicken)
five ____ (child) and twenty ____ (sheep)

items.lesson: Unit 2 More than fun  Understanding ideas
items.stem: Grandpa ____ the erhu in the park, and his friends ____ Beijing opera.
right: Grandpa 是三单，动词加 s：plays；
his friends 是复数，动词用原形：sing。
typical: 说别人做的事，动词都加 s：

ladder.q: My sister ____ (write) songs.
Li Bo and his friends ____ (like) Beijing opera.
改错：Emma like writing and her friends likes reading.

items.lesson: Unit 2 More than fun  Developing ideas
items.stem: Wang Chen 解释那只鸟为什么飞不起来：腿没力气 → 飞不起来。哪句对？
options: It can't fly, so its legs are weak.
Because its legs are weak, so it can't fly.
Its legs are weak, so it can't fly.
right: so 后面接结果：腿没力气是原因，飞不起来是结果；
because 和 so 只能选一个，不能同时用。
typical: It can't fly, so its legs are weak.

ladder.q: It's my hobby, ____ I know a lot about birds. (because / so)
I read books about birds ____ I love nature. (because / so)
用 so 连成一句：It rains. We stay at home.
ladder.a: It rains, so we stay at home.

items.stem: 哪个词里有长元音 /iː/（和 we、see 中的一样）？
right: teacher 中 ea 读 /iː/，和 see、need 一样；
ship 读短元音 /ɪ/，sorry 词尾的 y 读 /i/。

ladder.q: /iː/ 还是 /ɪ/：week，window
找出词尾读 /i/ 的词：need，miss，sunny
按元音分两组：eat，is，teacher，ship

items.lesson: Unit 3 Family ties  Starting out & Understanding ideas 1
items.stem: Silent love 结尾说：“His love may be silent. But like a mountain, it is always there.” 意思是？
options: 父亲的爱不说出口，但一直都在
父亲不爱儿子，所以不说话
父亲一直站在山上看着儿子
right: silent 指父亲不把爱说出口，不拥抱、不亲吻；
like a mountain 是比喻：爱像山一样，一直都在。
typical: 父亲不说话，也不拥抱儿子，

ladder.q: Tears quietly run down his face. 父亲此时心情怎样？
He just hides his care in his heart. 意思是？
ladder.a: 他只是把关心藏在心里

ladder.q: My mum is like the sun. 这句把妈妈比作什么？哪里像？

items.stem: 介绍爸爸妈妈两个人共用的房间，哪句对？
right: parents 以 s 结尾，所有格只加 '：parents'；
This is my parents' room.（我父母的房间）

ladder.q: 这是 Tom 的书：This is ____ book.
这些是学生们的书：These are the ____ books.
这是我爷爷奶奶的家：This is my ____ home.

items.lesson: Section A How do we get to know each other?
lessons: How do we get to know each other
items.stem: This boy is my new classmate. ____ name is Mike.
right: name 前要用形容词性物主代词：he → his。
His name is Mike.（他的名字叫迈克。）
typical: He's 就像 Tom's，表示“他的”：

ladder.q: ____ (she) name is Gina.
—What's ____ (you) name? —____ (I) name is Tom.
填 He's 或 His：____ my brother. ____ name is Bob.

items.stem: Tina 想请妈妈来接她之前先换下女王裙。哪句说得既清楚又委婉？
options: Change your clothes before you come!
I'm sorry, but can you change your clothes?
right: 先用 I'm sorry, but... 让语气软下来，
再用 can you... 提出请求，妈妈不容易受伤。
typical: 我说的都是实话，直接说就好：

ladder.q: 哪句更委婉？A. Turn off the TV! B. Sorry, but can you turn off the TV?
说得委婉一些：Help me with my homework!
ladder.a: I'm sorry, but can you help me with my homework?

ladder.q: 爸爸总是很忙。用 I know you're very busy, but... 说一句请求。
ladder.a: 如 I know you're very busy, but can we play together?

items.lesson: Section B What do we need to know about a new friend?
lessons: What do we need to know about a new friend
items.topic: 并列主语后的 be 动词
items.stem: 回帖介绍自己和朋友：My friend and I ____ both 13 years old.
right: My friend and I 是两个人，相当于 we，
be 动词用 are：My friend and I are both 13 years old.
typical: My friend and I am both 13 years old.

ladder.q: Lily and Lucy ____ (be) from the UK.
My cousin and I ____ (be) from Xi'an.
改错：My sister and I is good friends.

items.topic: 字母 u 的三种读音
items.stem: 哪个词里的 u 和 cup 中的 u 读音相同（/ʌ/）？
right: fun 中 u 读 /ʌ/，和 cup、mum 一样；
push 中 u 读 /ʊ/，June 中 u 读 /uː/。
typical: push 和 cup 一样，u 后面是辅音，

ladder.q: /ʌ/ 还是 /uː/：up，rule
/ʊ/ 还是 /uː/：cook，school
按元音分三组：mum，foot，soup，fun，could，June
ladder.a: /ʌ/ mum fun；/ʊ/ foot could；/uː/ soup June

items.lesson: Unit 4 Time to celebrate (Starting out & Understanding ideas 1)
items.stem: An unusual Spring Festival 中，听到 “This is the lion's head!”，Emilia 为什么吃惊？
options: 她以为菜是用狮子肉做的
她不喜欢吃中国菜，不想尝
她以为在英国过春节是违法的
right: Emilia 问 Isn't that against the law?——她以为菜是狮子做的；
其实 lion's head 是猪肉丸子，她尝了说 I love it!

ladder.q: lion's head 实际上是一道什么菜？
Its round shape stands for ____.
Emilia 尝了以后觉得怎样？用原文的一句话回答。

items.stem: 春节时我们家总是吃饺子。哪句对？
right: always 这类频度副词放在行为动词前：
We always eat dumplings.
typical: always 修饰“吃”，就放在 eat 后面：

ladder.q: 排序：often / I / help / mum / my / cook
ladder.a: I often help my mum cook.

ladder.q: 改错：We eat often zongzi.
把 always 放进句子：She is busy at festivals.
ladder.a: She is always busy at festivals.

items.stem: 学了 fact 和 opinion，哪一句是观点（opinion），不是事实（fact）？
options: We should have a green Christmas.
right: should 表示说话人的想法和建议，是观点；
圣诞节的日期、一年约 52 周都能查证，是事实。
typical: 数字前有 about，说明是估计的，

ladder.q: Fact 还是 opinion：Christmas trees are beautiful.
Fact 还是 opinion：Many families put up a Christmas tree at home.
Fact 还是 opinion：Plastic trees are the best!

items.stem: 朋友说：Let's buy a big plastic Christmas tree. 你不同意，又想说得有礼貌，可以说：
options: No! That's a really bad idea.
right: I'm not sure about that. 表示不同意，语气委婉；
No problem. 是同意；No! … 不礼貌。
typical: 有 No 就是不同意：

ladder.q: 同意还是不同意：Great idea!
同意还是不同意：I'm afraid I don't agree.
同学说 Let's not have a Christmas tree. 礼貌地表示不同意。
ladder.a: 如 I'm not sure about that.

items.stem: When duty shines 写急诊医生冷文颖（Leng Wenying）。哪句符合课文？
options: She has a break from work at festivals.
She regrets being an ER doctor.
She is often much busier at festivals.
right: 课文说她 often much busier during festivals；
节日对她意味着更多工作，她也从不后悔当急诊医生。
typical: 第一句说节日意味着 a break from work，

ladder.q: Leng 在节日里为什么又累又渴？
ladder.a: 有时要连续工作 20 小时不休息

ladder.q: We need to stand by every minute. 意思是？
ladder.a: 我们每分钟都要随时待命

ladder.q: But she never regrets her decision. 用中文说意思。
ladder.a: 但她从不后悔自己的决定

items.lesson: Section A What is your family like?
items.stem: 向同学介绍你的两个哥哥，哪句对？
right: these 指两个以上：be 动词用 are，
名词也要用复数：These are my brothers.
typical: “这些是我的哥哥”，“哥哥”不用变：

ladder.q: Those ____ (be) my parents.
These are my ____ (sister).
改成复数句：This is my friend.

items.lesson: Section A What is your family like?
items.stem: 小明把 He has a basketball. 改成一般疑问句。他从第几步开始错？
work: 句中没有 be 动词，要借助助动词 do
主语 he 是三单，用 Does，放在句首
has 照抄：Does he has a basketball?
回答：Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
right: 用了 Does，后面的动词还原成原形：has → have。
Does he have a basketball?

ladder.q: ____ your sister ____ (have) a tennis ball?
改成一般疑问句：Jim likes bananas.
改成否定句：Lucy has a ping-pong bat.
ladder.a: Lucy doesn't have a ping-pong bat.

items.lesson: Section B What do you like about your family?
lessons: What do you like about your family
items.stem: “她是长头发。”哪句对？
right: 描述头发用 have/has；
hair 指一头头发时不可数：She has long hair.

ladder.q: My brother ____ short black hair.
My father ____ tall and he ____ a big nose.
用英语说：我妈妈个子高，留着长长的黑头发。
ladder.a: My mother is tall and has long black hair.

items.stem: 哪个词里的 o 读 /ɔː/（和 for、more 中的一样）？
right: short 中 or 读 /ɔː/，和 for、more 一样；
clock 中 o 读短音 /ɒ/，go 中 o 读双元音 /əʊ/。
typical: clock 里的 o 拖长一点，
就和 more 里的一样

ladder.q: /ɔː/ 还是 /ɒ/：board，not
找出含 /ɔː/ 的词：more，not，clock
按元音分两组：for，not，board，clock

items.lesson: Unit 5 The power of plants (Starting out & Understanding ideas 1)
items.stem: Within a plant 中，叶子“车间”里的工人造出产品。根据课文，哪种产品对植物自己最重要？
right: 课文说 Most importantly (for them), there will be sugar!
糖供植物生长；氧气植物需要得不多，主要供动物和人呼吸。
typical: 所以氧气对植物自己最重要

ladder.q: Workers from the Root send up ____.
叶子里的工人把哪三样东西混在一起？
Why does oxygen mean a lot to animals and humans?

items.lesson: Unit 5 The power of plants (Understanding ideas 2)
items.stem: 植树节那天我们要去种树。哪句对？
options: We will planting trees on Planting Day.
We will to plant trees on Planting Day.
We will plant trees on Planting Day.
right: will 后面接动词原形：
We will plant trees on Planting Day.
typical: 种树是一项活动，用 planting：
We will planting trees on Planting Day.

ladder.q: These seeds will ____ (grow) fast in spring.
Look at the clouds! It ____ (rain) soon.
ladder.a: will rain（或 is going to rain）

ladder.q: 改错：Plants will gives us oxygen.

items.lesson: Unit 5 The power of plants (Developing ideas 1)
items.stem: 听到一句：My little brother is nearly 120 cm tall. 弟弟有多高？
right: nearly 意为“将近”，放在数字前，
表示接近但还不到这个数：将近 120 cm。

ladder.q: There are over 50 students in the club. 俱乐部有多少学生？
about 300 years ago 是多少年前？
班里有 39 个学生，用 nearly 说一句。
ladder.a: There are nearly 40 students in my class.

items.lesson: Unit 5 The power of plants (Developing ideas 2)
items.stem: 同桌问你：May I use your eraser? 你同意，可以说：
right: 同意请求：Certainly! / Sure. / Go ahead. / Yes, you may.
No, thank you. 是谢绝别人给的东西，不是同意。
typical: 他问 May I，我就答 I may：

ladder.q: —Can I sit here? 同意时说：
—____ I open the window? —Certainly.
礼貌地请老师允许你问一个问题。

items.lesson: Unit 5 The power of plants (Developing ideas 3)
items.topic: 习语 one's cup of tea
items.stem: What's your cup of tea? 的标题用了习语。Tom 说：Football isn't my cup of tea. 意思是？
right: one's cup of tea 指“某人喜欢、感兴趣的东西”；
isn't my cup of tea：我不太喜欢。

ladder.q: Reading is my cup of tea. 意思是？
Cooking isn't her cup of tea. 意思是？
用 cup of tea 说说你喜欢的一件事。
ladder.a: 如 Music is my cup of tea.

items.lesson: Section A What is your school like?
items.stem: 小明想说“我家附近有一个公园”。他这样写，你同意吗？
work: There has a park near my home.
right: 说“某处有某物”用 there be，不用 have/has：
There is a park near my home.

ladder.q: ____ ____ a bank on Green Street.
—____ ____ any shops near here? —Yes, there are.
Our school ____ (have) a big library.

items.lesson: Section B What fun things do you do at school?
lessons: What fun things do you do at school
items.stem: The science building is across from the library. 这句话的意思是：
options: 穿过图书馆就到科学楼
right: across from 表示“在……对面”，说的是位置：
科学楼和图书馆面对面，中间隔着路或空地。
typical: 所以是：穿过图书馆就到科学楼。

ladder.q: 填 next to 或 across from：我和 Li Ming 并排坐。I sit ____ Li Ming.
体育馆在美术楼对面。The gym is ____ the art building.
用英语说：图书馆在体育馆和食堂之间。
ladder.a: The library is between the gym and the dining hall.

items.stem: 哪个词里有双元音 /aɪ/（和 like、size 中的一样）？
right: high 中 igh 读 /aɪ/，和 like、try 一样；
big 中 i 读 /ɪ/，play 中 ay 读 /eɪ/。
typical: 字母 i 的名字就是 /aɪ/，

ladder.q: /aɪ/ 还是 /eɪ/：try，make
/aɪ/ 还是 /ɔɪ/：light，coin
按元音分三组：cake，buy，oil，great，high，joy
ladder.a: /eɪ/ cake great；/aɪ/ buy high；/ɔɪ/ oil joy

items.lesson: Unit 6 Fantastic friends (Starting out & Understanding ideas 1)
items.stem: Pigeon surprise 第 2 天，Henry 写道：Pigeons are BORING and DIRTY! 为什么这两个词全用大写？
options: 表示他很讨厌鸽子，语气很强
因为它们是像人名一样的专有名词
因为它们是这篇博客的生词
right: 网上写东西时，整个词大写表示加重语气，
说明 Henry 这时很讨厌鸽子；后面的 AMAZING 也一样。
typical: 大写的词都是专有名词，

ladder.q: Argh! The birds are flying madly to her. Argh 表达什么感受？
How surprising! Henry 此时感觉怎样？
Day 5 里哪个词全大写？说明 Henry 怎么看鸽子？

items.stem: 动物园里，饲养员小声说：Ssh! The baby panda ____ now.
right: Ssh! 和 now 说明事情此刻正在发生，用现在进行时：
is + sleeping：The baby panda is sleeping now.
typical: 熊猫睡觉，用一般现在时：

ladder.q: Look! The monkey ____ (eat) a banana.
The pigeons ____ (fly) to the girl now.
Look! Two penguins ____ (swim) in the water.

items.stem: 广播说 Bingjie 在地震后帮忙找到失踪的人。他靠自己的什么本领做到？
options: He had a good sense of smell.
right: He had a good sense of smell. 灵敏的嗅觉是他的本领，
所以他能在地震后找到失踪的人，救了很多人。

ladder.q: How many people did Bingjie help to find after the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake?
Bingjie died at the age of ____.
用 It has a good sense of... 说一种动物的本领。
ladder.a: 如 A dog has a good sense of smell.

items.stem: 主持人采访 Bingjie 的训导员欧阳红红。按本课 Asking questions 的建议，哪种做法好？
options: 对方还没说完就插话追问
问题简短，一次只问一件事
把几个问题连成一个长问题
right: 课本建议：问题要短而简单（short and simple），
也不要在别人说话时插话（talking over）。
typical: 插话追问说明我对他的话很感兴趣：
对方还没说完，就抢着问 Why? Why?

ladder.q: 把长问题拆短：What animal is it and what does it do?
ladder.a: What animal is it? What does it do?

ladder.q: 采访同学的爱好，写一个简短的问题。
对方说 I love bird-watching. 写一个追问。
ladder.a: 如 Why do you like it?

items.stem: As dead as a dodo 中，人类为什么捕杀渡渡鸟？
options: Dodos were slow and couldn't fly.
Dodos ate the eggs of humans' pigs.
right: 原文：They hunted us because we were slow and couldn't fly.
渡渡鸟跑得慢、不会飞，很容易被抓。
typical: 课文里有 pigs 和 eggs，
所以是渡渡鸟吃了人类的猪下的蛋

ladder.q: Where did dodos live?
ladder.a: On an island in the Indian Ocean.

ladder.q: Humans arrived on the island in ____.
As a result, we soon died out. 前面说了哪些原因？

items.lesson: Section A Why do you like this subject?
lessons: Why do you like this subject
items.topic: but 和 because 怎么选
items.stem: 小明想说“我唱歌不好，可我很喜欢音乐课”。他这样写，你同意吗？
work: I can't sing well, because I really like music class.
right: “很喜欢音乐课”不是“唱歌不好”的原因，前后意思相反，
要用 but：I can't sing well, but I really like music class.

ladder.q: 填 but 或 because：I like PE ____ it's exciting.
填 but 或 because：I want to play, ____ I have a lot of homework.
填 but 或 because：History is hard for me, ____ I like it ____ it's interesting.

items.lesson: Section B What can you learn from different subjects?
lessons: What can you learn from different subjects
items.topic: let 后面的代词和动词
items.stem: Our IT teacher ____ the computers after class.
right: lets 后面用宾格 us，再直接接动词原形：
lets us use（让我们用）。
typical: “让我们去用电脑”，两个动词之间加 to：
Our IT teacher lets us to use ...

ladder.q: Let ____ (we) go to the music room.
Our PE teacher lets us ____ (choose) the games.
Mum doesn't let ____ (he) ____ (watch) TV after 9:00.

items.stem: work 中的 or 读 /ɜː/。哪个词里的 or 也读 /ɜː/？
right: worse 中 or 跟在 w 后读 /ɜː/，和 work 一样；
short 中 or 读 /ɔː/，doctor 词尾的 or 读 /ə/。

ladder.q: /ɜː/ 还是 /ə/：first，better
找出含 /ɜː/ 的词：early，October，after
按元音分两组：dirty，doctor，thirteen，ever

items.lesson: Section A How do you choose a school club?
lessons: How do you choose a school club
items.stem: My sister ____ the piano very well.
right: can 是情态动词，没有人称变化，
后面直接跟动词原形：can play。
typical: 主语 my sister 是三单，动词加 s：
My sister can plays the piano.

ladder.q: He can ____ (swim) very well.
改成一般疑问句：Tom can speak English.
—Can your brother play chess? —No, he ____.

items.lesson: Section B What can you learn in a school club?
lessons: What can you learn in a school club
items.stem: Mia 想加入烹饪社，她写道：I'm good at ____ noodles.
right: at 是介词，后面接名词或动词 -ing：
I'm good at making noodles.

ladder.q: She is good at ____ (swim).
I'm interested in ____ (draw) animals.
Are you good at ____ (run)? Join our running club!

items.unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life
items.lesson: Section A How do you spend your school day?
lessons: How do you spend your school day
items.topic: 时间介词 in 与 on
items.stem: 小红说下面这句话写得对。你同意吗？
work: We have PE on Friday afternoon.
right: 说具体某一天的上午、下午、晚上用 on，
on Friday afternoon 没错，小红说得对。

ladder.q: We have music ____ Monday.
I do my homework ____ the evening.
We have a party ____ the evening of 31st December.

items.unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life
items.lesson: Section A How do you spend your school day?
lessons: How do you spend your school day
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Wang Hao usually ____ (go) to school at 7:20 and ____ (watch) TV after dinner.
right: 主语 Wang Hao 是三单，动词要变；
以 o、ch 结尾的加 es：goes，watches。
typical: “他去上学”和“我去上学”一样，不用变：go，watch

ladder.q: She ____ (do) her homework at six.
My father ____ (have) breakfast at 7:00.
Tom and his brother ____ (brush) their teeth at 9:00.

items.unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life
items.lesson: Section B How different are people's daily routines?
lessons: How different are people's daily routines
items.topic: 用 past 和 to 说时间
items.stem: Lin Tao 每天 4:15 去打篮球。4:15 用英语怎么说？
right: 英语先说分钟，再说钟点：15 分钟是 a quarter；
刚过 4 点用 past：a quarter past four（也可说 four fifteen）。

ladder.q: 用 past 说 6:30
用 to 说 4:45
Lin Tao 8:40 上床睡觉，用 to 说这个时间

items.lesson: Section A How do we celebrate birthdays?
items.stem: 想问“这条短裤多少钱”，哪句对？
right: 问价钱用 How much；
shorts 总是复数形式，要用 these 和 are。

ladder.q: How much ____ (be) the green sweater?
—How much are the socks? —____ 20 yuan.
How much ____ (be) this pair of trousers?

items.lesson: Section A How do we celebrate birthdays?
items.stem: 写出序数词：nine → ____，twelve → ____
right: nine 去掉 e 再加 th：ninth；
twelve 把 ve 变成 f 再加 th：twelfth。
typical: 序数词就是在后面加 th：nineth，twelveth

ladder.q: five → ____
twenty → ____
写成单词：22nd，31st

items.lesson: Section B How do you make your birthday meaningful?
lessons: How do you make your birthday meaningful
items.topic: 日期前用 on 还是 in
items.stem: 小红写了这句话，她说写得对。你同意吗？
work: We plant trees on 12th March every year.
right: 说到具体的某一天用 on：on 12th March；
只说月份才用 in：in March。所以小红写得对。

ladder.q: My birthday is ____ May.
Teachers' Day is ____ 10th September.
We eat birthday noodles ____ the morning of my birthday.

items.lesson: Section A Why do you like animals?
items.stem: “因为熊猫可爱，所以我喜欢它们。”哪句对？
options: I like pandas because they're cute.
Because pandas are cute, so I like them.
I like pandas because they cute.
right: because 和 so 只能用一个；
because 后面要跟完整的句子：because they're cute。
typical: Because pandas are cute, so I like them.

ladder.q: 用 so 改写：I like koalas because they're cute.
ladder.a: Koalas are cute, so I like them.

ladder.q: —____ do you like elephants? —Because they're smart.
用 because 说一句：我不喜欢狮子，因为它们很吓人。
ladder.a: I don't like lions because they're scary.

items.lesson: Unit 1 The secrets of happiness (Starting out & Understanding ideas 1)
items.topic: 分清他人观点与作者观点
items.stem: Some people think a big house makes a family happy. But in fact, time together is more important. 作者认为？
options: 大房子能让一家人幸福
一家人在一起的时间更重要
大房子和在一起的时间一样重要
right: Some people think… 引出的是别人的看法；
But in fact 后面才是作者的看法：在一起的时间更重要。
typical: 第一句就说大房子让家幸福，
所以作者认为大房子最重要

ladder.q: Many people think money brings happiness. But I think friends do. 作者认为什么带来幸福？
找出引出别人看法的词：Some students say homework is boring. In fact, it helps us.
用 Some people think… But in fact… 说说你对周末的看法。
ladder.a: 如 Some people think TV is fun. But in fact, sports are more fun.

items.lesson: Section B How are animals part of our lives?
lessons: How are animals part of our lives
items.topic: What is it like 问什么
items.stem: 动物帖子提纲里有 What does it look like? 和 What is it like?。哪一句该写在 What is it like? 下面？
options: It's small and has a long tail.
right: What is it like? 问性格、脾气：gentle、friendly；
问长相要说 What does it look like? 答 small、a long tail。
typical: What is it like? 里有 like，就写长相：
It's small and has a long tail.

ladder.q: What does it look like? 问的是长相还是性格？
补全：—What ____ the dog ____? —It's friendly and playful.
补全：—What ____ the giraffe ____ ____? —It's tall with a long neck.

items.lesson: Unit 1 The secrets of happiness (Understanding ideas 2)
items.stem: Last Sunday, my brother and I ____ a kite in the park.
right: Last Sunday 说的是过去的事，用一般过去时；
fly 是不规则动词，过去式是 flew，不是 flied。
typical: try 变 tried，fly 也一样：
y 变 i 加 ed → flied

ladder.q: 写出过去式：try，study，fly
Yesterday Lucy ____ (carry) a box and ____ (find) a cat in it.
Last winter we ____ (go) to Harbin and ____ (see) lots of snow.

items.lesson: Unit 1 The secrets of happiness (Developing ideas 1)
items.topic: 听调查：做法、结果与结论
items.stem: 听一份调查报告，哪一句是调查的结论（conclusion）？
options: We asked 40 students about their sleep.
25 of them sleep less than 8 hours.
So most students need more sleep.
right: 结论是从结果里得出的看法，常用 So 引出；
第一句说怎么调查，第二句是数字结果。
typical: 有具体数字的那句最重要，

ladder.q: 做法、结果还是结论：We showed 30 students a photo.
做法、结果还是结论：20 of them said they liked it.
根据结果写一句结论：35 of 40 students walk to school.
ladder.a: 如 So most students walk to school.

items.lesson: Unit 1 The secrets of happiness (Developing ideas 2)
items.stem: I always look on the bright side. ____, I lost a match last week, but I learned a lot from it.
right: 空格后是一个完整的句子，用 For example, 引出；
such as 后只接名词（短语）；Take 后先说例子：Take me for example.
typical: Such as, I lost a match…

ladder.q: I like sports ____ swimming and running. (such as / for example)
My cat makes me happy. ____, she waits for me at the door every day.
用 Take … for example 写一句，举一个让你开心的人。
ladder.a: 如 Take my grandma for example. She…

items.lesson: Unit 1 The secrets of happiness (Developing ideas 3)
items.stem: 写故事要有人物（characters）、背景（setting）和事件（events）。哪句交代的是 setting？
options: It happened on a rainy Sunday in the park.
Lily is a shy girl with long hair.
She helped an old man find his lost dog.
right: setting 交代故事发生的时间和地点：
a rainy Sunday 是时间，in the park 是地点。
typical: 故事开头先介绍主人公，
所以 Lily is a shy girl… 是背景

ladder.q: 时间、地点还是人物：last winter
找出 setting：One evening, at the bus stop, Tom met an old friend.
ladder.a: One evening, at the bus stop

ladder.q: 为你的故事写一句 setting（时间 + 地点）。
ladder.a: 如 It was a cold morning at my school.

items.stem: 哪个词里有和 now 相同的元音？
right: town 中 ow 的读音和 now、how、down 一样；
know 中 ow 和 go 的元音一样，soup 中 ou 读 /uː/。

ladder.q: ow 的读音和 now 一样吗？how，show
ou 的读音和 about 一样吗？mouth，you
找出元音和另外两个不同的词：down，house，slow

items.lesson: Unit 2 Go for it! (Starting out & Understanding ideas 1)
items.stem: 班长致谢：Thanks to Tom and Amy. Last but not least, thanks to Ms Li. 这里 last but not least 是什么意思？
options: 排在最后，所以最不重要
right: last but not least 用在列举的最后：
这一项最后才说，但和前面的一样重要。
typical: 所以最后感谢的老师最不重要

ladder.q: Last but not least 常放在一段话的什么位置？
把“最后同样重要的是，要多喝水”译成英语。
ladder.a: Last but not least, drink more water.

ladder.q: 用 Last but not least 写一句，说出运动的最后一个好处。
ladder.a: 如 Last but not least, sports make us happy.

items.stem: Ann could have tea or juice, but she had ____ of them. She just drank water.
right: 她只喝了水，茶和果汁两样都没喝；
“两者都不”用 neither，either 是“两者中任何一个”。

ladder.q: I have two cousins. ____ of them lives near me. They both live far away.
You can sit in ____ chair. Both are free.
There are 40 students in our class. ____ of them was late today.

items.stem: 校广播：Wang Lei ran 100 metres in 12.5 seconds and broke the school record! 这是说？
options: 王磊把学校的记录本弄坏了
王磊跑出了学校最好的成绩
right: break a record 是“打破纪录”：
成绩超过了学校以前最好的成绩。
typical: 所以他把学校的记录本弄坏了

ladder.q: break a record 是什么意思？
She ____ (break) the city record last year.
用 break a record 写一句，说说你想打破的纪录。
ladder.a: 如 I want to break the school record in the long jump.

items.stem: 同学说：I joined the school swimming team today! 怎样回应最好？
right: 对方分享好消息，要用积极、鼓励的话回应：
That's great to hear! / Wonderful!
typical: 就回 I'm sorry to hear that.

ladder.q: —I got a gold medal! —____ (写一句积极的回应)
ladder.a: 如 Wonderful! / That's great to hear!

ladder.q: —I hurt my foot. 回 I'm sorry to hear that. 还是 Wonderful!？
—I run every morning now. 写一句积极回应，再追问一个问题。
ladder.a: 如 Good to know! How far do you run?

items.stem: “多亏了刻苦训练，她们赢了比赛。”哪句对？
options: Thanks for their hard training, they won.
Thanks to they trained hard, they won.
Thanks to their hard training, they won.
right: thanks to 意为“多亏、由于”，后接名词短语：
thanks to their hard training；Thanks for… 是向人道谢。

ladder.q: ____ my friends, I wasn't afraid on my first day. (Thanks to / Thanks for)
改错：Thanks to she helped me, I found the way.
ladder.a: Thanks to her help, I found the way.

ladder.q: 用 thanks to 写一句，说说你进步的原因。
ladder.a: 如 Thanks to my teacher, I'm better at English.

items.stem: 哪个词的元音和 there 相同？
right: hair、chair、bear 和 there 的元音相同；
here 和 near 押韵，her 和 bird 的元音相同。
typical: here 和 there 都以 ere 结尾，

ladder.q: 元音和 near 一样吗？clear，pear
元音和 chair 一样吗？where，here
找出元音和另外两个不同的词：care，bear，ear

items.lesson: Section A What rules do we follow?
items.stem: 小明给春游写了一条提醒。你同意这样写吗？
work: Don't late for the football game.
right: late 是形容词，不能直接跟在 Don't 后面，
要加 be：Don't be late for the school bus.

ladder.q: Don't ____ (run) on the stairs.
Don't ____ noisy in the library.
Don't ____ (forget) your homework, and don't ____ late.

items.lesson: Section B How can rules help us?
items.stem: “每天早上，Mia 必须先遛狗。”Every morning, Mia ____ the dog first.
right: 主语 Mia 是三单，用 has to；
to 后面的动词用原形：has to walk。
typical: Mia 是三单，两个词都变：
Mia has to walks the dog first.

ladder.q: We ____ (必须) wear the school uniform.
Tom ____ (必须) wear a helmet when he rides a bike.
改错：She must to keeps her phone in the locker.

items.lesson: Unit 3 Food matters (Starting out & Understanding ideas 1)
items.stem: When I miss home, I cook Grandma's noodles. Their smell brings back happy days. 最好的标题是？
options: My home in a bowl of noodles
How to cook noodles at home
right: 短文讲的是奶奶的面条让“我”想起家，
标题要概括全文，不只说做法，也不能大过内容。
typical: 所以标题是 How to cook noodles

ladder.q: 短文只讲我家的饺子，标题 Chinese food 太大还是正好？
短文讲爷爷每天陪我跑步，选标题：Running shoes / Running with Grandpa
起个标题：Every Spring Festival, my family makes dumplings together. We laugh a lot.

items.stem: “妈妈做的汤闻起来很香。”哪句对？
right: smell 在这里是系动词，意为“闻起来”，
后面接形容词 nice，前面不再加 is。

ladder.q: The bread feels ____ (soft / softly).
Your idea ____ great! (sounds / is sounds)
用 look 或 taste 写一句，描述你喜欢的食物。

items.stem: A: Fried chicken is great for dinner. B: Hold on. It has too much fat. B 是在？
options: 不同意 A 的看法
请 A 等他一下，他马上就来
right: 讨论中 Hold on 常用来打断并表示不同意，
后面接自己的理由：It has too much fat.
typical: 所以 B 让 A 等他一下

ladder.q: 哪句说明对方不同意？That's true. / That's not true.
—Milk is bad for us. —Hold ____. I don't agree. Milk is good for our bones.
用 I don't agree 回应：Vegetables are boring.
ladder.a: 如 I don't agree. They're healthy and tasty.

items.stem: Ann 说：Bananas are a kind of vegetable. Ben 这样回应。你同意 Ben 的做法吗？
work: Actually, bananas are a kind of fruit.
right: Ann 说错了，Ben 用 Actually 引出正确的信息，
语气平和，没有说 You're wrong!，是礼貌的纠正。

ladder.q: 用 In fact 开头纠正：Tomatoes are bad for us.
ladder.a: In fact, tomatoes are good for us.

ladder.q: 哪种纠正更礼貌：You're wrong! / Actually, …
用 Actually 纠正：We should only drink juice, not water.
ladder.a: 如 Actually, we need to drink water every day.

items.stem: 选出意思是“这种饼和比萨很像”的句子。
options: This pancake likes pizza a lot.
This pancake is a lot like pizza.
This pancake is a lot of pizza.
right: a lot like 意为“很像”，这里的 like 是“像”，
不是动词“喜欢”：sth is a lot like sth。
typical: This pancake likes pizza a lot.

ladder.q: Lily is a lot like her mum. 是什么意思？
This cake looks a lot ____ a hat. (like / likes)
用 a lot like 写一句，说说两样很像的东西。
ladder.a: 如 My pancake is a lot like Mum's.

items.topic: 单词结尾的 /d/ 怎么读
items.stem: 读 food、bread 这样以 /d/ 结尾的词，结尾应该怎么读？
options: 读成“得”，后面带出一个“呃”
读出轻轻的 /d/，后面不带元音
结尾的 /d/ 不读，只读前面
right: 舌尖抵住上齿龈，读出 /d/ 就停：food、bread；
后面不加“呃”，也不能把 /d/ 吞掉。
typical: 汉语的字大多以元音收尾，
就把 food 读成 foo-de

ladder.q: 读 good 时，结尾要不要带出一个“呃”？
去掉结尾的 /d/，card 会变成哪个词？
找出结尾音是 /d/ 的词：sat，salad，help

items.lesson: Section A How often do you do sport or exercise?
lessons: How often do you do sport or exercise
items.stem: —Whose water bottle is this? —It's ____. Thanks!
right: 空后面没有名词，要用名词性物主代词：
mine = my water bottle。It's mine.

ladder.q: This pencil isn't ____ (I). It's Tom's.
—Is this Jenny's eraser? —Yes, it's ____.
My pen is red. ____ (你的) is blue.

items.lesson: Section A How often do you do sport or exercise?
lessons: How often do you do sport or exercise
items.topic: 对 Twice a week 提问
items.stem: —____ do you exercise? —Twice a week.
right: Twice a week 说的是“多久一次”，问频率用 how often；
how long 问多长时间，答语像 For an hour.
typical: 汉语问“多久”，就用 how long：

ladder.q: —____ does he go to the movies? —Once a month.
—____ do you sleep every night? —About eight hours.
—How ____ times a week do you play tennis? —Three times.

items.lesson: Section B How is exercise good for us?
lessons: How is exercise good for us
items.stem: —Whose basketball is this? —It's ____. Ken and I play with it every day.（我们的）
right: 空后面没有名词，用名词性物主代词：
ours = our basketball。It's ours.

ladder.q: —Whose jump rope is this? —It's ____.（我的）
Their skateboards are new, but ____ are old.（我们的）
改错：This cap isn't Mary's. Her's is blue.

items.unit: Unit 4 The art of having fun
items.lesson: Unit 4 The art of having fun (Starting out & Understanding ideas 1)
items.stem: 短文标题 All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy 想说什么？
options: 讲一个叫 Jack 的男孩的故事
只工作不玩耍，人会变得呆板
玩比学习和工作更重要
right: 这是一句谚语，Jack 泛指任何人：
只工作、不玩耍，人就会变得呆板无趣，要劳逸结合。
typical: 所以短文讲的是 Jack 这个男孩

ladder.q: dull 在标题里是什么意思？
谚语 Practice makes perfect. 是什么意思？
用一句英语劝同学学习之余也要玩一玩。
ladder.a: 如 Don't just study. Have some fun, too!

items.unit: Unit 4 The art of having fun
items.lesson: Unit 4 The art of having fun (Understanding ideas 2)
items.stem: 鼓励新同学：“别害羞，加入我们吧！”哪句对？
right: shy 是形容词，祈使句要先加 be：Be shy；
否定在前面加 Don't：Don't be shy.

ladder.q: ____ (not / be) late for the film!
____ (not / forget) to bring your ticket.
给电影社写两条规则：一条用 Don't be，一条用 Don't + 动词。
ladder.a: 如 Don't be noisy. Don't eat in the room.

items.unit: Unit 4 The art of having fun
items.lesson: Unit 4 The art of having fun (Developing ideas 1)
items.stem: 听到：The new pool is over 50 metres long. 笔记该怎么记？
right: over 放在数字前，意思是“超过、多于”：
over 50 metres 就是比 50 米长。

ladder.q: over 100 people 是多少人？
over 3 hours 可能是 2 小时 50 分吗？
听到 He has over 500 stamps. 记下他有多少邮票。

items.unit: Unit 4 The art of having fun
items.lesson: Unit 4 The art of having fun (Developing ideas 2)
items.stem: 采访时对方说：I started to collect stamps at the age of eight. 哪句是在追问细节？
options: Can you tell me more about it?
right: Can you tell me more…? 请对方展开说，
也可以问 Why did you…? 了解更多细节。

ladder.q: 对方说 I love painting. 写一个 Why 追问。
ladder.a: 如 Why do you love painting?

ladder.q: 对方说 I set up a club. 用 Can you tell me more…? 追问。
ladder.a: Can you tell me more about the club?

ladder.q: 对方说 I went to an insect museum. 写两个追问。
ladder.a: 如 Where is it? What did you see there?

items.unit: Unit 4 The art of having fun
items.lesson: Unit 4 The art of having fun (Developing ideas 3)
items.stem: My uncle is a couch potato at weekends. 这是说叔叔周末？
options: 总窝在沙发上看电视，不爱动
喜欢坐在沙发上吃土豆
right: couch potato 是固定说法，
指整天窝在沙发里看电视、不爱运动的人。
typical: couch 是沙发，potato 是土豆，
所以是在沙发上吃土豆

ladder.q: 说一个人是 couch potato，是夸他还是批评他？
I don't want to be a couch potato, so I ____ every evening. (jog / watch TV)
写一句话，劝 couch potato 出去活动。
ladder.a: 如 Turn off the TV and play ball with us!

items.unit: Unit 4 The art of having fun
items.stem: 读 very、visit 开头的 /v/ 时，嘴巴该怎么做？
options: 上齿轻触下唇，声带振动
双唇收圆，像读 we 的开头
上齿轻触下唇，声带不振动
right: /v/ 和 /f/ 口形相同：上齿轻触下唇；
读 /v/ 声带振动，读 /f/ 声带不振动。
typical: 所以双唇收圆，读成 wery

ladder.q: 摸着喉咙读 fun 和 very 的开头，哪个在振动？
/f/ 还是 /v/：life，video
找出含 /v/ 的词：wave，fun，five

items.lesson: Section A What do we like to eat?
lessons: What do we like to eat
items.topic: 请人吃喝：some 还是 any
items.stem: 服务员这样问客人。小红说这句话没有错，你同意吗？
work: Would you like some soup?
right: 请对方吃、喝，盼着对方说“要”时，疑问句用 some。
问“有没有”时常用 any：Do you have any soup?

ladder.q: I'd like ____ beef noodles, please.
Are there ____ tomatoes in the fridge?
—Can I have ____ juice, please? —Sure.

items.lesson: Section A What do we like to eat?
lessons: What do we like to eat
items.stem: “我喜欢饼干和牛奶。”哪句对？
right: 泛指一类可数的东西用复数：cookies；
milk 不可数，不加 s。

ladder.q: Do you like ____ (sandwich)?
I have some ____ (milk) for breakfast.
My brother likes ____ (dumpling) and ____ (rice).

items.lesson: Section B How do we make healthy eating choices?
lessons: How do we make healthy eating choices
items.topic: too many 还是 too much
items.stem: 小明写同学的不良饮食习惯。你同意这样写吗？
work: Tom eats too much cookies.
right: cookies 是可数名词复数，要用 too many：Tom eats too many cookies.
too much 用在不可数名词前：too much sugar。

ladder.q: Don't eat too ____ hamburgers.
This soup has too ____ salt.
改错：I drink too many juice and eat too much eggs.
ladder.a: many juice → much juice；much eggs → many eggs

items.lesson: Unit 5 Amazing nature (Starting out & Understanding ideas 1)
items.stem: 毕业时，Lily 对老师说：Words can't express my thanks to you. 她的意思是？
options: 她非常感谢，言语都表达不了
right: Words can't express… 是说感情太深，
用语言都表达不出来，表示非常感谢。
typical: can't express 就是说不出来，
所以她不会用英语道谢

ladder.q: Words can't express how happy I am. 他高兴吗？
把“我对大海的爱无法用语言表达”译成英语。
ladder.a: Words can't express my love for the sea.

ladder.q: 用 Words can't express… 写一句，说说你喜欢的地方。
ladder.a: 如 Words can't express my love for Hainan.

items.stem: Lake A is 30 metres deep. Lake B is 80 metres deep. Lake B is ____ Lake A.
right: 两个湖相比，用比较级 + than：deep → deeper；
单音节词加 -er，不用 more，也不用最高级。
typical: Lake B is more deep than Lake A.

ladder.q: This river is ____ (long) than that one.
Of the three mountains, Mount A is the ____ (high).
用比较级说一句：A 山高 900 米，B 山高 1,500 米。
ladder.a: 如 Mountain B is higher than Mountain A.

items.stem: 博物馆广告：Open 8:30–16:30. Closed on Wednesdays. 哪个时间可以去参观？
right: 16:30 是下午 4 点半，星期四下午 3 点在开放时间内；
Closed on Wednesdays 表示星期三闭馆。
typical: 所以星期三上午可以去

ladder.q: 16:30 是下午几点？
Closed on Sundays. 星期天能去吗？
The zoo is open 8:00–18:00, closed on Tuesdays. 写出一个能去的时间。
ladder.a: 如 星期三下午 3 点

items.stem: 导游正在介绍一种动物。你同意小明的做法吗？
work: 导游话说到一半，小明就大声问：Why? Why?
right: 不要在别人一句话说到一半时打断；
等这句说完，用 Excuse me 或 Sorry 礼貌地提问。

ladder.q: 想打断导游提问，开头先说什么？
补全：Sorry to ____, but could you explain more?
导游说 This plant can close its leaves. 礼貌地打断并提问。
ladder.a: 如 Excuse me. Why does it close its leaves?

items.stem: 店员说：We'll send the bike to your home within three days. 意思是？
right: within three days 是“三天之内”：
今天、明天、后天送到都算，不会超过三天。
typical: 就以为要等三天以后才送到

ladder.q: within a week 是什么意思？
“两天之内回复你”：I'll answer you ____ two days. (within / after)
用 within 说：请在 10 分钟之内完成。

items.stem: 有同学把 think 读成了 sink。读 think 开头的音时应该？
options: 舌尖留在齿后，像读 s
上齿轻触下唇，像读 f
舌尖轻放在上下齿之间送气
right: think 的 th 读 /θ/：舌尖轻放在上下齿之间，
送气，声带不振动；读 /s/ 时舌尖不伸到齿间。
typical: think 读成 sink 也行

ladder.q: 读 three 时舌尖放在哪里？
th 的读音相同吗：thank，this
找出 th 读音和 mouth 相同的词：they，thing，then

items.lesson: Section A What are you doing right now?
lessons: What are you doing right now
items.stem: Listen! Grandpa ____ in the garden.
right: Listen! 提示事情正在发生，用现在进行时：
am/is/are + 动词-ing：Grandpa is singing.

ladder.q: Look! The boys ____ (play) soccer.
—What ____ you ____ (do)? —I'm reading.
写 -ing 形式：swim，write，sit

items.lesson: Section B How do we share our lives with others?
lessons: How do we share our lives with others
items.stem: It's eight in the morning. Look! Many people ____ for the bus now.
right: people 是复数，be 动词用 are；
Look! 和 now 说此刻，用 are waiting。
typical: people 没有 s，当成一个人：
Many people is waiting for the bus.

ladder.q: The children ____ (play) in the park now.
Look! Some people ____ (fly) kites.
改错：Look! The people is dancing in the square.

items.lesson: Project Draw a group of flats
items.stem: — Where's Flat 201? — ____（在二楼）
right: “第二层”用 second，不用 two；
在某一层楼用 on：It's on the second floor.

ladder.q: 补全：Flat 302 is on the ____ floor.（三楼）
补全：My grandparents live ____ the third floor.
用英语说：我们住在五楼。
ladder.a: We live on the fifth floor.

items.lesson: Unit 6 Hitting the road (Starting out & Understanding ideas 1)
items.stem: 读到：The robot show was so cool! We all clapped. 你同意小林的理解吗？
work: 小林：cool 在这里是“凉快”的意思。
right: 大家为机器人表演鼓掌，说明表演很精彩；
cool 在这里是“很棒、很酷”，不是“凉快”。

ladder.q: It's cool today. Take a jacket. 这里 cool 指什么？
Your new bike is so cool! 这里 cool 指什么？
用 cool 写一句，表示“很棒”。

items.stem: Tom 和 Ben 都是 13 岁。Tom is ____ Ben.
right: 两人一样大，用 as…as 表示“和……一样”；
两个 as 之间用形容词原级：as old as。
typical: 比较两个人就用比较级：
Tom is as older as Ben.

ladder.q: This box is as ____ (heavy) as that one.
My room isn't as ____ (big) as yours.
用 as…as 写一句：骑车和跑步一样有趣。
ladder.a: Riding a bike is as fun as running.

items.stem: 视频博主说：On my trips, I don't just eat the local food. I also learn to cook it. 哪句对？
options: 他旅行时不吃当地菜，只学做菜
他旅行时只吃当地菜，不学做菜
他旅行时既吃当地菜，也学着做
right: not just 意为“不只是”：他吃当地菜，但不只是吃；
also 后面是另一件事：还学着做。
typical: 所以他旅行时不吃当地菜

ladder.q: I don't just read. I also write. 他写不写？
把“她不只唱歌，还跳舞”译成英语。
ladder.a: She doesn't just sing. She also dances.

ladder.q: 用 I don't just… I also… 说说你的周末。
ladder.a: 如 I don't just study. I also play ball.

items.stem: 朋友说：We missed the train and waited for six hours! 怎样回应最合适？
right: 对方遇到坏事，用 Oh dear! / How awful! 表示惊讶和同情；
Really? / Amazing! 用在好消息后面。
typical: 听到让人吃惊的事就说：

ladder.q: —I swam with dolphins! 回 Really? 还是 Oh dear!？
—My bike broke on the trip. 写一句表示惊讶和同情。
—I travelled across China by bike! 先表示惊讶，再追问一个问题。
ladder.a: 如 Amazing! How long did it take?

items.stem: 介绍一位旅行家，评价要尊重、客观。哪句最好？
options: He walked across China. I respect his courage.
He was the greatest man and was never wrong.
His trips were silly and a waste of time.
right: 客观：用事实说话（走遍中国）；
尊重：说出自己的敬意，不夸大，也不贬低。
typical: 介绍伟人就要夸到最高：

ladder.q: 客观还是不客观：He is perfect in every way.
改得客观些：Xu Xiake was the best person in the world.
ladder.a: 如 Xu Xiake made many discoveries.

ladder.q: 为一位你知道的旅行家写一句客观的评价。
ladder.a: 如 He visited many places and wrote about them.

items.stem: 哪个词的开头和 shop 的开头读音相同？
right: sure 虽然以 s 开头，开头却读 /ʃ/，和 shop、she 一样；
sea 开头读 /s/，chair 开头读 /tʃ/。
typical: shop 和 sea 开头听起来差不多，

ladder.q: 开头是 /ʃ/ 还是 /s/：she，see
找出含 /tʃ/ 的词：shoe，teacher，fish
找出含 /ʒ/ 的词：usually，sugar，she

items.lesson: Section A What’s the weather like?
items.topic: usually 与 now 的时态
items.stem: Tom usually ____ to school. It's raining today. Look! He ____ for the bus now.
right: usually 说平时的习惯，用一般现在时：walks；
Look! 和 now 说此刻正在发生，用现在进行时：is waiting。
typical: 学了进行时，两个空都用 be + -ing：
Tom is usually walking to school.

ladder.q: In Harbin, it often ____ (snow) in winter.
Look! It ____ (snow) outside now.
My dad usually ____ (drive) to work. Look! He ____ (ride) a bike today.

items.lesson: Section B How do we feel about the weather?
lessons: How do we feel about the weather
items.stem: 在海边 Lily 发帖写了这句。有人说这句写得对，你同意吗？
work: Although it's windy, we're still having fun on the beach.
right: although 已经表示“虽然”，后面不能再加 but；
这句写得对。也可以说：It's windy, but we're still …

ladder.q: 用 although 连接：It's raining. We're still playing.
ladder.a: Although it's raining, we're still playing.

ladder.q: 用 but 改写：Although I'm tired, I feel happy.
ladder.a: I'm tired, but I feel happy.

ladder.q: 改错：Although it's cold, but they're skating.

items.lesson: Section A What was your special day like?
lessons: What was your special day like
items.stem: —____ you ____ any horses on the farm? —Yes, I did.
right: 实义动词的过去时问句：Did + 主语 + 动词原形，
Did you see any horses?
typical: 过去的事，动词用过去式：

ladder.q: ____ you ____ (go) to the zoo yesterday?
改成一般疑问句：She took many photos.
改成否定句：They visited a fire station.
ladder.a: They didn't visit a fire station.

items.lesson: Section B What did you learn on that special day?
lessons: What did you learn on that special day
items.stem: 填空：Yesterday my grandma ____ (teach) me how to ____ (make) dumplings.
right: yesterday 说过去：teach 是不规则动词，过去式 taught；
how to 后面用动词原形：to make。
typical: 昨天的事，动词全改成过去式：
taught me how to made dumplings

ladder.q: Last Sunday we ____ (go) to a tea garden.
We wanted to ____ (buy) some tea for Grandpa.
Our teacher ____ (show) us how to ____ (plant) a tree.

items.lesson: Section A What are your favourite stories?
items.topic: 故事里的不规则过去式
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Once upon a time, a farmer ____ (go) to the market and ____ (buy) a cow.
right: 讲故事说的是过去的事，用一般过去时；
go、buy 是不规则动词：went，bought。

ladder.q: Long ago, an old man ____ (tell) the children a story.
The king ____ (give) the boy a horse, and the boy ____ (feel) happy.
The fox ____ (run) away, and the rabbit ____ (find) its way home.

items.lesson: Section B What can stories teach us?
items.stem: Mike 只读了 The Ugly Duckling 的前一半，就说：“He's a duck.” 读完全文，哪个回应最站得住？
options: No. At the lake, he saw he was a swan.
Yes. He swam as well as the ducks.
right: 结尾他在湖水里看见：自己是一只白天鹅；
会游泳、鸭妈妈的话，都证明不了他是鸭子。
typical: 鸭妈妈说 He's still a duck，

ladder.q: Who said, “He's still a duck like us!”?
The other birds thought he was ugly. Were they right?
ladder.a: No. He was a beautiful swan.

ladder.q: He swam well. Does that prove he was a duck? Why?

items.lesson: Section A How do people spend their holidays ?
lessons: How do people spend their holidays
items.stem: We saw ____ in the museum.
right: 形容词修饰 something 等不定代词时放在后面；
肯定句用 something：something interesting。

ladder.q: 用 something 或 anything 填空：There's ____ (new) on the blackboard.
用 something 或 anything 填空：I didn't buy ____ (special) for myself.
I have ____ ____ to do today.（我今天没什么特别的事要做。）

items.topic: 现在完成时的过去分词
items.stem: Mia has ____ three short stories this term.
right: 现在完成时：has + 过去分词；
write 的变化是 write–wrote–written。
typical: 写故事是过去做的事，用过去式：
Mia has wrote three short stories.

ladder.q: Tom has ____ (eat) all the strawberries.
I have ____ (see) that film twice.
用现在完成时填空：She ____ (lose) her key, so she can't get in.

items.lesson: Section B What can we learn from holiday experiences?
lessons: What can we learn from holiday experiences
items.topic: so 与 such 怎么选
items.stem: It was ____ a long trip that we slept on the bus. But the beach was ____ beautiful!
right: a long trip 是名词短语，前面用 such：such a long trip that…
beautiful 是形容词，前面用 so：so beautiful。
typical: It was so a long trip that we slept on the bus.

ladder.q: 填 so 或 such：The soup is ____ hot that I can't eat it.
填 so 或 such：She is ____ a kind girl that everyone likes her.
用 such…that 合成一句：It was a hot day. We stayed at home.
ladder.a: It was such a hot day that we stayed at home.

items.stem: 介绍一本书时，哪句说的是书的 message（想告诉读者的道理）？
options: It teaches us to be kind to animals.
It's about a boy who loses his dog.
It's the best book I have ever read.
right: message 是书想告诉读者的道理，常说 It teaches us...；
另两句分别是情节（plot）和读者自己的评价。

ladder.q: 说的是 plot 还是 message：It tells us that home is the best place.
说的是 writer、setting 还是 plot：The story happens in a small village.
用 It teaches us... 说说《小马过河》的 message。
ladder.a: 如 It teaches us to try things for ourselves.

items.stem: You can go out to play as long as you finish your homework. 这句话的意思是：
options: 你玩的时间要和写作业的一样长。
你可以玩很久，作业以后再写。
只要你写完作业，就可以出去玩。
right: as long as 意为“只要”，后面接条件：
写完作业，是出去玩的条件。
typical: as...as 是“和……一样”，long 是“长”，
所以是玩的时间和写作业一样长。

ladder.q: as long as 是什么意思：You can use my bike as long as you are careful.
翻译：As long as we work together, we can win.
ladder.a: 只要我们齐心协力，就能赢。

ladder.q: 用 as long as 连成一句：Try hard. You will get better.
ladder.a: As long as you try hard, you will get better.

items.stem: 哪个词以 /ŋ/ 结尾（和 long、young 的结尾音一样）？
right: song 结尾的 ng 读 /ŋ/，和 long、young 一样；
thank 结尾是 /ŋk/，最后还有 /k/；sun 结尾是 /n/。
typical: 结尾和 long 一样都是 /ŋ/

ladder.q: /n/ 还是 /ŋ/：thin，thing
找出结尾读 /n/ 的词：wing，win，king
按结尾音分两组：sing，sin，ran，rang

items.stem: Grandpa has kept this old radio ____.
right: 收音机一直保存到现在，用现在完成时 + 一段时间；
twenty years 是一段时间，前面用 for。
typical: has kept this radio since twenty years

ladder.q: for 还是 since：We have known Lily ____ 2021.
for 还是 since：My cat has slept ____ three hours.
I bought this bike two years ago. = I ____ this bike for two years.

items.stem: 朋友难过地说：“I lost my new phone today.” 哪句回应是在安慰他？
options: Great! Let's go and play ball.
right: 对方难过时，先表示理解：I'm sorry to hear that.
That sounds difficult. 也是常用的安慰话。
typical: 他不小心才丢的，提醒他下次注意：

ladder.q: 哪句是安慰：A. I see. That sounds difficult. B. That's your problem.
朋友说 My grandma is ill. 用一句话安慰他。
ladder.a: 如 I'm sorry to hear that.

ladder.q: 朋友说 I failed the test. 先安慰，再鼓励，说两句。
ladder.a: 如 I'm sorry to hear that. You'll do better next time.

items.stem: 诗歌常用押韵。下面哪组词押韵（结尾的音相同）？
right: 押韵看结尾的读音：light、kite 结尾都读 /aɪt/；
home、come 拼写像，但 come 里的 o 读 /ʌ/，不押韵。
typical: home 和 come 结尾都是 ome，

ladder.q: 哪个词和 day 押韵：dog，play，dry
哪个词和 said 押韵：paid，red，rain
写出一个和 night 押韵、但拼写不同的词。

items.stem: who 开头读 /h/。哪个词开头的音和 who 一样？
right: who、how 开头都读 /h/；
what 中的 wh 读 /w/，hour 中的 h 不发音。
typical: who 和 what 都以 wh 开头，

ladder.q: 哪个词开头读 /h/：whole，why，what
哪个词开头的 h 不发音：hand，hour，hat
填 a 或 an：____ hour，____ hat

items.lesson: Section A What can you do for your home?
lessons: What can you do for your home
items.stem: 你感冒了躺在床上，想请妈妈帮你关上窗户。哪句说得最得体？
options: Could I close the window, please?
Could you please closed the window?
Could you close the window, please?
right: 请别人帮你做事，用 Could you + 动词原形…?
Could you close the window, please?
typical: 想让窗关上，就问“能关窗吗”：
Could I close the window, please?

ladder.q: 填 I 或 you：Could ____ please feed the cat?（请姐姐喂猫）
填 I 或 you：Can ____ sit here?（问同学自己能不能坐这儿）
想请哥哥帮你修自行车，改写这句：Could I fix the bike?
ladder.a: Could you fix the bike, please?

items.lesson: Section B How do you feel at home?
lessons: How do you feel at home
items.stem: —The rubbish bin is full. Could you help? —Sure, I'll ____ now.
right: take out 的宾语是代词时，代词要放在中间：
take it out（不能说 take out it）。
typical: 记住了 take out the rubbish，换成 it 也放在最后：

ladder.q: 用 it 改写：Please clean up the kitchen. → Please ____.
用 them 改写：Can you hang up the photos? → Can you ____?
—Your books are all over the floor. —Sorry, I'll ____ (pick up) now.

items.stem: Ben enjoys ____ things with his 3-D printer.
right: enjoy 后面接动名词（-ing）作宾语：
enjoys making things。

ladder.q: Jenny decided ____ (learn) about robots.
Have you finished ____ (fix) the bike?
Tom hopes ____ (be) an inventor, so he practises ____ (draw) every day.

items.stem: 广播：“Come to the Robot Show at City Library this Sunday! Kids get in free.” 它的主要目的是：
right: Come to... 是在邀请；
时间、地点、票价都是为邀请服务的细节。

ladder.q: 这句话的目的是什么：Please keep quiet in the library.
ladder.a: 提醒大家在图书馆保持安静

ladder.q: 目的是什么：Our new bike shop opens on Monday. Come and have a look!
用一句话邀请同学来看你们班的发明展。
ladder.a: 如 Come and see our invention show on Friday!

items.stem: Out of ____, Tim opened the old box. He is a ____ boy.
right: out of 是介词，后面用名词：out of curiosity（出于好奇）；
a ____ boy 修饰名词，用形容词 curious。
typical: Out of curious, Tim opened the box.

ladder.q: curious 还是 curiosity：Cats are ____ animals.
curious 还是 curiosity：Her ____ about stars made her a scientist.
翻译：出于好奇，他问了很多问题。
ladder.a: Out of curiosity, he asked lots of questions.

items.stem: 哪组词开头的音相同？
right: write 中的 w 不发音，开头读 /r/，和 rain 一样；
light 开头是 /l/，white 开头是 /w/。
typical: white 和 write 都是 w 开头，

ladder.q: 开头是 /l/ 还是 /r/：lake，road
哪个词开头读 /r/：wrong，wet，long
按开头的音分两组：write，light，rain，leave

items.stem: Mr Lin has made a new kind of pen. He is an ____.
right: an 后面要用名词，这里说的是“人”；
invent 发明（动词）→ invention 发明物 → inventor 发明者。

ladder.q: The 3-D printer is a great ____. (invent)
Many ____ never give up. (invent)
The ____ wanted to ____ a robot. (invent)

items.lesson: Section A How are we different from each other?
lessons: How are we different from each other
items.stem: Tina is ____ than her sister.
right: 有 than，要用比较级；
outgoing 是多音节词，前面加 more：more outgoing。
typical: Tina is outgoinger than her sister.

ladder.q: Tom is ____ (tall) than Sam.
This book is ____ (interesting) than that one.
I'm ____ (good) at math than my brother, but he's ____ (funny).

items.lesson: Section B How do we understand differences?
items.stem: 小明这样理解下面这句话。你同意吗？
work: Mia is less outgoing than her sister.
小明：意思是姐姐比 Mia 更外向。
right: less + 形容词 + than 表示“不如……”：
Mia 不如姐姐外向，也就是姐姐比 Mia 更外向。

ladder.q: This box is less heavy than that one. 哪个箱子更重？
同义改写：Mia is less outgoing than her sister. = Mia is not as ____ as her sister.
用 less…than 写：我没有哥哥那么认真（serious）。
ladder.a: I am less serious than my brother.

items.stem: Mum told me ____ my phone at the dinner table.
right: tell sb (not) to do：不定式作宾语补足语；
否定把 not 放在 to 前：told me not to use。
typical: Mum told me don't use my phone.

ladder.q: The teacher asked us ____ (bring) our own cups.
Dad told me ____ (not play) games too late.
“Don't run in the hall,” Mr Lee said. → Mr Lee told us ____.
ladder.a: not to run in the hall

items.stem: Mum: “No phone after 9 pm.” Tom: “What? But my friends are all online!” Tom 的态度是：
right: What? 后面紧跟 But...，表示吃惊和不同意；
Tom 不愿意晚上 9 点后不用手机。
typical: Tom 没听清妈妈说什么。

ladder.q: 说话人是什么态度：No! I don't want to go!
说话人是什么态度：Really? You made this robot yourself?
用 What? 或 No! 回应，表示不同意：Let's stay home all weekend.
ladder.a: 如 What? But it's sunny outside!

items.stem: 写 50 年后的学校：In 50 years, there ____ more robot teachers.
right: there be 的将来时是 there will be；
will 后面跟动词原形 be，不随名词变成 are。
typical: there will have more robot teachers

ladder.q: There ____ a sports meeting next week. (be)
In the future, students ____ (not need) to carry heavy bags.
用 there will be 写一句你对 50 年后教室的预测。
ladder.a: 如 There will be a big screen on every desk.

items.stem: 哪个词开头读 /j/（和 yes、you 开头的音一样）？
right: use 开头读 /juː/，有 /j/ 音，和 yes、you 一样；
jump 开头是 /dʒ/，umbrella 开头是 /ʌ/。
typical: /j/ 就是字母 j 的音，

ladder.q: 开头是 /j/ 还是 /dʒ/：young，June
哪个词开头读 /j/：under，useful，up
按开头的音分两组：yet，job，year，just

items.stem: 哪一句是观点（opinion），不是事实（fact）？
options: Lots of people in China pay by phone!
Shared bikes are the best way to travel.
This app has about two million users.
right: the best 是说话人的看法，别人可能不同意，是观点；
另两句说的情况可以查证，是事实。
typical: 这句带感叹号，语气很强，

ladder.q: Fact 还是 opinion：Online games are boring.
Fact 还是 opinion：My phone can take photos.
把这个事实改成一个观点：I use an app to learn English.
ladder.a: 如 Learning English with an app is fun.

items.lesson: Section A What can plants and animals do?
lessons: What can plants and animals do
items.stem: That is ____ tree in our town.
right: tall 是单音节词，最高级加 -est；
最高级修饰名词，前面要加 the：the tallest。
typical: 最高级就是在前面加 the most：

ladder.q: This is ____ (big) shop in our town.
Which is ____ (good) place to see birds near here?
Mike is ____ (funny) student in our class.

items.lesson: Section B How are plants and animals connected with us?
lessons: How are plants and animals connected with us
items.stem: 用 important 的名词形式填空：Our teacher told us about the ____ of sleep.
right: the ____ of 中间要填名词；
important 的名词是 importance（-ant 变 -ance）。

ladder.q: 写出名词：dark → ____
写出名词：active → ____
用 invent 的适当形式填空：The ____ of paper changed the world.

items.stem: Kate went to the library ____ some books about rules.
right: 表示目的用不定式 to do：to borrow books；
也可以说 in order to borrow 或 so as to borrow。
typical: went to the library for borrow books

ladder.q: 用 to 连成一句：I got up early. I wanted to catch the bus.
ladder.a: I got up early to catch the bus.

ladder.q: 用 in order to 连成一句：She saves money. She wants to buy a bike.
ladder.a: She saves money in order to buy a bike.

ladder.q: 翻译：为了赶上早班车，他五点就起床了。（用 so as to）
ladder.a: He got up at five so as to catch the early bus.

items.stem: 辩论中对方说：“Rules should never be broken.” 你不同意。哪句说得最好？
options: No! That's wrong. You don't understand.
I see your point, but not in every situation.
right: 先承认对方的观点，再用 but 引出自己的不同看法；
辩论既要礼貌，也要把自己的意思说出来。
typical: No! That's wrong. You don't understand.

ladder.q: 哪句更礼貌地表示不同意：A. That's silly. B. I'm afraid I have to disagree.
补全：I understand your point, ____ rules keep us safe.
对方说 Phones are bad for students. 礼貌地反驳，并给出理由。
ladder.a: 如 I see your point, but phones can help us learn.

items.topic: 习语 a piece of cake
items.stem: The maths test was a piece of cake for Lily. 这句话的意思是：
options: 考试时 Lily 吃了一块蛋糕。
数学考试对 Lily 来说很容易。
这次考试让 Lily 觉得很甜蜜。
right: a piece of cake 是习语，意思是“小菜一碟，很容易”；
不能按字面理解成“一块蛋糕”。
typical: 所以是考试时吃了一块蛋糕

ladder.q: a piece of cake 是什么意思：Riding a bike is a piece of cake for me.
用 a piece of cake 回答：Is the new game hard for you?
ladder.a: No, it's a piece of cake.

ladder.q: 用 a piece of cake 写一句话，说一件对你来说很容易的事。
ladder.a: 如 Making noodles is a piece of cake for me.

items.stem: 读 flag 时，开头的 /fl/ 应该怎样读？
options: f、l 紧连着读，中间不加元音
f 后加一个轻元音，再读 l
只读 f，l 很轻，可以不读
right: /fl/ 是辅音连缀，f 和 l 之间不能加元音；
加了元音，flag 就多出一个音节。
typical: f 后面带个 /ə/ 才好读，

ladder.q: slow 有几个音节？
哪个词开头是辅音连缀：below，blue，ball
在 blow 的 b 和 l 之间加个元音，听起来像哪个词？

items.lesson: Section A How do we make food?
items.stem: Mum, ____ bananas should I buy? And ____ milk?
right: bananas 可数，用 how many；
milk 不可数，用 how much。
typical: 牛奶也能一杯一杯地数：
how many bananas…? And how many milk?

ladder.q: ____ yogurt is there in the fridge?
____ apples do you want?
____ cups of milk did you drink today?

items.lesson: Section B What does cooking give us?
items.stem: 用英语写在纸上：四瓶水
right: water 不可数，复数加在量词 bottle 上：
four bottles of water
typical: 汉语“四瓶”的“瓶”不变，英语照搬：

ladder.q: 用英语写：两碗汤
用英语写：三杯咖啡
We need ____（两袋米）and ____（三勺盐）.
ladder.a: two bags of rice；three spoons of salt

items.stem: While my sister ____ her homework, the ground began to shake.
right: 地面开始晃动是过去的事，while 引出当时正在做的事，用过去进行时；
主语 my sister 是单数：was doing。
typical: While my sister is doing her homework...

ladder.q: What ____ you ____ (do) at 8 last night?
I ____ (read) when the lights went out.
用 when 连成一句：They were playing football. It started to rain.
ladder.a: They were playing football when it started to rain.

items.stem: Ken 在洪水中救了两个孩子。你想夸夸他，哪句对？
right: 感叹句：What + a/an + 形容词 + 可数名词单数！
也可以说 How brave he is!

ladder.q: ____ smart girl she is! (What a / How)
____ brave they are! (What / How)
用 What 和 How 各写一句，夸同学很友好。
ladder.a: 如 What a kind boy! / How kind he is!

items.stem: Ann used to be afraid of the dark. 这句话的意思是：
options: Ann 以前怕黑，现在不怕了。
Ann 现在还和以前一样怕黑。
right: used to do 表示过去常常做或过去的状态，
现在已经不这样了。
typical: 所以 Ann 已经习惯了黑暗

ladder.q: 翻译：I used to walk to school.
My grandma used to ____ (live) in a small village.
用 used to 写一句：你以前怎样，现在不一样了。
ladder.a: 如 I used to be shy, but now I enjoy speaking in class.

items.stem: 哪个词里有 /fr/（和 free、front 开头的音一样）？
right: afraid 中间有 /fr/，和 free、front 一样；
three 开头是 /θr/，fly 开头是 /fl/。

ladder.q: 开头是 /fr/ 还是 /fl/：fresh，floor
开头是 /br/ 还是 /bl/：bring，blow
按开头的音分两组：three，fruit，throw，from

items.lesson: Section A When do we make plans?
items.stem: Jack plans ____ a movie tonight. He enjoys ____ action movies.
right: plan 后接 to do：plans to watch；
enjoy 后接 doing：enjoys watching。
typical: 两个空都跟 plan 一样用 to do：

ladder.q: I hope ____ (see) you again.
My parents enjoy ____ (watch) the news after dinner.
She enjoys ____ (read), and she wants ____ (learn) French.

items.lesson: Section A When do we make plans?
items.stem: “他长大后打算当医生。”He ____ a doctor when he grows up.
right: be going to + 动词原形；“当”要用 be：
He is going to be a doctor.
typical: He is going to a doctor.

ladder.q: 用 be going to 填空：I ____ (visit) my grandparents this weekend.
—What ____ you going to ____ when you grow up? —An engineer.
改成一般疑问句：They're going to be teachers.
ladder.a: Are they going to be teachers?

items.lesson: Section B How can we make good plans?
lessons: How can we make good plans
items.stem: Tom makes a study plan every week, but he hardly ever follows it. 意思是？
options: 他很努力地按计划去做
他几乎从来不按计划做
right: hardly ever = almost never，“几乎从不”：
他每周都订计划，却几乎从来不照着做。
typical: hardly 是 hard 加 -ly，“努力地”：
他很努力地按计划去做。

ladder.q: hardly ever 和哪个意思相同：always / almost never / often？
He is very busy, so he ____ ____ watches TV.（他几乎从不看电视）
按频率从高到低排：hardly ever, always, sometimes, usually

items.lesson: Section A What are your predictions about the future?
lessons: What are your predictions about the future
items.stem: “下周会有一场音乐会。”哪句对？
options: There will be a concert next week.
There will have a concert next week.
There will is a concert next week.
right: there be 的将来时是 there will be，
will 后用原形 be：There will be a concert next week.
typical: There will have a concert next week.

ladder.q: There ____ ____ a test tomorrow.
—____ there be robots in every home? —Yes, there will.
People ____ (have) robots at home in 50 years.

items.lesson: Section B How can we prepare for the future?
lessons: How can we prepare for the future
items.stem: In the future, there will be ____ cars on the road and ____ pollution.
right: cars 可数，用 fewer；
pollution 不可数，用 less。
typical: less cars on the road and less pollution

ladder.q: 填 fewer 或 less：I want to eat ____ sugar.
填 fewer 或 less：There are ____ students in Class 2 than in Class 1.
We should drink ____ sweet drinks and eat ____ fast food.

items.lesson: Section A How do we communicate?
items.stem: 朋友邀请小明，小明这样回答。你同意吗？
work: —Can you come to the school concert with me tonight?
—Sure, I'd love.
right: I'd love to. 是 I'd love to come. 的省略，
to 不能省：Sure, I'd love to.

ladder.q: —Would you like to go hiking? —Yes, I'd like ____.
—Can you go to the movies with us? —I'd love ____, but I have to study.
—Can you help me with my English? —I'd be glad ____.

items.lesson: Section A How do we communicate?
items.stem: 用 if 把 It will rain tomorrow. 和 We will stay at home. 连成一句。小明从第几步开始错？
work: “明天下雨”是条件，用 if 引出
从句照搬原句：If it will rain tomorrow,
主句用一般将来时：we will stay at home.
合起来：If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
right: if 条件句“主将从现”：if 句用一般现在时，
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

ladder.q: If you ____ (study) hard, you'll pass the test.
If it ____ (be) sunny tomorrow, we ____ (go) hiking.
If she ____ (not get) up early, she ____ (miss) the bus.

items.lesson: Section B How can we communicate better?
items.stem: My classmates lent me their notes after I missed the class. They were easy to read. They 指什么？
right: They 是复数，“容易读”的是笔记：
They = their notes。
typical: They 离 the class 最近，
所以 They 指那节课。

ladder.q: I bought a new kite. It flies very high. It 指什么？
My parents gave me two books. I put them on my desk. them 指什么？
Tom asked Amy for help, and she said yes. Then he thanked her. she、her 各指谁？

items.lesson: Section A How do you spend your free time?
lessons: How do you spend your free time
items.stem: “为了保持健康，爷爷每天早上游泳。”Grandpa swims every morning ____.
right: 说明“为了做某事”，用动词不定式 to do：
Grandpa swims every morning to keep fit.
typical: Grandpa swims every morning for keep fit.

ladder.q: I got up early ____ (catch) the first bus.
填 to 或 for：Tom went to the shop ____ some milk and then went home ____ cook dinner.
用不定式说明目的：我存钱是为了买一把吉他。
ladder.a: I save money to buy a guitar.（或 I'm saving money to …）

items.lesson: Section A How do you spend your free time?
lessons: How do you spend your free time
items.stem: 小林给同桌推荐一个视频，这样写。你同意吗？
work: This funny video will make you laugh.
right: make 后的宾语补足语用不带 to 的动词原形：
make you laugh，这句话没有错。

ladder.q: Please let me ____ (carry) the box for you.
The coach asked us ____ (run) faster, and he made us ____ (practise) every day.
改错：The sad movie made my mum to cry.
ladder.a: 去掉 to：made my mum cry

items.lesson: Unit 1_Understanding ideas_2 Read Robert's speech. How does he feel about his job?
items.stem: 公交司机 Mr Lin 的车每天都坐满了人。他说：A girl waved to me every day. After she moved away, the bus felt empty. 这句话是说？
options: 少了一个人，他更轻松了
right: 前文说女孩每天向他挥手；她搬走后，
满车的人还在，他却觉得“空”——是想念她。

ladder.q: My best friend moved away. The playground looks so big now. 说话人什么心情？
After Grandma left, our house was too quiet. too quiet 说明什么？
ladder.a: 家人想念奶奶，觉得冷清

ladder.q: 仿写一句：用“东西变了”的说法，表达你想念一位老同学。
ladder.a: 如 Our classroom feels different without you.

items.lesson: Unit 1_Understanding ideas_8 Work in pairs. Choose a job and complete the notes.
items.topic: 一般将来时的被动语态
items.stem: “明年我们镇上将建一座新图书馆。”A new library ____ in our town next year.
right: 图书馆是“被建”的，又是将来的事：
will be + 过去分词 → will be built
typical: 说将来就用 will + 动词：
A new library will build in our town.

ladder.q: The results ____ (put) on the school website tomorrow.
改成被动语态：They will hold the art show in May.
ladder.a: The art show will be held in May.

ladder.q: 用一般现在时的被动语态说：这种茶种植在云南。
ladder.a: This kind of tea is grown in Yunnan.

items.lesson: Section B How can a hobby improve your life?
lessons: How can a hobby improve your life
items.topic: 分清句子是事实还是观点
items.stem: 小林读一篇介绍爱好的短文，这样判断下面这句话。你同意吗？
work: Painting is the most relaxing hobby.
小林：这是观点——说的是一种看法，没法证明一定对。
right: 事实能查证；观点是看法，可能对也可能不对。
这句没有 think，但“最放松”因人而异，所以是观点。

ladder.q: 写 F（事实）或 O（观点）：Amy has 50 stamps.
写 F 或 O：① Collecting stamps is boring. ② Amy keeps her stamps in a blue box.
不用 think、believe，写一句关于集邮的观点。
ladder.a: 如 Collecting stamps is the best hobby.（是看法即可）

items.lesson: Unit 1_Developing ideas_1 Listen to the preview of a radio programme and choose what next week's show is.
items.stem: 电台预告：Do you want to know how a 15-year-old girl opened a library in her village? Join us next Monday! 主持人这样问是为了？
options: 引出下期节目要讲的内容
请听众打电话回答问题
right: 这是不需要听众回答的问句（rhetorical question），
用来点出下期的主要内容：女孩怎样办起图书馆。
typical: 听到问号就想：主持人在等我们回答，

ladder.q: Why do so many people love pandas? Let's find out today. 这期节目讲什么？
ladder.a: 人们为什么喜欢大熊猫

ladder.q: Who says old people can't learn new things? 说话人的观点是？
用一个不需要回答的问句，为你的职业介绍开个头。
ladder.a: 如 What is it like to be a firefighter?

items.stem: 下面哪个词里没有 /sk/ 这两个连着的音？
right: school 开头是 /sk/，desk 结尾是 /sk/；
science 里的 sc 读 /s/：/ˈsaɪəns/，没有 /sk/。
typical: desk 里的 sk 在词尾，
只有在开头的 sk 才读 /sk/。

ladder.q: 读一读，找出 /sk/：sky，ask，basket
哪个词没有 /sp/：spend，sport，sugar
找出 /st/ 不在开头的两个词：stop，best，still，fast

items.lesson: Unit 1_Developing ideas_3 Listen to the interview of Yan Jing and complete the diagram.
items.stem: 采访面包店的王师傅，想让他多讲讲。同意小林的说法吗？
work: 小林准备的问题：
Do you get up at four every day to make bread?
小林：这个问题很长，是开放式问题（open question）。
right: Do 开头的一般疑问句，答 Yes 或 No 就结束了；
开放式问题用 how、what、why 开头，如 Why do you get up so early?

ladder.q: 开放式还是封闭式：Is your job hard?
改成开放式问题：Do you like your job?
ladder.a: 如 What do you like about your job?

ladder.q: 王师傅说：The hardest part is getting up early. 接一个追问。
ladder.a: 如 How do you get up so early?

items.lesson: Unit 1_Developing ideas_Reading for writing_2 Read the passage.Why are traditional jobs disappearing and new jobs springing up?
items.stem: New bubble tea shops are springing up near our school. springing up 在这里的意思是？
options: 一家接一家很快开起来
right: spring up 表示“迅速出现、涌现”，
这句是说学校附近很快开了很多新奶茶店。
typical: spring 是春天，up 是向上，

ladder.q: Tall buildings are springing up in the town. 意思是？
ladder.a: 镇上很快建起许多高楼

ladder.q: 用 spring up 改写：Many new parks appear quickly in our city.
ladder.a: Many new parks are springing up in our city.

ladder.q: 用 spring up 说一句你家附近的变化。
ladder.a: 如 New shops are springing up near my home.

items.lesson: Unit 2_Understanding ideas_2 Read the play. What does the mother expect from her son?
items.stem: 剧本中的一行：Dad: (looking at his watch) You're late again! 括号里的字该怎么处理？
options: Dad 要把这几个词也说出来
可以不管，演的时候跳过
演员照着做动作，不说出来
right: 括号里是舞台说明（stage directions）：
告诉演员做什么动作、用什么语气，不是台词。
typical: Dad 要说：Looking at his watch. You're late again!

ladder.q: Mum: (smiling) Well done! 哪部分是台词？
Tom: (in a low voice) I'm sorry. 演员该怎么说这句？
给这句台词加一个舞台说明：Amy: I passed the test!
ladder.a: 如 Amy: (jumping up and down) I passed the test!

items.lesson: Unit 2_Understanding ideas_2 Read the play. What does the mother expect from her son?
items.topic: 一般过去时的被动语态
items.stem: “这幅画是爷爷五十年前画的。”This picture ____ by my grandpa fifty years ago.
right: 画是“被画”的，又是五十年前的事：
was + 过去分词 → This picture was painted by my grandpa.
typical: “被”画，就用 is + 过去分词：
This picture is painted by my grandpa fifty years ago.

ladder.q: The letters ____ (send) last Monday.
改成被动语态：Lucy found the lost key under the sofa.
ladder.a: The lost key was found under the sofa.

ladder.q: 改成被动语态：The teacher encouraged Ben to try again.
ladder.a: Ben was encouraged to try again.

items.lesson: Unit 2_Developing ideas_1 Listen to the conversation and choose Colin's attitude.
items.stem: Lucy 说：Everyone in my class has a smart watch. I don't really need one, but I don't want to be different. Lucy 的态度是？
options: 她感到要和同学一样的压力
她不需要手表，所以无所谓
她以和别人不一样为荣
right: but 后面是 Lucy 真正在意的：不想和别人不一样，
这正是来自同龄人的压力（peer pressure）。
typical: Lucy 说 I don't really need one，
所以她无所谓，有没有手表都行。

ladder.q: I'm tired, but I'll finish my homework first. 说话人会先做什么？
All my friends play that game. I tried it, but I don't like it. 他的态度？
用英语说：朋友都学街舞，我不喜欢，但不想被落下。
ladder.a: 如 I don't like it, but I don't want to be left out.

items.stem: 小明读 street，他说这样读听得更清楚。同意他的读法吗？
work: 小明在 s 和 t、t 和 r 之间各加了一个轻轻的“呃”：
s-呃-t-呃-r-eet
拍手数音节，拍了三下。
right: /str/ 是三个辅音连在一起读，中间不加元音；
street 只有一个音节，拍一下就读完。

ladder.q: 拍手数音节：strong，spring
ladder.a: 各拍一下（都是一个音节）

ladder.q: 找出有 /skr/ 的词：screen，secret，school
数音节：strange，spread，instrument

items.lesson: Unit 2_Developing ideas_3 Listen to the radio and complete the notes.
items.stem: 朋友说：I'm afraid to speak in front of the class. 你想讲一个自己的经历来回应，哪一句开头最合适？
options: You shouldn't be afraid. It's easy.
That reminds me of my first speech.
Let me share a song with you.
right: That reminds me of... 由对方的话引出自己的经历，
接着讲：I was scared at my first speech, too...
typical: 要帮朋友，就告诉他不用怕：
You shouldn't be afraid. It's easy.

ladder.q: 哪句在引出自己的故事？A. Let me share a story with you.  B. Here is a book.
用 That reminds me of... 回应：I lost my bike today.
ladder.a: 如 That reminds me of the day I lost my bag.

ladder.q: 用 Let me share... 开头，说一句你学游泳的经历。
ladder.a: 如 Let me share how I learnt to swim.

items.lesson: Unit 2_Developing ideas_Reading for writing_2 Read the passage. What was the writer's pain?
items.stem: I lost a singing contest last year and cried all night. Now I smile about it — it made me work harder. 她现在怎样看那次失败？
options: 还是很难过，一想起就哭
觉得那次失败对自己有帮助
觉得评委不公平，很生气
right: Now I smile about it 和 it made me work harder
说明她现在把那次失败看作让自己进步的经历。
typical: 她输了比赛，哭了一整晚，

ladder.q: I was afraid of dogs as a child. Now I have two dogs. 他现在还怕狗吗？
I failed a test and felt awful. Later I learnt a lot from it. 他后来怎样看？
ladder.a: 觉得从失败中学到了很多

ladder.q: 用 Back then... Now... 写一句你对一次失败的感受变化。
ladder.a: 如 Back then I was sad. Now I know it helped me.

items.lesson: Section A What should we do when we don't feel well?
lessons: What should we do when we don't feel well
items.stem: 填一个词：“这对双胞胎是自学弹吉他的。”The twins taught ____ to play the guitar.
right: 主语 the twins 是复数，“他们自己”用复数反身代词：
them + selves = themselves。
typical: myself、yourself 是物主代词加 self，
所以“他们自己”= their + selves：theirselves

ladder.q: 写出反身代词：he → ____，she → ____，they → ____
The little girl can dress ____ now.
—Did your parents enjoy ____ at the party? —Yes, they had a great time.

items.lesson: Section B How should we stay safe?
items.stem: 护士说：“Don't worry. The test is painless.” 她的意思是这项检查——
right: 后缀 -less 表示“没有”（without）：
pain + less = without pain，painless 就是“不痛的”。

ladder.q: This small snake is harmless. harmless 是什么意思？
My old phone doesn't work at all. It's ____ (use) now.
Ben left hot oil on the stove and walked away. That was ____ (care) of him.

items.unit: Unit 3 What makes a great team?
items.lesson: Unit 3_Understanding ideas_2 Read the emails and find out Tony's problems and Ms White's advices.
items.stem: “李老师就我的演讲给了我一些建议。”Ms Li gave me ____ about my speech.
right: advice 是不可数名词，不加 a/an，也不加 s：
some advice；“一条建议”说 a piece of advice。

ladder.q: Can you give me some ____ (advice)?
“他给了我两条建议。”He gave me two ____.
改错：Thank you for your useful advices.

items.unit: Unit 3 What makes a great team?
items.lesson: Unit 3_Understanding ideas_8 Work in pairs. Discuss the qualities of a good leader.
items.stem: “明天是周六，你不必早起。”It's Saturday tomorrow. You ____ get up early.
right: “不必”用 don't have to（= needn't）；
mustn't 是“禁止”，意思不对。
typical: 所以 mustn't 就是“不必”。

ladder.q: You ____ run in the hallway. It's dangerous.（mustn't / don't have to）
We ____ bring lunch. The school gives us food.（mustn't / don't have to）
给队长写一条建议，用 should 或 doesn't have to。
ladder.a: 如 A captain doesn't have to do everything alone.

items.unit: Unit 3 What makes a great team?
items.lesson: Unit 3_Developing ideas_2 Listen again and complete the post.
items.stem: 听到通知：The basketball match is moved from Friday to Saturday afternoon. Bring your own water. 哪份笔记最好？
options: 一字不漏地抄下每一句
right: 好笔记只记关键：什么事、改到哪天、要做什么，
用缩写和箭头：Fri → Sat p.m.
typical: 先听到 Friday 就记下：

ladder.q: 给这句记笔记：The art club meets in Room 305 at 4 pm on Tuesday.
The trip is moved from May 3rd to May 5th. 笔记里该记哪天？
Bring a pen and two photos to the office by Friday. 用不超过 8 个词记下。
ladder.a: 如 Office by Fri: pen, 2 photos

items.unit: Unit 3 What makes a great team?
items.stem: 老师读一个词：/ˈkwaɪət/，两个音节。是哪个词？
right: quiet /ˈkwaɪət/ 有两个音节：qui-et；
quite /kwaɪt/ 和 quick /kwɪk/ 都只有一个音节。
typical: quite 和 quiet 读法一样。

ladder.q: 读一读，找出 /kw/：square，equal，quick
填 quite 或 quiet：The library is very ____.
填词：Please be ____. The baby is sleeping. / The test was ____ easy.
