items.unit: Unit 3 What makes a great team?
items.lesson: Unit 3_Developing ideas_3 Listen to the conversation and complete the diagram.
items.stem: 小组做海报，颜料不够了。你建议：“为什么不向美术老师要一些呢？”Why not ____ the art teacher for some paint?
right: Why not + 动词原形 = Why don't you + 动词原形：
Why not ask the art teacher for some paint?
typical: Why not 也一样：Why not asking...?

ladder.q: How about ____ (take) a bus there?
Why not ____ (call) your mum first?
用 Maybe we could... 委婉地提建议：组里有人病了，海报做不完。
ladder.a: 如 Maybe we could share his part.

items.unit: Unit 3 What makes a great team?
items.lesson: Unit 3_Developing ideas_Reading for writing_2 Read the passage and check your answers.
items.stem: On our football team, Jack is our “wall”. Very few balls get past him. 把 Jack 叫作 wall，是说？
options: Jack 反应慢，总站着不动
Jack 很会挡住对方的球
right: 后一句 Very few balls get past him 点明了相似点：
像墙一样挡得住——Jack 很会防守。
typical: 所以 Jack 反应慢，总是站着不动。

ladder.q: Mum is the “sun” of our family. 这是说妈妈怎样？
ladder.a: 给全家带来温暖和快乐

ladder.q: My brother is a “walking dictionary”. 是说他怎样？
用一个比喻夸一位队友，并在下一句说明为什么。
ladder.a: 如 Lily is our “engine”. She never stops running.

items.lesson: Section A What makes you upset?
items.stem: 用 although 把 Lucy failed the test. 和 She didn't give up. 连成一句。小明从第几步开始错？
work: 两句是转折：没考好，却没放弃
although 放在“没考好”这句前面
后句表示转折，前面再加上 but
Although Lucy failed the test, but she didn't give up.
right: although 和 but 只能用一个：
Although Lucy failed the test, she didn't give up.

ladder.q: 用 but 改写：Although it was cold, Tom didn't wear a coat.
ladder.a: It was cold, but Tom didn't wear a coat.

ladder.q: 改错：Although Tom was tired, but he finished his homework.
用 although 说一句：虽然这本书很长，我还是一天就读完了。
ladder.a: Although the book was long, I finished it in a day.

items.lesson: Section A What makes you upset?
items.stem: “雨停了我们才出发。”哪句对？
options: We will leave until the rain stops.
We won't leave until the rain will stop.
We won't leave until the rain stops.
right: leave 是一下子的动作，雨停前“不走”，用 not … until；
We won't leave until the rain stops.（until 句用一般现在时）
typical: “才出发”是肯定的，就用 will leave：
We will leave until the rain stops.

ladder.q: “昨晚我直到十点才睡觉。”I ____ go to bed ____ ten o'clock last night.
“妈妈回来我们才吃饭。”We won't eat ____ Mum ____ (come) back.
用 until 翻译：直到铃响，他才写完试卷。
ladder.a: He didn't finish the test until the bell rang.

items.lesson: Section B How can we stay positive?
items.stem: After the game, Leo felt blue all evening. felt blue 的意思是——
right: feel blue 是习语，意思是“心情低落、不开心”；
习语的意思不等于每个词的意思相加。
typical: blue 是“蓝色”，feel blue 就是脸色发青：
Leo 一晚上都冻得发青。

ladder.q: 哪个和 feel blue 意思相反：in high spirits / in low spirits？
Lily had a long face after the test. 她当时心情怎样？
选习语填空（a heavy heart / on top of the world）：She won first prize and felt ____.

items.lesson: Unit 4_Understanding ideas_2 Read the passage. What did Leah do to help other patients?
items.stem: Mr Gao's family couldn't afford a new car, so they kept their old one. couldn't afford 的意思是？
right: afford 意为“买得起，付得起”，
couldn't afford a new car 就是钱不够，买不起新车。

ladder.q: I can't afford this bike. It's too expensive. 意思是？
We saved for a year, and now we can ____ a piano.
用 afford 说一句：他的零花钱不够买那双鞋。
ladder.a: He can't afford those shoes with his pocket money.

items.lesson: Unit 4_Understanding ideas_8 Work in pairs. Discuss things to do to help people around you.
items.stem: “Jim 现在不可能在家。”填一个情态动词：Jim ____ be at home now. I saw him at the bookshop a minute ago.
right: 刚在书店看到他，所以他“不可能”在家：
表示“不可能”用 can't：Jim can't be at home now.
typical: Jim may not be at home now.

ladder.q: The lights are on. Someone ____ be in the room.（must / can't）
That ____ be Lucy. She is in Beijing this week.（must / can't）
用 might 猜一猜：门口的盒子可能是给姐姐的。
ladder.a: The box might be for my sister.

items.lesson: Unit 4_Developing ideas_1 Listen to the news and choose the headline.
items.stem: 新闻：Last Saturday, 30 students cleaned up Silver Beach. They picked up 200 kg of rubbish. Some visitors helped. 最好的标题？
options: 200 kg of Rubbish Found at School
right: 新闻主要讲：学生们清理了 Silver Beach，
标题概括“谁 + 做了什么”：Students Clean Up Silver Beach
typical: 最后一句说有游客也来了，
所以标题是 Visitors Enjoy Silver Beach。

ladder.q: News: Our school's robot team won first prize in the city contest. 拟个标题。
ladder.a: 如 School Robot Team Wins First Prize

ladder.q: News: A 70-year-old man teaches kids to swim for free. 拟个标题。
ladder.a: 如 Old Man Gives Free Swimming Lessons

ladder.q: News: Class 3 made 100 cards for old people in the village. 拟个标题。
ladder.a: 如 Students Make Cards for Old People

items.stem: 下面哪个短语里，第一个词末尾的音通常失去爆破（只做口形，不爆破出来）？
right: /d/ 和 /b/ 都是爆破音，紧挨在一起时，
good 末尾的 /d/ 只做口形不爆破：good book。
typical: big 末尾的 /g/ 是爆破音，
所以 big apple 里的 /g/ 也不爆破。

ladder.q: 找出六个爆破音：/p/ /s/ /t/ /m/ /d/ /k/ /b/ /g/
哪个有失去爆破：sit down，sit up
找出有失去爆破的两个：next term，red bag，get up，big egg

items.lesson: Unit 4_Developing ideas_3 Listen to the conversation and complete the poster.
items.stem: 你想和同学聊学校附近新开的宠物医院，先确认他知不知道这件事。最合适的开头是？
options: Go and help at the new pet hospital!
Have you heard about the new pet hospital?
right: 先用 Have you heard about...? 礼貌地问对方知不知道；
没听过就简单介绍，听过就直接聊怎么帮忙。
typical: 就直接说：Go and help at the new pet hospital!

ladder.q: 用 Did you know that...? 开头，提起学校下周要办书市。
ladder.a: Did you know that our school will have a book sale?

ladder.q: 同学答 No, I haven't. 你下一步该做什么？
用 Do you know about...? 开头，提起社区新开的图书角。
ladder.a: Do you know about the new reading corner?

items.lesson: Unit 4_Developing ideas_Reading for writing_2 Read the passage and check your answer.
items.stem: When Tim was ten, a fireman pulled him out of a burning house. Tim never forgot it. Now he is a fireman too. 他当消防员的原因？
options: 小时候一名消防员救过他
right: 原因：十岁时消防员把他从火里救出来，他一直没忘；
结果：他也当上了消防员。
typical: 文中说 Now he is a fireman too，
这就是他当消防员的原因。

ladder.q: Lily missed the bus, so she was late. 哪个是原因？
A nurse was kind to Ann. Now Ann wants to be a nurse. 用 because 连成一句。
ladder.a: Ann wants to be a nurse because a nurse was kind to her.

ladder.q: 用 so 写一句因果：你曾被人帮助，现在你也去帮助别人。
ladder.a: 如 A boy helped me once, so I help others now.

items.lesson: Section A What is amazing about nature?
items.stem: “下山时，爸爸走得比我更小心。”On the way down, Dad walked ____ than I did.
right: 比的是“走”的样子，要用副词 carefully；
多音节副词的比较级前加 more：more carefully。
typical: Dad walked more careful than I did.

ladder.q: Tom runs ____ (fast) than his brother.
Sally sings ____ (beautiful) than the other girls in her class.
用比较级翻译：李华英语说得比她哥哥更流利。
ladder.a: Li Hua speaks English more fluently than her brother (does).

items.lesson: Section B Why do we explore nature?
items.topic: How 后面接哪个形容词
items.stem: 填两个词：—____ ____ is the river here? —It's about 3 metres deep.
right: 答语说的是 deep（深），问“多深”就用 How deep；
How 后面的形容词要和答语里的形容词对上。
typical: 问多少米就用 How long：
How long is the river here?

ladder.q: —____ ____ is your grandpa? —He's 70 years old.
—____ ____ is the nearest hospital? —About 3 kilometres away.
—____ ____ will the bus come? —In ten minutes.

items.lesson: Unit 5_Understanding ideas_2 Read the passage and check your answer.
items.stem: “Tom 想知道明天的郊游会不会取消。”Tom wants to know ____ the trip will be cancelled tomorrow.
right: “会不会、是否”拿不准，用 whether（或 if）引导：
Tom wants to know whether the trip will be cancelled.
typical: 宾语从句都用 that 引导：
Tom wants to know that the trip will be cancelled.

ladder.q: Tom asked me ____ I could help him.（that / if）
I believe ____ we will win the match.（that / whether）
连成一句：Will it snow this weekend? Lucy wants to know.
ladder.a: Lucy wants to know whether it will snow this weekend.

items.lesson: Unit 5_Understanding ideas_2 Read the passage and check your answer.
items.stem: 同意小红的说法吗？
work: I hope that we can visit the science museum.
→ I hope we can visit the science museum.
小红：去掉 that，句子仍然正确，意思不变。
right: that 引导宾语从句时没有词义，
常可省略：I hope (that) we can visit the science museum.

ladder.q: 去掉 that 读一读：I believe that you can do it.
ladder.a: I believe you can do it.

ladder.q: 补上被省略的 that：She says she will come early.
ladder.a: She says that she will come early.

ladder.q: whether 也能省掉吗？I wonder whether he is at home.

items.lesson: Unit 5_Developing ideas_2 Listen again and complete the profile.
items.stem: 听一段介绍一个湖的话，哪一句是说话人的观点（opinion）？
options: I visited the lake last summer.
The lake is about 30 km long.
I believe it's the most beautiful lake.
right: I believe 表明这是说话人自己的看法；
“最美”因人而异，不能查证，是观点。
typical: I visited... 是说话人自己说的，
带 I 的句子都是观点。

ladder.q: 事实还是观点：The river is 500 km long.
事实还是观点：I guess the river is too cold to swim in.
用 I think 说一句你对一处自然景观的看法。
ladder.a: 如 I think the Yellow Mountain is amazing.

items.stem: The number of birds may increase this year. 这句里的 increase 重音在哪里？
right: may 后面是动词，increase 作动词重读第二个音节：
in-CREASE；作名词时读 IN-crease。

ladder.q: 标出重音：a big increase
标出重音：The number of visitors increased last year.
标出 present 的重音：a birthday present / present the prizes

items.lesson: Unit 5_Developing ideas_3 Listen to the conversation and complete the table.
items.stem: “那座山可能是一座火山。”填 maybe 或 may be：The hill ____ a volcano.
right: 句子缺谓语，要用情态动词 + be：The hill may be a volcano.
maybe 是副词，放句首：Maybe the hill is a volcano.
typical: 放在主语后面：The hill maybe a volcano.

ladder.q: 填 maybe 或 may be：____ it will rain tonight.
填 maybe 或 may be：The answer ____ in the book.
用 It's possible that... 猜一猜：湖水变绿可能是因为湖里有很多植物。
ladder.a: It's possible that there are many plants in the lake.

items.lesson: Unit 5_Developing ideas_Reading for writing_2 Read the passage and check your answers.
items.stem: 短文讲 Ms Zhang 在山村小学教了 40 年书，帮很多孩子走出大山。标题是 A Light in the Mountains。标题的意思是？
options: 她给山里孩子带来了希望
她在山里卖了 40 年的灯
right: 短文讲她教书 40 年、帮孩子走出大山，
light 是比喻：她像一盏灯，给孩子们带来希望。

ladder.q: 一篇写老渔民天天出海的短文题为 Friends with the Sea。题目想说什么？
ladder.a: 老渔民热爱大海，和大海很亲近

ladder.q: 写妈妈每天为全家做早餐的短文，哪个标题好？A. Morning Love  B. Eggs and Milk
给一篇写校医 30 年照顾学生的短文起个英文标题。
ladder.a: 如 A Caring Heart at School

items.lesson: Section A What happens during a natural disaster?
lessons: What happens during a natural disaster
items.topic: 过去进行时：当时正在做
items.stem: “去年地震发生时，叔叔阿姨正在院子里干活。”When the earthquake hit last year, my aunt and uncle ____ in the garden.
right: 地震那一刻，叔叔阿姨正在干活，用过去进行时；
主语是复数，用 were：were working。
typical: my aunt and uncle worked in the garden.

ladder.q: At eight last night, I ____ (watch) a movie with my family.
—What ____ your friends ____ (do) when the storm started?
When the lights went out, my parents ____ (talk) and I ____ (have) a shower.

items.lesson: Section A What happens during a natural disaster?
lessons: What happens during a natural disaster
items.stem: 小红这样写上周一节体育课上的事。你同意吗？
work: While lightning hit a tree, we were having PE.
right: while 后面要接持续一段时间的动作；
闪电一下子就击中了树，要用 when：
When lightning hit a tree, we were having PE.

ladder.q: 填 when 或 while：____ the teacher came in, we were still talking.
用 while 连成一句：I was walking in the park. I met my English teacher.
ladder.a: While I was walking in the park, I met my English teacher.

ladder.q: 改错：While I got home, Mum was cooking dinner.
ladder.a: While → When（或 While Mum was cooking dinner, I got home.）

items.lesson: Section B What can we do to prepare for the worst?
lessons: What can we do to prepare for the worst
items.stem: “去年那个小镇发生了一场大地震。”A big earthquake ____ in the town last year.
right: happen（发生）不用被动语态，主语是事情也直接用它；
去年发生的事用过去式：happened。
typical: 地震不是自己做的事，要用被动：
A big earthquake was happened in the town.

ladder.q: A big fire ____ (happen) in the forest last week.
改错：The accident was happened near our school.
The flood ____ (take place) in our village in 2020.

items.lesson: Unit 6_Understanding ideas_2 Read the passgae and check your answer.
items.stem: 用所给词的正确形式填空：The ____ (arrive) of the first snow made the children very excited.
right: The ____ of... 中的空格要用名词，
arrive 的名词是 arrival：The arrival of the first snow...
typical: The arrive of the first snow...

ladder.q: 填 arrive 或 arrival：When did the train ____?
填词：We waited for the ____ (arrive) of spring.
用 arrival 写一句：春节的到来让大家都很开心。
ladder.a: The arrival of the Spring Festival makes everyone happy.

items.lesson: Unit 6_Understanding ideas_8 Work in pairs. Talk about how people live by the laws of nature.
items.stem: “我不知道公交车什么时候开。”I don't know ____.
right: 宾语从句用陈述语序：疑问词 + 主语 + 谓语，
I don't know when the bus leaves.
typical: 把问句 When does the bus leave? 原样放进去：
I don't know when does the bus leave.

ladder.q: Can you tell me where ____?（is the station / the station is）
连成一句：Why do bees like flowers? I wonder.
ladder.a: I wonder why bees like flowers.

ladder.q: 连成一句：How do farmers know when to plant? Please tell me.
ladder.a: Please tell me how farmers know when to plant.

items.lesson: Unit 6_Developing ideas_2 Listen again and complete the table.
items.stem: Ben 对爸爸说：Can you tell me how this solar lamp works? Ben 想知道什么？
options: 这盏太阳能灯是怎么工作的
right: Can you tell me... 是礼貌的问法，真正的问题在 how 后面：
这盏太阳能灯是怎么工作的。
typical: Can you tell me 是“你能说吗”，
所以 Ben 想知道爸爸能不能说话。

ladder.q: Do you know where the solar park is? 说话人想知道什么？
I wonder what makes the sea salty. 说话人想知道什么？
用 Can you tell me... 礼貌地问：太阳能板能用多少年？
ladder.a: Can you tell me how long the solar panels can work?

items.stem: classroom 这个复合名词，重音在哪里？
right: 复合名词的重音通常在第一部分：
CLASS-room，和 BED-room、FOOT-ball 一样。
typical: room 是“房间”，是这个词的中心，

ladder.q: 标出重音：bedroom，football
标出重音：toothbrush，sunflower
找出重音不在前面的词：homework，birthday，afternoon

items.lesson: Unit 6_Developing ideas_3 Listen to the radio and complete the notes.
items.stem: 你要在广播里介绍一款太阳能小灯，想吸引听众。哪个开头最好？
options: This is a lamp. It uses sunlight. That's all.
It's just a small, boring lamp, I'm afraid.
Can you believe this lamp works all night?
right: 用 Can you believe...? 引起听众的好奇，
直接对听众说话，语气积极。
typical: This is a lamp. It uses sunlight. That's all.

ladder.q: 哪个词更能吸引听众：nice / amazing
把这句改得更吸引人：This bike uses no oil.
ladder.a: 如 Can you believe this bike needs no oil?

ladder.q: 用 Have you ever seen...? 开头，为风力发电的介绍写一句开场白。
ladder.a: 如 Have you ever seen a field of giant windmills?

items.lesson: Unit 6_Developing ideas_Reading for writing_2 Read the passage and check your answers.
items.stem: Electric bikes are clean and cheap to use, but their batteries need charging often. 下面哪一项是电动自行车的缺点？
right: but 前面是优点：干净、用起来便宜；
but 后面是缺点：电池要经常充电。
typical: 便宜的东西不好，所以是缺点。

ladder.q: Living in the city is exciting, but it's noisy. 缺点是什么？
Solar lamps save energy, but they don't work well on cloudy days. 优点和缺点？
ladder.a: 优点：节能；缺点：阴天不太好用

ladder.q: 用 but 写一句：用手机学英语的一个优点和一个缺点。
ladder.a: 如 It's easy, but it's bad for our eyes.

items.lesson: Section A How different are our cultures?
items.stem: In class, Ben called his teacher “Mum” by mistake. It was ____ to everyone, and Ben felt a little ____.
right: “这件事让人惊讶”用 -ing：It was surprising；
“Ben 感到尴尬”用 -ed：Ben felt a little embarrassed。
typical: “尴尬的”就是 embarrassing，说人说事都一样：

ladder.q: The story was so ____ (bore) that I fell asleep.
We were ____ (excite) when we heard the news.
The maths problem was so ____ (confuse) that I felt ____ (confuse).

items.lesson: Section A How different are our cultures?
items.stem: 小明想说“如果你不快点，就会迟到”，写了下面这句。你同意吗？
work: You will be late unless you don't hurry.
right: unless 本身就是“如果不”，后面不再加 not：
You will be late unless you hurry.

ladder.q: 用 unless 改写：If you don't leave now, you'll miss the train.
ladder.a: Unless you leave now, you'll miss the train.

ladder.q: 填 if 或 unless：Don't call me ____ it's really important.
用 unless 翻译：除非下雨，否则我们明天去爬山。
ladder.a: We'll go hiking tomorrow unless it rains.

items.lesson: Section B How do we show respect to other cultures?
lessons: How do we show respect to other cultures
items.topic: 否定前缀 un- 还是 im-
items.stem: 加前缀写出反义词：It's ____ (polite) to look at your phone while a friend is talking to you.
right: polite 的反义词是 impolite；
p 开头的词常用 im-：impossible、improper、impatient。

ladder.q: It's ____ (possible) to read 100 books in one week.
Jeans are too ____ (formal) for a wedding.
My brother never waits for anyone. He is so ____ (patient).

items.lesson: Section A What great books have you read?
lessons: What great books have you read
items.stem: “我已经写完读书报告了，但还没给老师看。”I've ____ written my book report, but I haven't shown it to my teacher ____.
right: 肯定句说“已经”用 already，放在 have 后面；
否定句说“还没”用 yet，放在句末。
typical: I haven't shown it to my teacher already.

ladder.q: 填 already 或 yet：The movie has ____ started, but Tom hasn't arrived ____.
—Have you had lunch ____? —Yes, I've ____ had it.
用 already 或 yet 翻译：我还没给奶奶回信。
ladder.a: I haven't written back to Grandma yet.（或 replied to）

items.lesson: Section B What can we learn from great books?
lessons: What can we learn from great books
items.stem: Lily 的故事按顺序有三件事。画故事山（story mountain）时，哪件事是高潮（climax）？
options: Lily's cat runs away one rainy night.
Lily finds her cat under a car.
Lily and her cat sleep safely at home.
right: 猫跑丢是难题出现，后面还要去找；
找到猫，难题在这一刻解决，是故事的最高点——高潮。
typical: 所以高潮是 Lily's cat runs away.

ladder.q: 按顺序排：climax, beginning, ending, build-up, problem
Ben's kite gets stuck in a tree. At last his dad gets it down. They fly it again. 哪句是高潮？
ladder.a: At last his dad gets it down.

ladder.q: 补一句高潮：Max gets lost in a big shop. He looks everywhere. ____ They go home together.
ladder.a: 如 At last he finds his mum.（难题在这里解决）

items.lesson: Section A What can we do to help?
lessons: What can we do to help
items.stem: “林慧加入学校乐队已经两年了。”Lin Hui ____ the school band for two years.
right: “加入”是一下子的动作，join 不能和 for two years 连用；
说“在乐队两年了”，用能持续的 be in：has been in the band。
typical: Lin Hui has joined the school band for two years.

ladder.q: Tom bought this camera two years ago. → Tom has ____ this camera for two years.
改错：Mr Li has come to our school for three years.
ladder.a: has come to → has been at（或 has been in / has worked at）

ladder.q: Uncle Wang left Beijing three years ago. → Uncle Wang has ____ ____ from Beijing for three years.

items.lesson: Section B How does helping others make a difference?
lessons: How does helping others make a difference
items.stem: “这次救援很成功。”The rescue was very ____.
right: was very 后面说救援“怎么样”，要用形容词 successful；
success 是名词，successfully 修饰动作。

ladder.q: The school concert was a great ____ (succeed).
They ____ (successful) found the lost boy that night.
Lisa wants to be a ____ (succeed) writer. She tried hard and ____ (succeed) at last.

items.lesson: Section A What changes have taken place around you?
lessons: What changes have taken place around you
items.stem: Big changes ____ in our village since 2015.
right: since 2015 说的是从那时到现在，用现在完成时；
主语 changes 是复数，用 have；take place 没有被动。
typical: 变化是“被带来的”，要用被动：

ladder.q: My town ____ (change) a lot in the past ten years.
What ____ (happen) to your hometown since you left?
改错：A big change has been taken place in my school.

items.lesson: Section A What changes have taken place around you?
lessons: What changes have taken place around you
items.stem: 小明这样写家乡的变化。你同意吗？
work: A big supermarket has opened in my village two years ago.
right: two years ago 是过去的一个时间点，要用一般过去时：
A big supermarket opened in my village two years ago.

ladder.q: We ____ (move) to this town in 2018.
My hometown ____ (change) a lot since I was a child.
The new bridge ____ (open) last year, and many people ____ (use) it since then.

items.lesson: Section A What changes have taken place around you?
lessons: What changes have taken place around you
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：My grandpa used to ____ (ride) a bike to work. Now he takes the subway.
right: used to + 动词原形，表示过去常常做、现在不做了：
used to ride。
typical: used 是过去式，后面也用过去式：rode

ladder.q: There used to ____ (be) a river here.
用 used to 改写：Tom often played football, but he doesn't now.
用 used to 说一句：这座小镇以前很安静，现在很热闹。
ladder.a: This town used to be quiet. Now it's busy.

items.lesson: Section A What changes have taken place around you?
lessons: What changes have taken place around you
items.topic: 完成时配 for 还是 since
items.stem: My grandparents have lived in this town ____.
right: have lived 说的是一直住到现在，后面接一段时间用 for：for 50 years；
since 后面接时间点：since 1976；ago 只配一般过去时。
typical: have lived in this town since 50 years

ladder.q: 填 for 或 since：We have lived in this city ____ 2018.
填 for 或 since：My father has worked in this hospital ____ ten years.
填 for 或 since：My grandpa has lived here ____ he was a child.

items.stem: Which of them is a teenager?（下面哪一位是 teenager？）
right: teenager 指 13–19 岁、岁数带 -teen 的人；
Lucy 15 岁（fifteen），是 teenager。
typical: Mike 11 岁，是“十几岁”的少年，

ladder.q: Tom is 12. Is he a teenager? 用 Yes / No 回答。
用英文写出 teenager 年龄段里最小和最大的岁数。
用英语说：我哥哥 20 岁了，已经不是 teenager 了。
ladder.a: 示例：My brother is 20, so he isn't a teenager now.

items.lesson: Section B How do changes influence us?
items.topic: 读懂 used to 的意思
items.stem: 读句子：My town used to have only one small shop. 这句话的意思是：
options: 镇上一直到今天都只有一家小商店
镇上的人早就习惯那家小商店了
镇上把那家小商店用来干别的
过去只有一家小商店，现在不同了
right: used to + 动词原形：过去常常是这样，现在不再这样；
读报道时，used to 后面常接着 now 说现在的样子。
typical: used to 就是“常常”：镇上一直只有一家小商店

ladder.q: There used to be a river here. 现在这里还有河吗？
ladder.a: 没有了（以前有，现在没有）

ladder.q: 哪句说“现在每天早起”？A. I used to get up early. B. I get up early every day.
用 used to 和 now 写两句：以前骑车上学，现在坐公交。
ladder.a: I used to ride a bike to school. Now I take a bus.

items.lesson: Section B How do changes influence us?
items.stem: 小林写 Changes in My Life，写了四句。他从第几句开始用错时态？
work: In primary school, I used to go home for lunch.
Now I have lunch at school with my classmates.
Since I started junior high, I learned to cook.
I have grown taller, so my old bike is too small.
right: 第 3 句有 since，说的是从上初中一直到现在，要用现在完成时：
Since I started junior high, I have learned to cook.

ladder.q: My family ____ (live) in this flat since 2020.
We ____ (move) to a bigger flat last year.
改错：Since I came to this school, I joined two clubs.

items.stem: If it ____ this Saturday, our club will hold the puppet show in the school hall.
right: if 从句说将来的事，用一般现在时；
主语 it 是三单，动词加 s：If it rains, … will hold …
typical: 说的是周六（将来）的事，从句也用将来时：
If it will rain this Saturday, …

ladder.q: If you ____ (feel) tired, have a rest.
If Tom ____ (join) the art club, he will learn paper cutting.
改错：If we will take action now, the folk art will not disappear.

items.stem: 汇报爷爷小时候的生活：When Grandpa was 12, he ____ to school on foot. Now I go by bus.
right: When Grandpa was 12 说的是过去的一段时间，用一般过去时：went；
Now 后面说现在的事，才用一般现在时。
typical: 照汉语“爷爷 12 岁时走路上学”，动词不变：
When Grandpa was 12, he goes to school on foot.

ladder.q: When my mum was a child, she ____ (live) in a small village.
Back then, people wrote letters. Now people ____ (send) messages by phone.
改错：When Grandma was young, she has never seen a computer.
ladder.a: has never seen → never saw（或 had never seen）

items.topic: at the age of 的用法
items.stem: 介绍一位小发明家：Li Hua made a small robot ____ the age of 12.
right: at the age of + 数字，表示“在……岁时”，固定用 at；
也可以说 when he was 12（when 后接完整的句子）。

ladder.q: My cousin learnt to swim ____ the age of six.
改写：She started to paint at the age of ten. → She started to paint when ____.
翻译：他 15 岁时发明了一种新的风筝。
ladder.a: He invented a new kite at the age of 15. / when he was 15.

items.stem: 按“名词、动词通常重读”，读 Kate wrote a letter to her grandpa. 时，通常重读哪些词？
right: Kate、letter、grandpa 是名词，wrote 是动词，撑起句子的意思，要重读；
a、to、her 读得轻而快。

ladder.q: 划出重读词：Tom plays football.
划出重读词：My dad cooks dinner for us.
划出重读词：Lucy found a key under the desk.

items.stem: In 2003, Yang Liwei made history as China's first astronaut in space. 句中 made history 的意思是：
right: make history 指做出具有历史意义的事，创造历史；
成为中国第一位进入太空的航天员，正是创造了历史。
typical: 合起来就是“写一本历史”。

ladder.q: 翻译短语：make history
填空：Our team ____ history by winning the school's first gold medal.
用 make history 写一句话，说说你的梦想。
ladder.a: 示例：I hope to make history in science one day.

items.stem: 推荐班级榜样时，哪一句最适合放在结尾（Conclusion），对榜样作出评价？
options: Today I'll introduce my role model to you.
She shows us what a teenager can do.
She started a reading club at 14.
right: 结尾要对榜样作出评价，说出我们能从她身上学到什么；
第一句点明要介绍谁，属于开头；第三句是事实，属于正文。
typical: 14 岁就办读书会，这件事最打动人，

ladder.q: 开头、正文还是结尾？My role model is my cousin Ann.
开头、正文还是结尾？She won a science prize at 15.
为你的榜样写一句结尾评价。
ladder.a: 示例：We can all learn from her hard work.

items.topic: if 与 because 的分工
items.stem: Tom 爱剪纸，但还不知道社团有没有空位：Tom will join the club ____ it still has room, ____ he loves paper cutting.
right: “还有空位”现在还不确定，是条件，用 if；
“他喜欢剪纸”是已知的理由，用 because。
typical: 两个空都在说他为什么参加，先填 because：
… because it still has room, if he loves …

ladder.q: ____ it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home. (If / Because)
Amy stayed at home ____ she had a bad cold. (if / because)
用 if 和 because 写一句话，说说负责任的青少年。
ladder.a: 示例：If I make a promise, I keep it because others trust me.

items.stem: 谚语 Money can't buy happiness. 表达的看法是：
right: can't buy = 买不到：快乐不能靠钱买来；
原句并没有说有钱的人就不快乐。
typical: 钱买不来快乐，说明钱和快乐对着干，
所以有钱的人都不快乐。

ladder.q: 说出看法：Health is more important than money.
说出看法：Money doesn't grow on trees.
用英语写一句你对钱的看法。
ladder.a: 示例：Money is useful, but it isn't everything.

items.stem: My grandpa still lives ____ he was born.
right: “住在他出生的地方”：从句说地点，用 where；
where 本身就含“在那里”，前面不加 in。
typical: 住“在”……的地方，要先写 in：
lives in where he was born

ladder.q: Please put the books back ____ you found them. (when / where)
____ the bell rings, we go back to the classroom. (When / Where)
合并：There is a big tree. We often play there. → We often play ____.
ladder.a: where there is a big tree

items.stem: 一段广播开头的三句话里，哪一句直接说出了说话人的目的？
options: I'd like to invite you to our book sale.
Our school library has over 8,000 books.
Many students in our school love reading.
right: I'd like to invite you to… 直接说出说话人想做什么：请大家来逛书市；
另外两句是细节和引出话题的铺垫。

ladder.q: 找出说目的的句子：Hello, everyone. I'm here today to tell you about our art club.
ladder.a: I'm here today to tell you about our art club.

ladder.q: 用 I'd like to… 说出目的：邀请同学周六一起植树。
ladder.a: I'd like to invite you to plant trees with us this Saturday.

ladder.q: 说出目的：Our park is getting dirty. Come and join us to clean it up this Sunday!
ladder.a: 邀请大家周日一起去打扫公园

items.stem: Q: What did Tom buy for his mum? A: Tom bought some flowers for his mum. 回答时最该重读哪个词？
right: 问句问的是 What（买了什么），
答句里回答它的新信息是 flowers，所以重读 flowers。
typical: 句子最后一个词要读得最重：

ladder.q: Q: Who bought the flowers? A: Tom bought the flowers. 重读哪个词？
Q: When did you visit Grandma? A: I visited Grandma last Sunday. 重读哪里？
读出两种意思：I lent Sam my bike.（强调借给 Sam / 借的是自行车）
ladder.a: I lent SAM my bike. / I lent Sam my BIKE.

items.lesson: Section A Who do we admire?
items.topic: 夸人用 of 还是 for
items.stem: It was very brave ____ him to travel so far.
right: brave 说的是他这个人勇敢（He was brave.），
夸人的品质用 of：It was very brave of him to …
typical: It is important for us to …，所以也用 for：
It was very brave for him to travel so far.

ladder.q: 填 of 或 for：It's very kind ____ you to help me.
填 of 或 for：It is difficult ____ us to finish the work in a day.
用 It was … of … to … 改写：Tom helped the old man. (nice)
ladder.a: It was nice of Tom to help the old man.

items.topic: even though 不和 but 连用
items.stem: 小林写书评时用了下面这句话。你同意吗？
work: Even though Ben was poor, but he bought me a gift.
right: even though 和 but 只能用一个：
Even though Ben was poor, he bought me a gift.

ladder.q: 去掉多余的词：Even though it was late, but she kept working.
用 even though 合并：It was raining. We still went to the museum.
ladder.a: Even though it was raining, we still went to the museum.

ladder.q: 用 but 改写：Even though it was raining, we still went to the museum.
ladder.a: It was raining, but we still went to the museum.

items.lesson: Section B What makes people admirable?
items.stem: 用括号里词的正确形式填空：Mr Li writes books about the Tang Dynasty. He is a ____ (history).
right: 指人的词要加后缀：history 变成 historian（历史学家）。
He is a historian.

ladder.q: 写出指人的词：science → ____
用所给词的正确形式填空：Einstein was a great ____ (physics).
用所给词的正确形式填空：Many ____ (research) are studying seeds.

items.stem: 零花钱计划：I'll put ¥5 into my moneybox every week ____ a new football.
right: 存钱是为了买足球，表示目的用 to + 动词原形：
put ¥5 … every week to buy a new football
typical: … every week for buy a new football

ladder.q: I went to the bank ____ (open) an account.
for 还是 to：We sold old books ____ raise money for the library.
用 to do 说说你存零花钱的目的。
ladder.a: 示例：I save my pocket money to buy books.

items.lesson: Project Make a wall of inspiration
items.topic: 写人物介绍：It is … 句型
items.stem: 为“激励墙”写人物介绍。哪一句是对的？
options: It is necessary of us to learn from her.
It was amazing that she never gave up.
It was kind for him to share his ideas.
right: 夸人的品质（kind、brave）用 of，说事情（necessary）用 for；
It was amazing that … 后面接一个完整的句子。
typical: 学了 It was brave of him …，就都用 of：
It is necessary of us to learn from her.

ladder.q: 填 of 或 for：It is easy ____ me to remember her story.
填 of 或 for：It was clever ____ him to find a new way.
用 It is amazing that … 改写：She helps poor children.
ladder.a: It is amazing that she helps poor children.

items.stem: 理财建议：Write down what you spend ____ you buy something, and keep the notes ____ you can find them easily.
right: 买东西的“时候”记账，用 when；
放在“能找到的地方”，用 where，where 前不加 in。
typical: 放“在”找得到的地方，先写 in：
keep the notes in where you can find them

ladder.q: ____ you get pocket money, save part of it first. (When / Where)
Put your money box ____ your little brother can't reach it. (when / where)
用 when 和 where 各写一条理财建议。
ladder.a: 示例：Shop where prices are low. Save when you can.

items.stem: Hundreds of years have ____, but the old city wall still stands.
right: have 后面用过去分词：pass → passed → passed；
past 是“过去（的）”，不是 pass 的变化形式。

ladder.q: We learn about the ____ in history class. (past / passed)
Two hours ____ quickly in the museum. (past / passed)
The bus went ____ the old temple. (past / passed)

items.stem: The gold mask was ____ beautiful that all the visitors stopped to look at it.
right: 空后是单个形容词 beautiful，后面用 that 引出结果：so…that；
such 后面要有名词：such a beautiful mask that…

ladder.q: The box was ____ heavy that I couldn't move it. (so / such)
It was ____ an interesting film that we watched it twice. (so / such)
用 so…that 合并：The museum is very big. We can't see everything in a day.
ladder.a: The museum is so big that we can't see everything in a day.

items.stem: 参观古迹时，Tom 说：I don't think the giants moved these stones. Tom 的意思是：
options: 他不相信是巨人搬的这些石头
他认为是巨人搬的这些石头
他还没想过这些石头是谁搬的
right: I don't think … 是英语里表示怀疑、不相信的常用说法，
意思是“我认为不是……”：他不相信是巨人搬的。
typical: 所以 Tom 还没想过这个问题。

ladder.q: 翻译：I don't think it will rain today.
表示怀疑：A: The statues can walk at night! B: ____
ladder.a: I don't think that's true! / That's impossible!

ladder.q: 用 I don't think… 回应：A: History is just boring facts.
ladder.a: I don't think history is just boring facts.

items.stem: 按“前一词以辅音结尾、后一词以元音开头就连读”，下面哪一组通常连读？
right: an 以辅音 /n/ 结尾，hour 的 h 不发音，以元音开头，所以连读；
university 以辅音 /j/ 开头，black cat 是两个辅音，都不连读。
typical: university 以元音字母 u 开头，
big 以辅音结尾，所以要连读。

ladder.q: 标出连读：look at
标出连读：Pick it up.
哪一组连读：an egg、a pen、big tree？

items.stem: 小芳用下面这句话介绍学校的课程。你同意吗？
work: Besides Chinese and maths, we also study history.
right: besides = 除……之外（还有），和 also 搭配：
语文、数学要学，还学历史，用 besides 是对的。

ladder.q: ____ English, Lily can also speak French. (Besides / Except)
Everyone went to the museum ____ Tom. He was ill. (besides / except)
用 besides 说一句：除了时装秀，还有什么方式让历史“活”起来？
ladder.a: 示例：Besides fashion shows, films can also bring history alive.

items.topic: such a + 形容词 + 名词
items.stem: 为班级历史书写一页：The legend of Mulan is ____ that people still tell it today.
right: such 后接“形容词 + 单数可数名词”时，a / an 放在 such 后面：
such a moving story that …
typical: 照“一个如此感人的故事”的语序：

ladder.q: It was ____ old temple that nobody knew its age. (such an / an such)
The bridge was ____ long that we walked for an hour. (such / so)
用 such…that 介绍一处古迹。
ladder.a: 示例：It is such a beautiful place that many people visit it.

items.stem: ① The cave was so dark that we used torches. ② We used torches so that we could see the paintings. 两句的从句分别表示：
right: ① so + 形容词 + that：因为太黑，结果用了手电筒；
② so that 连在一起，后面有 could：为了能看清壁画。
typical: 两句都有 so 和 that，

ladder.q: 目的还是结果？I got up early so that I could see the sunrise.
目的还是结果？The film was so funny that we laughed a lot.
用 so that 合并：Mr Li made a video. Students could learn about the old town.
ladder.a: Mr Li made a video so that students could learn about the old town.

items.lesson: Section A How do we learn?
items.stem: Tom 问你：Do you like maths? 你转述给同桌：Tom wants to know ____.
right: 原句问的是“是不是”，用 if / whether 引导；
从句用陈述语序：Tom wants to know if I like maths.
typical: 宾语从句用 that 引导：
Tom wants to know that I like maths.

ladder.q: 填 that 或 if：I think ____ reading is fun.
填 that 或 if：Mum asks ____ I have finished my homework.
合成一句：Is the library open today? I don't know.
ladder.a: I don't know if the library is open today.

items.lesson: Section B How can we get better at learning?
lessons: How can we get better at learning
items.stem: “我们笑得越多，就越开心。”英语怎么说？
options: More we laugh, happier we are.
The more we laugh, the happier we are.
The more we laugh, the more happier we are.
right: “越……越……”用 The + 比较级 …, the + 比较级 …；
happier 已经是比较级，前面不再加 more。
typical: More we laugh, happier we are.

ladder.q: 补全：The more you read, the ____ (fast) you can read.
翻译：我们练习得越多，就变得越自信。
ladder.a: The more we practise, the more confident we become.

ladder.q: 改错：The more you review, the more better you remember.

items.lesson: Project Carry out a survey on learning
lessons: Carry out a survey on learning
items.stem: 打分 1–10（1 最不重要，10 最重要）。平均分：taking notes 8.5，studying all the time 2.5。这样汇报，你同意吗？
work: Taking notes is more important than studying all the time.
right: 分数越高越重要：taking notes 8.5 分，studying all the time 只得 2.5 分，
所以 taking notes 更重要，这样汇报是对的。

ladder.q: 打分 1–10，10 最重要。A 平均 9 分，B 平均 3 分。小组认为哪个更重要？
用英语汇报：reviewing lessons 平均 7.5 分，taking notes 平均 6 分。
ladder.a: Our group thinks reviewing lessons is more important than taking notes.

ladder.q: 改成排名（第 1 名 = 最重要），排第 1 的方法最重要还是最不重要？
ladder.a: 最重要；排名看名次，打分看分数，先读说明

items.stem: The doctors and nurses who saved lives in the flood are true ____.
right: are 和 doctors and nurses 说明要用复数；
hero 以 o 结尾，复数加 -es：heroes（像 tomatoes）。

ladder.q: 写复数：potato → ____
写复数：photo → ____（要特别记的词）
用 heroes 写一句话，说说你心中的英雄。
ladder.a: 示例：Firefighters are heroes to me.

items.stem: My aunt is a nurse ____ works at a children's hospital.
right: 先行词 a nurse 是人，引导词用 who；
who 在从句里作 works 的主语，说明是哪一个护士。
typical: “在儿童医院工作的”说的是哪一个护士，

ladder.q: He is the boy ____ helped me yesterday. (who / which)
合并：I have a friend. She can play the erhu.
ladder.a: I have a friend who can play the erhu.

ladder.q: 改错：Heroes are people what help others in danger.

items.stem: A: Did you like the film about the pilots? B: Well, it was OK, I guess. It was a bit long. B 的态度是：
right: Well、I guess 说明他说得不太肯定，a bit long 是在抱怨，
所以他觉得一般，不太满意。
typical: OK 就是“好”，所以他很喜欢。

ladder.q: A: How was the trip? B: Amazing! I want to go again! B 的态度？
A: Was the book good? B: Hmm… it was all right, I guess. B 的态度？
用一句话表示“觉得一般，有点失望”：A: How was the show?
ladder.a: 示例：Well, it was OK, I guess. It was a bit boring.

items.stem: go out 两个元音相连，中间会带出一个音把它们连起来。go out 听起来像：
right: go 以圆唇的元音结尾，out 以元音开头，
嘴唇从圆到张开，自然带出 /w/：go wout。
typical: 就像 the end 读成 theyend：go yout。

ladder.q: two eggs 中间带出 /j/ 还是 /w/？
she is 中间带出 /j/ 还是 /w/？
朗读并标出带出的音：I agree. / Do it now.

items.stem: After many tries, Lucy finally succeeded in ____ a robot dog.
right: succeed in doing sth 成功做成某事；
in 是介词，后面用 -ing：succeeded in making。
typical: succeeded in to make a robot dog

ladder.q: He succeeded in ____ (pass) the test.
They spent two years ____ (build) the bridge.
翻译：经过多次失败，她终于成功种出了西瓜。
ladder.a: After many failures, she finally succeeded in growing watermelons.

items.stem: 介绍本地英雄：Dr Zhou spent 30 years ____ the people in the mountain villages.
right: spend + 时间 + doing：花……时间做某事；
spent 30 years helping the people …
typical: spent 是过去式，help 也跟着变成过去式：

ladder.q: She spends an hour ____ (read) every day.
改错：He spent two years built the bridge.
用 spend… doing 介绍一位本地英雄。
ladder.a: 示例：She spent ten years teaching in the village.

items.topic: 用 who 合并英雄故事
items.stem: 小雨用 who 把两句合成一句：My aunt is a firefighter. She saved two children from a fire. 她从第几步开始错了？
work: 两句说的是同一个人：a firefighter 就是 She
在 a firefighter 后面接上 who
who 后照抄第二句：who she saved two children
写出：My aunt is a firefighter who she saved …
right: who 已经代替了 She，在从句里作主语，不能再留 she：
My aunt is a firefighter who saved two children from a fire.

ladder.q: 合并：I have an uncle. He is a police officer.
ladder.a: I have an uncle who is a police officer.

ladder.q: 改错：The man who he helped me is a doctor.
用 who 合并：We thanked the volunteers. They cleaned the park.
ladder.a: We thanked the volunteers who cleaned the park.

items.lesson: Section A What do we remember?
items.stem: 把问题放进句子里：When does the lecture start? → I can't remember ____.
right: 宾语从句用陈述语序，去掉 does；
主语 the lecture 是三单，动词加 -s：when the lecture starts。
typical: I can't remember when does the lecture start.

ladder.q: 合成一句：Where is the library? Can you tell me?
ladder.a: Can you tell me where the library is?

ladder.q: 合成一句：What does Tom need? I don't know.
ladder.a: I don't know what Tom needs.

ladder.q: 改错：I wonder why did she leave so early.
ladder.a: why did she leave → why she left

items.lesson: Section B How can we improve our memory?
lessons: How can we improve our memory
items.stem: 用括号里词的正确形式填空：Grandpa is getting ____ (forget). He often can't find his glasses.
right: is getting 后面要形容词，说爷爷“怎么样”；
forget + -ful = forgetful（健忘的）。
typical: forget 就是“忘”：Grandpa is getting forget.

ladder.q: 写出形容词：help → ____
用所给词的正确形式填空：Mind maps are an ____ (effect) way to review.
用所给词的正确形式填空：Be an ____ (act) learner.

items.lesson: Project Debate: Do we need to memorize things?
lessons: Do we need to memorize things
items.stem: 辩论题：Do we need to memorize things? 你方观点是 Yes。哪一句是支持你方的理由？
options: During exams, we can't look things up online.
Search engines can answer questions fast.
right: 理由要回答“为什么需要记”：考试时不能上网查，
所以有些东西必须记在脑子里。

ladder.q: 观点 We should read more. 哪句是理由？A. Reading is a must. B. Reading teaches us new words.
哪句支持“不用背电话号码”？A. Our phones can save them. B. Phones can run out of power.
哪句用例子说明需要记？A. Memory matters a lot. B. In an emergency, doctors have no time to search.

items.stem: A place that gets very little rain and has few plants is a ____.
right: 雨很少、植物很少的地方是沙漠 desert（一个 s）；
dessert（两个 s）是甜点；rainforest 雨水很多。

ladder.q: We had ice cream for ____ after dinner. (desert / dessert)
Cows and sheep eat grass on the ____. (grassland / desert)
用英语说说 rainforest 是什么样的地方。
ladder.a: 示例：It gets lots of rain and has many tall trees.

items.stem: 小明说：定语从句的引导词都能省略，所以下面两句都对。你同意吗？
work: The bird that sings in the tree is small.
= The bird sings in the tree is small.
right: that 在从句里作 sings 的主语，不能省略；
作宾语时才能省：The bird (that) I saw is small.

ladder.q: that 能省吗？The book that I bought is new.
ladder.a: 能，that 作 bought 的宾语

ladder.q: that 能省吗？The river that runs past my school is clean now.
ladder.a: 不能，that 作 runs 的主语

ladder.q: 改错：The animals live in the forest need our help.
ladder.a: 在 animals 后加 that（或 which）

items.stem: Since the forest is getting smaller, the animals there will lose their homes. 这里 since 的意思是：
right: 主句 will lose 不是完成时，since 不表示时间；
森林变小是原因，since = 因为（既然）。
typical: 自从森林变小，动物将失去家园。

ladder.q: 找出表示原因的词：As it was raining, we stayed at home.
since 是“自从”还是“因为”？Since you are free, let's go shopping.
since 是“自从”还是“因为”？We have lived here since I was five.

items.stem: 读 We planted trees on the hill. 时，on 和 the 应该怎样读？
options: 读得轻而快，但要读出来
和 planted、trees 一样读得重
right: on、the 是虚词，主要管语法，读得轻而快；
弱读不是不读，它们仍要发出来。
typical: on、the 在录音里听不清楚，

ladder.q: I have a cup of tea. 里，a、cup、of、tea 哪两个弱读？
朗读并圈出弱读词：Put the book on the desk.
朗读并圈出弱读词：A lot of birds live in the forest.

items.stem: The new park in our town is three times ____ the old one.
right: 倍数表达：… times as + 形容词原级 + as …；
three times as big as the old one。

ladder.q: My room is as ____ (big) as yours.
This river is ____ (long) than that one.
翻译：这个湖是那个湖的两倍大。
ladder.a: This lake is twice / two times as big as that one.

items.stem: 预测结果：After we clean up the river, it will be ____ easier for fish to live there.
right: easier 已经是比较级，前面用 much 加强：much easier；
very 只修饰原级（very easy），more 不和 -er 连用。
typical: it will be very easier for fish

ladder.q: The air is ____ cleaner now. (very / much)
This park is ____ beautiful. (very / much)
翻译：现在河水干净多了。
ladder.a: The river is much cleaner now.

items.stem: 选一个词，两个空都能填：The volunteers ____ cleaned the river took away the bottles ____ were left on the bank.
right: 第一空指人（volunteers），第二空指物（bottles）；
that 既能指人也能指物，两个空都能填。
typical: 第一空填 who 最顺，

ladder.q: The trees ____ we planted last year are growing well. (who / which)
The scientist ____ studies birds came to our school. (which / who)
用 that 合并：Some rivers were dirty before. They are clean again.
ladder.a: Some rivers that were dirty before are clean again.

items.lesson: Section A What changes can inventions bring to our lives?
lessons: What changes can inventions bring to our lives
items.stem: The new science museum in our town ____ last year.
right: 博物馆是“被建”的，用被动语态 be + 过去分词；
last year 是过去，be 用 was：was built。
typical: 博物馆是去年建的，用过去式就行：
The new science museum built last year.

ladder.q: 用所给词的正确形式填空：This bridge ____ (build) in 2020.
用所给词的正确形式填空：These toys ____ (make) by a 3D printer last week.
改成被动语态：Students planted these trees last spring.
ladder.a: These trees were planted by students last spring.

items.lesson: Section B How do we turn ideas into reality?
lessons: How do we turn ideas into reality
items.stem: Papermaking is one of the greatest ____ in history.
right: one of the greatest 后面要复数名词；
造纸术是一项发明，不是发明者：inventions。

ladder.q: 写出名词：create → ____
写出指人的名词：invent → ____
用所给词的正确形式填空：My brother has a big stamp ____ (collect).

items.lesson: Project Come up with your own invention
lessons: Come up with your own invention
items.stem: 在发明海报上介绍材料：Our new plant pot ____ of old newspapers.
right: 花盆是“被做”出来的，用被动语态 be + 过去分词；
说现在的样子用 is：Our new plant pot is made of old newspapers.
typical: 花盆是用旧报纸做的，made 就是“做的”：
Our new plant pot made of old newspapers.

ladder.q: 用所给词的正确形式填空：This bag ____ (make) of cloth.
用所给词的正确形式填空：Our robot ____ (use) to clean windows.
改成被动语态：We make these toys from old bottles.
ladder.a: These toys are made from old bottles.

items.stem: World Environment Day is ____ 5 June every year.
right: 5 June 是具体的某一天，用 on；
只说月份才用 in：in June。

ladder.q: Our school's Green Week is ____ June. (in / on)
World Ocean Day is ____ 8 June. (in / on)
用英语说：我们 4 月 22 日去捡垃圾。
ladder.a: We'll pick up rubbish on 22 April.（或 on April 22）

items.stem: 用括号里的词的正确形式填空：Life on the earth is ____ (possible) without water.
right: 没有水就不可能有生命，这里要否定的意思；
possible 的反义词加前缀 im-：impossible。

ladder.q: 写反义词：happy → ____
写反义词：polite → ____
用括号里的词填空：Our teacher is very ____ (care). She checks our work twice.

items.stem: Lucy turns an old pair of jeans into a pencil bag. 按本课的说法，这属于：
right: upcycling 是用有创意的方法再用旧东西；
牛仔裤没有变回原料，而是改成了笔袋，所以是 upcycling。
typical: 旧牛仔裤变成了新笔袋，

ladder.q: We turn off the lights when we leave the room. 这是哪个 R？
Old newspapers are made into new paper at a factory. 这是 recycling 还是 upcycling？
用 I can turn… into… 说一种你能做的 upcycling。
ladder.a: 示例：I can turn an old T-shirt into a shopping bag.

items.stem: Mum 问：Is this your umbrella? Lily 指着 Amy 说：No, it's HER umbrella.（重读 her）Lily 想强调：
options: 伞是 Amy 的，不是我的
没什么特别，只是读响一点
right: her 平时弱读；这里重读，是在纠正 Mum 说的 your：
伞是她（Amy）的，不是我的。
typical: 名词才是重点，重读 her 是为了带出

ladder.q: A: Is this Tom's bike? B: No, it's MY bike. B 在强调什么？
ladder.a: 车是我的，不是 Tom 的

ladder.q: A: Shall I clean the room? B: No, I'll do it. 想强调“我来做”，重读哪个词？
强调“我们自己就能做”，该怎样读：We can help the earth.

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空（注意词序）：My little brother is not ____ (old, enough) to ride a bike on the road.
right: enough 修饰形容词时放在形容词后面：
old enough to do sth 年龄够大，可以做某事。
typical: not enough old to ride a bike

ladder.q: The water is not ____ (warm, enough) for swimming.
We don't have ____ (time, enough) to finish the game.
翻译：这个盒子够大，能装下所有的书。
ladder.a: This box is big enough to hold all the books.

items.stem: 家庭环保报告：I suggest that we ____ off the TV when nobody is watching it.
right: suggest that 后面是完整的从句：we + 动词原形；
I suggest that we turn off the TV …
typical: 建议“去”做某事，就加 to：
I suggest that we to turn off the TV …

ladder.q: I suggest that we ____ (walk) to school more often.
I suggest that you ____ (drink) more water every day.
用 I suggest that we… 给家人提一条环保建议。
ladder.a: 示例：I suggest that we take our own bags.

items.stem: 按构词法，reuse、recycle、refill 里的前缀 re- 表示：
right: re- 表示“再，重复”：reuse 再用，refill 再装满，
recycle 回收后再次利用。
typical: 3R 里第一个就是 reduce（减少），
所以 re- 表示“减少”。

ladder.q: 写出意思：reopen
用 build 的正确形式填空：After the flood, the school was ____.（重建）
用 reuse 写一句话，说说你怎样再用旧东西。
ladder.a: 示例：I reuse old boxes to keep my toys.

items.lesson: Section A Why do we explore space?
items.stem: A new satellite ____ into space next month.
right: 卫星是“被送”上天的，用被动语态；
next month 是将来：will be + 过去分词 sent。
typical: A new satellite will send into space next month.

ladder.q: 用所给词的正确形式填空：More trees ____ (plant) here next spring.
改成被动语态：They will build a new hospital next year.
ladder.a: A new hospital will be built next year.

ladder.q: 改错：The new space station will finished in two years.

items.lesson: Section B How far can we go into space?
lessons: How far can we go into space
items.stem: 读句子：Take some water in case you get thirsty on the trip. 意思是：
options: 先带上水，以防路上口渴
如果路上口渴了，再去拿水
因为路上口渴，所以带上水
right: in case + 一件可能发生的事：先做准备，以防万一；
现在还没口渴，带水是防着路上会渴。
typical: in case 就是 if：如果路上口渴了，再去拿水

ladder.q: in case 的意思是：A. 以防 B. 因为
翻译：带上外套，以防天变冷。
ladder.a: Take a coat in case it gets cold.

ladder.q: 用 in case 连成一句：Leave early. The roads may be busy.
ladder.a: Leave early in case the roads are busy.

items.lesson: Project Make a poster about China’s space programme
lessons: Make a poster about China’s space programme
items.stem: 小组给中国航天海报写了四句。从第几句开始出错？
work: Tianhe was sent into space in 2021.
Since then, many astronauts have worked there.
More experiments will do there in the future.
One day, people may be sent to Mars.
right: 实验是“被做”的，要用将来时的被动语态 will be + 过去分词：
More experiments will be done there in the future.

ladder.q: 用所给词的正确形式填空：New photos of Mars ____ (send) back next week.
改成被动语态：They will choose three astronauts for the mission.
ladder.a: Three astronauts will be chosen for the mission.

ladder.q: 改错：More robots will use to explore the moon.

items.lesson: Section A What do you like about music?
lessons: What do you like about music
items.stem: I want to meet the musician ____ played the piano at our concert.
right: 先行词 the musician 是人，用 who（也可以用 that）；
… the musician who played the piano at our concert.
typical: … the musician which played the piano at our concert.

ladder.q: 填 who 或 which：I like music ____ makes me happy.
填 who 或 which：The girl ____ plays the pipa is my sister.
合成一句：I have a friend. He can play the violin.
ladder.a: I have a friend who can play the violin.

items.lesson: Section B What is the power of music?
lessons: What is the power of music
items.stem: 读句子：Lily sings the best in our class, but she never looks down on others. 意思是：
right: look down on 是一个整体：瞧不起、看不起；
莉莉唱得最好，却从不瞧不起别人。
typical: look 是看，down 是向下：莉莉从不低头看别人

ladder.q: look up to 的意思是：A. 敬佩 B. 瞧不起
翻译：不要瞧不起别人。
填 look up to 或 look down on：Many students ____ Yuan Longping.

items.lesson: Project Give a presentation on a famous musician
lessons: Give a presentation on a famous musician
items.stem: 介绍音乐家冼星海：The Yellow River Cantata is a famous piece ____.
right: piece 是物，用 which；which 在从句里就是 wrote 的宾语，
后面不再加 it：… a famous piece which Xian Xinghai wrote.
typical: “冼星海写了它”，宾语 it 不能少：
… a famous piece which Xian Xinghai wrote it.

ladder.q: 改错：This is the song which I like it best.
合成一句：I listened to a song. My friend wrote it.
ladder.a: I listened to a song (that / which) my friend wrote.

ladder.q: 改错：The musician who I met him yesterday plays the erhu.

items.lesson: Section A Why do we like sports events?
lessons: Why do we like sports events
items.stem: 选出主谓一致正确的一句：
options: Everyone in our class are ready.
Both Tom and Jim is fast.
right: each team 作主语看作单数，用 has；
Everyone 后用 is；Both Tom and Jim 是两个人，用 are。
typical: Everyone in our class are ready.

ladder.q: 填 is 或 are：Everybody in my family ____ a football fan.
填 is 或 are：Both my brother and I ____ in the school team.
用所给词的正确形式填空：Each player ____ (have) a number on the shirt.

items.lesson: Section B How does sport bring us together?
lessons: How does sport bring us together
items.stem: 读句子：Li Lei ran faster and caught up with Tom in the last 20 metres. 意思是：
options: 李雷在最后 20 米伸手抓住了汤姆
李雷在最后 20 米追上了汤姆
李雷在最后 20 米超过了汤姆
right: catch up with sb：从后面追上某人，跟他并排；
句子只说追上了，没说跑到了汤姆前面。
typical: catch 是抓：李雷在最后 20 米伸手抓住了汤姆

ladder.q: catch up with 的意思是：A. 追上 B. 抓住
翻译：跑快点，我们就能追上他们。
ladder.a: Run faster, and we can catch up with them.

ladder.q: 填 catch up with 或 sign up for：Tom fell behind, but he soon ____ the others.

items.lesson: Project Introduce your favourite sports event
items.stem: 小林介绍他最喜欢的赛事，写了四句。从第几句开始出错？
work: Wimbledon started in 1877.
Everyone in our school watch the final.
Both my dad and I love tennis.
We hope to go there one day.
right: everyone 作主语看作单数，动词用三单：
Everyone in our school watches the final.

ladder.q: 填 is 或 are：Nobody in our class ____ late today.
用所给词的正确形式填空：Everybody in my family ____ (like) basketball.
改错：Every athlete in the race have a dream.

items.lesson: Section A How do people celebrate festivals?
items.topic: 分清简单句、并列句和复合句
items.stem: 下面哪一句是复合句（complex sentence）？
options: Mia and I watched lanterns and ate yuanxiao.
We made zongzi, and Grandpa told us a story.
I wonder when the boat race will start.
On New Year's Eve, my family eats dumplings.
right: I wonder 后面跟着从句 when the boat race will start，
一个主句加一个从句，是复合句。
用 and 连起两个简单句是并列句；只有一组主谓是简单句。
typical: We made zongzi, and Grandpa told us a story.
有两部分，所以是复合句。

ladder.q: 判断句型：Tomb-sweeping Day is usually in April.
判断句型：I wanted to go out, but it rained all day.
ladder.a: 并列句（but 连接两个简单句）

ladder.q: 用 because 把两句合成复合句：We eat zongzi. We want to remember Qu Yuan.
ladder.a: We eat zongzi because we want to remember Qu Yuan.

items.lesson: Section B What can festivals bring us?
items.topic: 没有 I think 也可能是观点
items.stem: 读到下面这句话，小林这样判断。你同意吗？
work: The Spring Festival is the best time of the year.
小林：这句没有 I think，但它是观点，不是事实。
right: best 是对节日的评价，别人可能觉得中秋节更好，没法查证，所以是观点。
事实能查证，如 People in Egypt celebrate Sham El-Nessim in April.

ladder.q: 事实还是观点？Chinese people eat mooncakes at the Mid-Autumn Festival.
事实还是观点？Holi is the most exciting festival in India.
把这句观点改成一句事实：The Dragon Boat Festival is the most interesting festival.
ladder.a: 如：People eat zongzi at the Dragon Boat Festival.

items.lesson: Project Give a presentation on a festival
items.stem: 为节日展示列问题清单：What ____ people in India throw during Holi?
right: throw 是实义动词，问句要借助助动词；
people 是复数，用 do：What do people in India throw during Holi?
typical: people 没有 s，看着像一个人，

ladder.q: 补全问题：How long ____ Holi last? (is / does)
补全问题：What ____ people eat at the Spring Festival? (do / are)
为你想介绍的节日写两个问题。
ladder.a: 示例：Where do people celebrate it? What do they eat?

items.unit: Unit 2 A Look into the Past
items.lesson: Section A What can ancient objects tell us about history?
items.stem: This jade cup is so small. It can't weigh much. 这里的 can't 是什么意思？
options: 一定不重，说话人很有把握
也许不太重，说话人没什么把握
人们没有能力把它做得很重
right: can't 在这里是很有把握的否定推测：“不可能……”，依据是杯子很小。
must be 是很有把握的肯定推测；might / could be 才是没把握。
typical: 人们不能把它做得很重。

ladder.q: 选 must / can't 填空：Tom takes photos every day. He ____ love photography.
选 must / can't 填空：Lily is in Beijing today. The girl I saw in Shanghai today ____ be Lily.
用 might 改写，表示没把握：Perhaps the box is made of wood.
ladder.a: The box might be made of wood.

items.unit: Unit 2 A Look into the Past
items.lesson: Section B How can we bring the past back to life?
lessons: bring the past back to life
items.topic: 同一个词作名词和动词
items.stem: 小华这样判断。你同意吗？
work: aim 是名词，意思是“目标”，
所以 She aims to become a tour guide. 这句话错了。
right: aim 既是名词（目标），也是动词（力争做到）。
这里 aims 是动词：她力争成为一名导游。trade、repair 也是这样一词两用。

ladder.q: aim 是名词还是动词？The main aim of the trip is to learn about history.
用 repair 的正确形式填空：The workers ____ the bronze mask last year.
用 trade 造两个句子，一句当名词，一句当动词。
ladder.a: 如：Trade helps both countries. / They traded tea for silk.

items.unit: Unit 2 A Look into the Past
items.lesson: Project Bring the past to life
items.stem: 介绍一件古物：This pot has black marks at the bottom. It might ____ a cooking pot.
right: might 是情态动词，后面跟动词原形 be：
It might be a cooking pot.（也许是一口煮饭的锅）
typical: It might is a cooking pot.

ladder.q: This bronze mask must ____ very old. (is / be)
改错：The jade cup could to be a gift for a king.
用 might be 猜一猜：This small stone tool has a sharp edge.
ladder.a: 示例：It might be a knife.

items.lesson: Section A What do you like about art?
items.stem: Mum told me ____ my phone during dinner.
right: tell sb (not) to do：让某人（不要）做某事，不定式作宾语补足语；
否定把 not 放在 to 前面：told me not to use。
typical: 照“妈妈告诉我：别用手机”直接写：
Mum told me don't use my phone.

ladder.q: 补全：The teacher asked us ____ (close) the windows.
补全：The guide told us ____ (not touch) the paintings.
改错：I expect you not come late again.

items.lesson: Section B How can art inspire us?
items.stem: I came across an old calligraphy brush in Grandpa's drawer. came across 是什么意思？
right: come across = 偶然遇见、碰到（人或物）；
抽屉里的旧毛笔是“我”无意中发现的，不是专门去找的。
typical: 在抽屉里，那就是在找东西：

ladder.q: 选意思：I came across my old classmate in the museum.（A 偶然遇见 B 约好见面）
用 come across 的正确形式填空：Yesterday I ____ a beautiful painting in an old shop.
用 come across 写一句话，说说你偶然看到书法的经历。
ladder.a: 如：I came across a calligraphy show in a shopping mall.

items.stem: 作品介绍：Our paper-cut shows a full moon. We hope it makes you ____ of your family.
right: make sb do：让某人做某事，do 前不加 to；
it makes you think of your family.
typical: 学过 ask sb to do，就照着加 to：
it makes you to think of your family

ladder.q: This song makes me ____ (feel) happy.
We asked the visitors ____ (write) their names.
用 make sb do 介绍一件艺术作品。
ladder.a: 示例：The painting makes me want to visit the sea.

items.stem: 小东把一个问句放进 Can you tell me 后面。他从第几步开始错了？
work: 原问句：How can we reduce waste?
把它放在 tell me 后面，作宾语从句
从句开头保留疑问词 how
照抄问句：Can you tell me how can we reduce waste?
right: 宾语从句用陈述语序：疑问词 + 主语 + 谓语，
Can you tell me how we can reduce waste?

ladder.q: 合成一句：Where is the waste centre? I don't know.
ladder.a: I don't know where the waste centre is.

ladder.q: 合成一句：Why is the river so dirty? Do you know?
ladder.a: Do you know why the river is so dirty?

ladder.q: 合成一句：Does the factory cause the smog? I wonder.
ladder.a: I wonder if / whether the factory causes the smog.

items.lesson: Section B How can we protect our environment?
items.stem: Many people stayed indoors ____ the heavy smog.
right: the heavy smog 是名词短语，前面用 because of；
后面是完整的句子才用 because，如 because the smog was heavy.
typical: Many people stayed indoors because the heavy smog.

ladder.q: 选 because / because of：Many fish died ____ the dirty water.
选 because / because of：Fishing was banned ____ there were too few fish.
用 as a result 改写：Factories put waste into the river, so the fish died.
ladder.a: Factories put waste into the river. As a result, the fish died.

items.lesson: Project Make a leaflet about the three Rs
items.stem: 做三 R 传单时，这条做法应放进哪一栏？Use an old glass jar as a pencil holder.
right: 玻璃瓶没有变回原料，只是换个用法再用一次，属于 Reuse；
Recycle 要送去回收、重新加工成新材料。
typical: 旧瓶子变成了笔筒，变成了新东西，

ladder.q: 哪一栏？Don't buy things that you don't need.
哪一栏？Put empty cans in the recycling bin.
为传单的 Reuse 一栏写一条做法。
ladder.a: 示例：Use old T-shirts as cleaning cloths.

items.lesson: Section A How has your junior high experience shaped you?
items.stem: Lucy and I ____ each other since Grade 7. Now we are graduating!
right: since Grade 7 表示从那时一直到现在，用现在完成时；
know 表示状态，不用进行时：have known。
typical: Lucy and I knew each other since Grade 7.

ladder.q: 用所给词的正确形式填空：I ____ (study) at this school for three years.
用所给词的正确形式填空：My uncle ____ (live) in Shanghai since 2020.
用所给词的正确形式填空：We ____ (be) friends since we ____ (meet) in Grade 7.

items.lesson: Section B What do you have to say upon graduation?
items.stem: 用括号里的词的正确形式填空：Ms Li always listens to us with great ____ (patient).
right: with great 后面要用名词；patient（耐心的）的名词是 patience，
像 silent → silence、different → difference。
typical: patient 就是“耐心”，直接填：with great patient

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：Please keep ____ (silent) in the library.
写出名词形式：encourage → ____；develop → ____
用括号里的词填空：Thanks for the useful ____ (inform) about high schools.

items.stem: 年鉴照片说明：Last spring, our class ____ first prize in the school singing contest.
right: Last spring 是过去的一个时间点，用一般过去时；
win → won：our class won first prize.
typical: 拿奖是“已经”发生的事，用现在完成时：
our class has won first prize

ladder.q: We ____ (go) on a class trip to the Great Wall in Grade 8.
We ____ (be) classmates for three years.
为年鉴写一句话，回忆初中的一件事。
ladder.a: 示例：In Grade 7, we planted a tree in the school garden.
